We are looking for an experienced **Payroll Manager** to manage the complete payroll function, ensuring accurate and timely salary processing, statutory compliance, payroll reconciliation, employee payments, and reporting.  
The ideal candidate should have strong hands\-on experience in payroll operations, statutory deductions, payroll audits, HRMS/payroll systems, and coordination with HR and Finance teams.  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage the **end\-to\-end payroll process** for employees across the organization.

* Manage payroll inputs including attendance, leave, overtime, incentives, deductions, reimbursements, bonuses, arrears, and new joiners/exits.
* Review and validate payroll calculations before salary processing.
* Ensure accurate calculation of **PF, ESI, Professional Tax, TDS, Gratuity, Bonus, and other applicable statutory deductions**.
* Coordinate with Finance to ensure timely salary disbursement and statutory remittances.
* Manage payroll processing through HRMS/payroll software and ensure data accuracy.
* Conduct monthly payroll reconciliation and resolve discrepancies.
* Prepare payroll MIS, salary reports, headcount reports, variance reports, and management dashboards.
* Handle employee payroll queries related to salary, deductions, tax, payslips, arrears, reimbursements, and other payroll matters.

* Review and process exit payroll, notice\-period adjustments, leave encashment, recoveries, and final settlements.
* Coordinate with HR for employee master data and payroll changes.
* Ensure compliance with payroll\-related statutory requirements and deadlines.
* Support payroll audits and provide required reports, registers, and supporting documents.
* Coordinate with statutory consultants, auditors, Finance, HR, and payroll vendors.
* Monitor payroll\-related statutory changes and ensure necessary system/process updates.
* Maintain strict confidentiality and security of employee salary and payroll information.
* Develop and improve payroll processes to increase accuracy, efficiency, and compliance.
* Identify payroll errors and implement appropriate corrective and preventive measures.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in **HR, Finance, Accounting, Commerce, or a related field**.
* 6–10 years of relevant experience in **payroll management / payroll operations**.
* Strong hands\-on knowledge of Indian payroll processes.
* Good understanding of **PF, ESI, PT, TDS, Gratuity, Bonus, and other statutory deductions**.
* Strong knowledge of payroll calculations and reconciliation.
* Experience with HRMS/payroll software.
* Advanced knowledge of **MS Excel**, including formulas, Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and data reconciliation.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
* Good communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to handle confidential employee information professionally.
* Strong knowledge of payroll compliance and statutory deadlines.

**Preferred**

* Experience managing payroll for **500\+ employees**.
* Multi\-location payroll experience.
* Experience with payroll audits and statutory reconciliations.
* Experience handling payroll automation and HRMS implementation.
* Professional certification in Payroll / HR / Finance will be an advantage.

We are looking for a dynamic and people\-oriented People Experience Partner to support the HR function at our manufacturing plant in Arakkonam.

The role will also support the Plant HR Head in Industrial Relations, statutory compliance, contract labour management and workforce\-related activities.


The position will serve as an important interface between employees, contract workmen, supervisors and the HR team, ensuring timely resolution of employee queries and delivery of a positive employee experience at the plant

**HR Operations \& Employee Lifecycle**

* Understand employee concerns and grievances and escalate matters appropriately to the Plant HR Head.
* Coordinate employee welfare activities, celebrations, recognition initiatives and other plant\-level employee engagement programmes.
* Maintain a positive and employee\-friendly work environment while ensuring alignment with business requirements.

**Employee Relations \& Industrial Relations Support**

**Statutory Compliance \& Regulatory Coordination**

* Support preparation of documents and information required for statutory inspections, audits and reviews.
* Coordinate with relevant internal teams and external agencies for compliance\-related activities.
* Assist in ensuring timely renewal, documentation and maintenance of relevant licences, registrations and records.
* Support liaison and coordination with statutory authorities and external agencies whenever required.

**Contract Labour Management**

Passion, excitement \& global collaboration are all core to what it means to be a FlyMate. At Flywire, we’re on a mission to deliver the world’s most important and complex payments. Flywire is a global payments enablement and software company, founded more than a decade ago to solve high\-stakes, high\-value payments. We’ve scaled into new regions and industry verticals and expanded our product offerings to deliver meaningful value to our clients around the world.


Today we support more than 5,300 clients across the global education, healthcare, travel \& B2B industries, with diverse payment methods across 240 countries \& territories and more than 140 currencies.


With over 1,400\+ global FlyMates, representing more than 40 nationalities, and in 15 offices world\-wide, we’re looking for FlyMates to join the next stage of our journey as we continue to grow.

 **Job Description** **The Opportunity**


Flywire is seeking a highly skilled Senior People Analytics Specialist (Workday) to strengthen the People team's ability to make timely trusted data\-informed decisions. This role will own the design, development, maintenance and continuous improvement of People reporting and analytics within Workday.


You will partner closely with People leaders, People Operations, People Technology, Finance and Business Intelligence teams to translate business questions into scalable reporting solutions. This is an ideal opportunity for a technically strong Workday reporting professional who is equally comfortable working with stakeholders, improving data quality and turning complex workforce data into clear actionable insights.

**What you will do**

* Design, build, test and maintain Workday reports, dashboards, scorecards and data extracts that support People, Finance, executive and board\-level reporting needs.
* Translate stakeholder needs into clear reporting requirements, including metrics definitions, data sources, security considerations, delivery cadence and expected business outcomes.
* Develop advanced Workday reporting solutions using Report Writer, calculated fields, dashboards, composite reports, matrix reports and related Workday capabilities.

* Establish trusted consistent definitions for core workforce metrics such as headcount, attrition, hiring, internal mobility, diversity, organisational structure and talent outcomes.
* Validate report logic and data accuracy, investigate discrepancies and resolve issues through disciplined testing and root\-cause analysis.
* Build and maintain documentation covering reports, metrics, data sources, business logic and operating procedures.
* Partner with Business Intelligence and data teams when advanced analytics, cross\-functional data sets, automation or enterprise\-level insights are required beyond native Workday reporting.
* Identify opportunities to simplify manual reporting, improve self\-service access to data and strengthen the overall People analytics experience.
* Support reporting governance by ensuring appropriate data security, confidentiality, access controls and adherence to applicable privacy requirements.
* Provide guidance and enablement to People team stakeholders on how to interpret and use reports effectively.

  

**Qualifications** **Here's what we're looking for**

* 5\+ years of experience in People Analytics, HRIS, Workforce Analytics or a related analytical role.
* Demonstrated hands\-on experience building and maintaining reports in Workday, including advanced and matrix reports, calculated fields and composite reporting.
* Experience with Workday Dashboards and Discovery Boards, along with Worksheets.
* Strong knowledge of Workday HCM data structures, business processes, security domains and reporting best practice.

Assist with purchase requisitions, purchase orders, invoicing, materials ordering and induction day planning as required.

Two to five years’ experience in recruitment, sourcing, talent acquisition or a related HR coordination role.
  
Tertiary qualification in Human Resources or a related discipline.
  
Experience using applicant tracking systems and recruitment tools, ideally including SuccessFactors.
  
Strong sourcing capability, including LinkedIn Recruiter, Naukri, Boolean search and online talent research.
  
Ability to build and maintain targeted talent pipelines aligned to business hiring priorities.
  
Excellent communication, stakeholder engagement and candidate care skills.
  
Strong attention to detail, data management skills and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
  
Experience supporting recruitment campaigns, assessment centres, interview coordination, due diligence and onboarding activities.
  
Sound understanding of privacy, compliance and accurate document handling requirements within a recruitment environment.

Values led culture
  
Flexible work options
  
Generous annual leave, sick leave and casual leave
  
Cultural and religious leave with flexible public holiday opportunities
  
A competitive remuneration package featuring performance\-based incentives with uncapped Employer Provident Fund
  
  

Woodside is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workforce culture, which is supported by our Values.
  
  

Inclusion centres on all employees creating a climate of trust and belonging, where people feel comfortable to bring their whole self to work. We also offer supportive pathways for all employees to grow and develop leadership skills.

title: maintanance engineer
description:
A Maintenance Engineer for Data logger/ RTU/ PLC and SCADA systems ensures the maximum uptime, reliability, and continuous operation of industrial automation infrastructure. Their core responsibilities include preventive maintenance, troubleshooting hardware and network failures, updating software logic, and performing emergency breakdowns to minimize production or utility downtime.

**Key Responsibilities**

· **Routine Maintenance:** Execute scheduled preventive and predictive maintenance on Data Logger, RTU, PLC panels, SCADA workstations, HMI screens, and industrial networks.

· **Fault Diagnostics:** Troubleshoot system faults, I/O module failures, communication drops, and loop errors under high\-pressure breakdown conditions.

· **Logic Modification:** Perform minor programming changes, logic updates, and backup management for PLC programs and SCADA graphic configurations.

· **Calibration \& Instrumentation:** Verify and maintain field instruments (sensors, transmitters, VFDs, actuators) interfacing with the control system.

· **Network Maintenance:** Monitor and maintain industrial communication links, including Modbus, Profibus, Profinet, and Ethernet/IP networks.

· **Documentation:** Maintain detailed logs of breakdowns, history cards, calibration reports, change management tracking, and inventory of critical spares.

**Essential Qualifications**

· **Education:** Diploma or Bachelor’s Degree in Instrumentation, Electronics, Electrical, or Automation Engineering.

· **Experience:** Fresher / 1 year of hands\-on maintenance experience in Electronics/ PLC \& SCDA

· **PLC/SCADA Expertise:** Working knowledge of major platforms such as Schneider Electric, or Siemens

· **Location/Mobility:** Mumbai Maharashtra

· **Soft Skills:** Strong analytical thinking, swift problem\-solving during plant emergencies, and willingness to work in rotational shifts.

description:
About the Role

We are looking for an **HR Intern** who wants to understand how people and teams actually work inside a growing company.

This is not a role limited to recruitment calls, attendance sheets and routine HR administration. You will work closely with the **core team**, and get a first\-hand view of how hiring decisions are made, how teams evolve, how people issues are handled and how a company's culture is built in practice.

You will be expected to take ownership of your work, ask questions and bring your own thinking to the table.

**What You Will Do**

* Support the complete recruitment process, from sourcing candidates to interview coordination and follow\-ups
* Screen candidates and conduct initial conversations to understand their skills, motivation and fit
* Work with the Founder and team leads to understand hiring requirements and create relevant candidate profiles
* Help improve our hiring and onboarding processes
* Maintain candidate records, recruitment trackers and HR documentation
* Support employee onboarding and help new team members settle into the organisation
* Assist with day\-to\-day HR and people operations
* Work with different teams to understand employee needs and identify areas where HR can improve things
* Assist in employee engagement and internal communication initiatives
* Support performance review and feedback processes
* Work on specific HR projects based on the organisation's current needs
* Observe team dynamics and bring relevant people\-related observations to the Founder/HR team
* Handle sensitive employee and candidate information with confidentiality

What We Are Looking For

* Someone pursuing or recently completed a degree in **HR, Business Administration, Management** or a related field
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal
* Good people skills and the ability to speak comfortably with different kinds of people
* Curiosity about how organisations and people work
* Good attention to detail and follow\-through
* Ability to organise multiple tasks without needing constant supervision
* Comfortable asking questions and expressing an opinion
* Basic understanding of MS Excel/Google Sheets and common office tools
* Prior internship or HR experience is useful, but **not mandatory**

The Kind of Person Who Will Do Well Here

We are less interested in someone who already knows every HR process and more interested in someone who wants to **learn how things work**.

Who Should Apply

This internship is particularly suited for someone who is considering a career in **HR, People Operations, Talent Acquisition or organisational development** and wants practical exposure rather than a purely process\-driven internship.

If you are looking for an internship where you can **learn by being involved in real decisions and real work**, we'd like to hear from you.

description:
**Human Resources Intern** 




 Helping Build the Culture, One Detail at a Time
 



**Who Are We?** 
  
 



 Millipixels Interactive
 
 is where creativity, technology, strategy, and innovation come together to build meaningful digital experiences for clients across 16 countries. We partner with startups, growing businesses, and enterprise brands globally to create immersive digital products and technology solutions.
 





 We’re a team that thrives on ideas, ownership, experimentation, and execution. We like people who take initiative, think beyond the obvious, and bring energy into everything they do.
 




  






 If you’re someone who enjoys building, collaborating, and making a visible impact, you’ll probably enjoy being here.
 




  





**About The Role** 

  
 





 Good culture isn't an accident \- it's built through consistent, well\-run people processes surveys that lead to real action, reports and dashboards that leadership can actually use, events that people look forward to, and an onboarding experience that makes new hires feel at home from day one.
 

  
 





 As the Human Resources Intern, you'll work closely with the Human Resources team to support exactly that. You'll get hands\-on exposure across engagement, dashboards \& reporting, training coordination, and day\-to\-day HR operations, learning what it actually takes to run a people function, not just observe one.
 




  





**You’ll Be The Person Who** 




  




* **Drives Engagement Initiatives:** 

 Assists with engagement surveys and initiatives, helping capture how the team is really feeling.
* **Makes the Numbers Tell a Story:** 

 Helps build and maintain HR reports and dashboards, keeping people's data accurate and current.
* **Coordinates Learning:** 

 Supports the planning and coordination of training sessions, handling logistics and scheduling.
* **Brings People Together:** 

 Helps plan and coordinate HR events and engagement activities, from idea to on\-the\-day execution.
* **Smooths the Onboarding Journey:** 

 Assists with onboarding new hires, so their first few weeks feel organised and welcoming.
* **Keeps the Records Straight:** 

 Handles general HR documentation and maintains employee records, so nothing falls through the cracks.



  





**Is This You?** 




  




* You're proficient in MS Excel/Google Sheets and PowerPoint, and familiar with task tracking tools like ClickUp.
* You communicate clearly — in writing and out loud — and can put together basic content for engagement posts and announcements.
* You're strongly organised, reliable with recurring tasks, and good at juggling multiple priorities at once.
* You have an eye for detail, take data accuracy seriously, and can think analytically to put together reports that make sense.
* You've got some experience with (or genuine interest in) event planning and coordination.
* You're proactive, creative, and enthusiastic, with a collaborative mindset that works well across teams.



  





**Benefits Of Working At Millipixels** 




  




* **Flexible work, your way:** 

 Work where you do your best thinking. We measure outcomes, not hours at a desk.
* **Life admin handled:** 

 Regular expert\-led sessions on finance, tax, and healthcare, so the boring stuff doesn't eat into your weekends.
* **Real mentorship:** 

 Work closely with an experienced HR team that invests in your growth, not just your task list.
* **Hands\-on learning:** 

 Get exposure to real HR projects and processes from day one — not just coffee runs and admin.
* **Room to grow:** 

 Continuous learning and real development in a global team, with space to turn this internship into something more.
* **Ownership, not red tape:** 

 Small team, big trust. Bring the idea, run with it, and watch it ship.

title: Talent Partner-G&A
description:
**Talent Partner, G\&A**
------------------------


**Location:** Bengaluru, India — Hybrid **Department:** People — Talent Acquisition

  

### **About the Role**


You'll lead hiring for Rubrik's G\&A organization in India, and be the talent voice in the room when leaders decide how those teams get built. This is a senior individual\-contributor seat: you'll run the hardest G\&A searches yourself — Finance, Legal, People, IT, Business Operations — while advising VPs on leveling, location, and org shape, and setting the standard the wider Talent Partner team follows.


### **About the Team**


Rubrik's India Talent Acquisition team hires across Engineering, Go\-to\-Market, and G\&A from our Bengaluru site, one of the company's fastest\-growing locations. You'll be among the most senior recruiters here, partnering with functional leaders and their global counterparts, and looked to by peers on how full life\-cycle recruiting should be done.


### **What You'll Do**


* Lead full life\-cycle recruitment for Rubrik's most complex and senior G\&A searches in India — leadership hires and scarce specialist roles alike.
* Advise Senior Manager and above stakeholders on hiring strategy, driving leveling decisions, team composition, and location choices rather than reacting to them.
* Design and run sourcing strategies across channels and modalities without direction, using competitive intelligence to move passive talent who weren't looking.
* Make diverse pipelines structural to every search: build them into intake, involve interview panels in sourcing, and evidence the outcome req by req.
* Bring internal talent and mobility into the conversation with your business partners, treating early\-career and internal\-promotion paths as real options.
* Lead a Talent Acquisition initiative that outlasts a single req — candidate experience, interviewer calibration, reporting, or process improvement — and pull the team into it.
* Set the bar on tools and process: model best practice in the ATS, teach peers, and challenge how we work when there's a better way.

### **What You'll Bring**


* 6\+ years of full life\-cycle recruiting, with several years owning senior and leadership hiring for G\&A or corporate functions.
* A record of independently running complex searches to close across more than one function or business unit.
* Credibility with Senior stakeholders — evidence that your talent recommendations changed a hiring decision, a level, or an org design.
* Fluency with market and competitive intelligence data, and the judgment to forecast a search with reliable accuracy.
* Advanced command of an ATS and sourcing stack, at the level where peers come to you for guidance.
* Persuasive communication under pressure: you can close a senior candidate and reframe a panel's view of a profile in the same week.
* Deep knowledge of the Indian talent market across cities and functions.

### **Bonus Points**


* Building or scaling G\&A hiring at a public or recently public technology company.
* Leading a cross\-functional TA initiative with measurable results.
* Partnering with HR and Finance on headcount and location planning.
  

You'll embody Rubrik's RIVET values — Relentlessness, Integrity, Velocity, Excellence, and Transparency — in how you collaborate, make decisions, and show up for Stakeholders and teammates.


**Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation**
----------------------------------------------------------------------


Rubrik (RBRK), the Security and AI Operations Company, leads at the intersection of data protection, cyber resilience, and enterprise AI acceleration. Rubrik Security Cloud delivers complete cyber resilience by securing, monitoring, and recovering data, identities, and workloads across clouds. Rubrik Agent Cloud accelerates trusted AI agent deployments at scale by monitoring and auditing agentic actions, enforcing real\-time guardrails, fine\-tuning for accuracy and undoing agentic mistakes.

  


**Inclusion @ Rubrik**
----------------------


At Rubrik, we are dedicated to fostering a culture where people from all backgrounds are valued, feel they belong, and believe they can succeed. Our commitment to inclusion is at the heart of our mission to secure the world’s data.


Our goal is to hire and promote the best talent, regardless of background. We continually review our hiring practices to ensure fairness and strive to create an environment where every employee has equal access to opportunities for growth and excellence. We believe in empowering everyone to bring their authentic selves to work and achieve their fullest potential.


### **Our inclusion strategy focuses on three core areas of our business and culture:**

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.


As an organization, we are committed as one firm to our purpose, united through trust as one inclusive, diverse team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.


**INFORMATION ABOUT THE BUSINESS**


Aon is a leading global professional services firm providing a broad range of risk, retirement, and health solutions. Our colleagues provide clients in over 120 countries and sovereignties with advice and solutions that give them the clarity and confidence to make better decisions to protect and grow their business. **GENERAL DESCRIPTION OF ROLE:**


The People Operations function delivers the operational, administrative, and transactional services that enable the People Organization to focus on strategy, advisory, governance, and risk management.
Within People Operations, regional teams provide end‑to‑end operational support across the employee lifecycle, which may include, but is not limited to:* Benefits and rewards operations
* Workforce data and administration
* HR knowledge management and colleague‑facing support (e.g., HR portals, FAQs)


The **Regional Workforce Admin Lead** leads these regional operational teams and will report into the People Operations Leader and partners closely with regional People Organization leaders and specialist teams (e.g., Benefits, People Matters, Talent, Total Rewards). The Regional Workforce Admin Lead is responsible for overseeing and continuously improving regional HR operations across the full employee lifecycle. This role leads teams that perform operational and administrative work to support the Colleague experience, ensuring services are delivered accurately, efficiently, and in line with defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). While the People Organization owns program, policy, and advisory responsibilities, this role ensures that the underlying operations, processes, systems, and data that support those activities are efficient, consistent, accurate, and well‑coordinated. **JOB RESPONSIBILITIES**:  

The colleague is responsible for:
* The Regional Workforce Admin Lead will have a variety of interactions with People Operations, the People Organization, managers, colleagues, and external providers, including:
* 
* **Team Leadership \& People Management:**
	+ Directly manage and develop a team, delivering HR operational services across the employee lifecycle
	+ Plan and manage team capacity, work allocation, and coverage across multiple processes and queues, ensuring support for peak periods, regional time zones, and urgent or sensitive matters
	+ Build a high‑performing, service‑oriented culture focused on accuracy, accountability, and continuous improvement
	+ Set clear objectives, priorities, and development plans for team members in line with regional and global People Operations strategies
* **HR/People Operations Across Employee Lifecycle**:
	+ Oversee delivery of end‑to‑end HR operational processes, such as hiring, job and data changes, benefits and rewards administration, employee relations operations support, and exits/retirements, as applicable in the region
	+ Ensure operational processes are aligned to People Organization policies, local legal/regulatory requirements, and global People Operations standards
	+ Support cyclical HR activities (e.g., performance and compensation cycles, benefits renewals and enrollment, engagement initiatives) from an operational execution and readiness perspective
	+ Ensure that new or evolving HR services can be successfully transitioned into regional People Operations, including defining scope, processes, controls, knowledge content, and success measures
	+ Promote a consistent experience for colleagues and managers across all lifecycle touchpoints and channels
* **Operational Excellence \& Knowledge Management:**
* Design, implement, and maintain KPIs, SLAs, and operating standards that define expectations for quality, timeliness, and colleague experience
* Own and continuously improve SOPs, process maps, and work instructions for regional HR operations, ensuring documentation is accurate, accessible, and regularly reviewed
* Oversee HR operational knowledge bases and colleague‑facing content (e.g., HR portal, FAQs, standard communications) in partnership with the People Organization, ensuring content is current, clear, and operationally feasible
* Monitor performance against KPIs/SLAs; identify trends, root causes, and areas for improvement; and lead remediation and enhancement plans
* Partner with HR Technology, Data \& Analytics, and global People Operations to standardize processes and leverage tools, digitization, and automation where possible
* **Governance, Risk, and Third\-Party Management:**
* Establish and facilitate regular governance forums with People Organization counterparts, People Partners, and other stakeholders to:
	+ Review operational KPIs, SLAs, and service metrics
	+ Discuss trends, risks, and colleague experience feedback
	+ Agree on priorities and roadmap of continuous improvement initiatives
* Ensure appropriate controls, documentation, and audit trails are in place to manage operational risk and support compliance, privacy, and regulatory requirements across HR operations
* Coordinate with Internal Audit, Compliance, and other control functions as needed to prepare for and respond to audits and reviews
* Oversee relationships with third‑party providers supporting People operations in the region, working with Procurement and the People Organization to monitor performance, conduct regular service reviews, resolve escalations, and assess opportunities for improvement or change
* **Stakeholder Management \& Collaboration:**
* Act as the primary People Operations point of contact for regional HR partners, clearly communicating process expectations, timelines, and operational impacts
* Build strong partnerships with People Organization leaders and specialist teams (e.g., Benefits, People Matters, Talent, Total Rewards), People Partners, Employment Law, Compliance, Finance, Payroll, and other key stakeholders
* Represent the regional operational perspective in HR program and policy design discussions, ensuring operational feasibility, scalability, controls, and colleague experience are considered
* Capture and share regional feedback and insights, including operational data and colleague experience themes, to inform global and regional People strategies and decision‑making
* **Continuous Improvement, Change Management, and Service Delivery:**
* Identify and implement processes, technologies, and organizational improvements that enhance service quality, efficiency, and colleague satisfaction
* Lead or support transition and change activities when new work, new processes, or new tools are introduced into People Operations (including operational readiness planning, UAT, training, and cutover support)
* Encourage a culture where colleagues challenge the status quo, propose ideas, and use data and feedback to drive improvements
* Oversee service recovery for escalated issues or service failures, ensuring root causes are addressed and learnings are embedded into processes and controls

 **SKILLS/COMPETENCIES REQUIRED** :  

* Varied experience in HR operations/People Operations or a related shared services environment, preferably with regional or multi country scope
* Demonstrated experience leading operational teams across multiple HR process areas and through periods of change or growth
* Proven ability to design and manage SLAs, KPIs, and SOPs, and to use data and metrics to drive performance and decision making
* Experience working with HR systems, case management, and workflow tools, and comfort with introducing and embedding new technologies and processes.
* Strong people leadership skills, including coaching, performance management, and building high performing teams.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate across geographies, cultures, and functions.
* Strong process and continuous improvement mindset, with a track record of simplifying, standardizing, and automating processes.
* High level of attention to detail, data accuracy, and governance, with the ability to manage confidential and sensitive information appropriately.

**HOW WE SUPPORT OUR COLLEAGUES**
In addition to our comprehensive benefits package, we are proud to be an equal opportunity workforce. At Aon, we believe a diverse workforce is an innovative workforce. Our agile, inclusive environment allows colleagues to manage their wellbeing and work/life balance while empowering you to be your authentic self.


Furthermore, all colleagues enjoy two “Global Wellbeing Days” each year, encouraging them to take time to focus on themselves. We offer a variety of workstyle options through our Smart Working model, but we also recognize that flexibility goes beyond just the place of work... and we are all for it!


Our continuous learning culture inspires and equips colleagues to learn, share and grow, helping them achieve their fullest potential. As a result, Aon colleagues are more connected, more relevant, and more valued.

title: HR Associate
description:
**Position Overview:**



Anaqua is looking for an HR Associate to support our India\-based workforce and partner closely with our global HR team. Reporting to the Sr. HR Regional Director in the U.S., this role is the day\-to\-day HR point of contact for employees in India — handling everything from statutory compliance and HRIS data to exit interview tracking and employee handbook maintenance. You'll work across time zones as part of a small, tight\-knit regional HR function, with real involvement over the processes you run and regular visibility into cross\-regional reporting and projects.

 **You'll Love This Job if You Like To:**


* Prepare recurring HR reports and dashboards for other departments and executives (headcount, attrition, leave utilization, and similar workforce metrics)
* Assist with periodic reviews and updates to the Employee Handbook, as requested
* Assist with managing onboarding and offboarding for India\-based employees, including documentation, background verification, and exit formalities
* Maintain accurate, up\-to\-date employee records in the HRIS
* Support statutory compliance activities
* Respond to employee questions on policies, benefits, and HR procedures
* Assist with recruitment coordination — scheduling interviews, preparing offer letters, and tracking background checks
* Support employee engagement and culture initiatives for the India team
* Conduct internal audits to check HR process compliance and consistency
* Partner with the Sr. HR Regional Director on ad hoc regional and global HR projects
* Maintain a high level of confidentiality when handling sensitive employee information
* Assist with any visa letters required for business travel

  


**What You'll Need to Be Successful:**


* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field; or equivalent experience
* 2–4 years of progressive HR generalist or HR associate experience, ideally within a multinational or technology company
* Working knowledge of Indian labor law and statutory compliance requirements (PF, ESI, Gratuity, POSH, Shops \& Establishment Act)
* Experience with an HRIS platform (e.g., BambooHR, ADP, Workday, or similar)
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to partner directly with a U.S.\-based manager and stakeholders across time zones
* High level of discretion, professionalism, and sound judgment with confidential information
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail
* Proficiency in MS Office particularly Excel for reporting is a requirement
* Ability to work independently, prioritize competing demands, and manage time well in a remote\-reporting structure
* Experience in the use of AI would be beneficial

  


**About Anaqua**



Anaqua, Inc. is a premium provider of integrated intellectual property (IP) management technology solutions and services. Anaqua's AQX platform combines best practice workflows with big data analytics and tech\-enabled services to create an intelligent environment designed to inform IP strategy, enable IP decision\-making, and streamline IP operations. Today, nearly half of the top 100 U.S. patent filers and global brands, as well as a growing number of law firms worldwide use Anaqua's solutions. Over one million IP executives, attorneys, paralegals, administrators, and innovators in large and medium\-sized companies use the platform for their IP management needs. The company's global operations are headquartered in Boston, with offices across the U.S., Europe, Asia, and Australia. For additional information, please visit anaqua.com, or on LinkedIn.

* Use strong analytical skills to translate complex data into insights and compelling narratives that influence decision\-making and drive strategy.
* Identify opportunities to streamline \& simplify processes, reduce manual effort, and enhance user experience through automation, technology and digital tools.
* Ensure compliance with labor laws, pay equity \& transparency legislations, tax regulations, and corporate governance policies.
* Support the development and implementation of SOPs, knowledge bases, and training materials different audiences like (HR) business partners, Talent Acquisition, Tier 2 and Tier 3\.

**Skills:**

* Strong understanding of job architecture, market pricing, salary structures, incentive plan design, and equity compensation.
* Exceptional analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, generate insights, and tell compelling, data\-driven stories.
* Experience with compensation tools (e.g., Workday, Radford, Mercer, WTW, MarketPay) and data visualization platforms (e.g., Visier, Tableau, Power BI) is a plus.
* Demonstrated ability to influence and collaborate effectively across HR, Finance, and business leadership.

Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains on the cutting\-edge of innovation, using technology and human genetic data to push beyond what’s known today.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

**Role Description**


The Senior Associate, Benefits supports the administration, compliance, and day\-to\-day operations of employee benefits programs for the assigned JAPAC region. This role is responsible for ensuring accurate plan administration, a seamless employee experience, strong vendor performance, and adherence to local statutory and regulatory requirements. The position partners closely with HR, Payroll, Finance, Legal, vendors, brokers, and external advisors to deliver high\-quality benefits services and drive operational excellence across regional benefit offerings.

**Roles \& Responsibilities**

**Benefit Administration \& Operations**


Oversee day\-to\-day administration of benefit plans including health, dental, life insurance, disability, retirement/pension plans, wellness programs, statutory benefits, and region\-specific employee benefit programs. Serve as a primary point of contact for employees, managers, and HR partners regarding benefit enquiries, eligibility requirements, enrolments, life events, and issue resolution. Manage benefit enrolments, dependent updates, life\-event changes, leaves of absence, and terminations while ensuring timely and accurate updates in HR systems and vendor platforms. Partner with Payroll teams to support benefit deductions, taxable benefit processing, reconciliation activities, and issue resolution. Maintain accurate employee benefits records and ensure data integrity across internal systems and third\-party administrator platforms. Support employee onboarding and offboarding activities related to benefits administration.

**Vendor \& Partner Management**


Partner with benefit providers, insurers, pension administrators, wellness vendors, brokers, and third\-party administrators to resolve operational issues and ensure effective service delivery. Monitor vendor performance against service level agreements (SLAs) and escalate issues as appropriate. Review and validate eligibility files, vendor reports, invoices, and benefit\-related data to ensure accuracy and completeness. Support annual plan renewals, vendor transitions, implementation of new programs, and operational enhancements. Coordinate with internal stakeholders and external vendors to ensure timely resolution of employee and operational issues.

**Compliance \& Governance**


Ensure benefits programs are administered in accordance with local statutory, tax, regulatory, and data privacy requirements. Maintain audit\-ready documentation including policies, standard operating procedures (SOPs), process documentation, and benefits records. Support internal and external audits by providing accurate documentation, reports, and supporting evidence. Ensure adherence to established controls, governance standards, and operational procedures. Identify and escalate potential compliance risks and support remediation efforts as needed.

**Employee Experience \& Communication**


Support the development and delivery of employee benefit communications, enrolment materials, employee guides, Knowledge Articles, FAQs, and intranet content. Facilitate benefit\-related onboarding and offboarding communications and employee education initiatives. Partner with HR stakeholders to improve employee understanding and awareness of available benefits programs. Support resolution of complex employee benefit inquiries while maintaining a high level of customer service. Identify opportunities to enhance employee experience and simplify benefit processes.

**Projects \& Continuous Improvement**


Contribute to annual Open Enrollment planning, execution, and post\-enrolment activities. Support benefits\-related projects including process improvements, vendor implementations, operational transitions, and technology enhancements. Analyze operational trends, employee inquiries, and vendor performance metrics to identify process improvement opportunities. Participate in initiatives focused on service delivery excellence, process standardization, and operational efficiency. Support knowledge management activities including updates to procedures, training materials, and operational documentation.

**Basic Qualifications and Experience**


Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, Commerce, or a related discipline. 4\-7 years of overall experience in with at least 3 years in Benefits Administration, Benefits Operations, Total Rewards Operations, HR Shared Services, or Employee Benefits Consulting. Experience supporting regional or multinational employee benefits programs in a global organization. Strong understanding of employee benefits administration, statutory frameworks, and tax considerations. Experience working with HRIS platforms such as Workday and case management tools such as ServiceNow. Experience partnering with global vendors, insurers, brokers, third\-party administrators, and cross\-functional stakeholders. Experience supporting Open Enrollment, plan renewals, benefits implementations, or vendor transitions. title: Data Platform Consultant (DBT)
description:
### **Description**

  

**The headlines...**  

  

**Immediate Joiners Preferred**  

**Location** \- Hybrid in our central Pune office  

  

**A few application tips…**  

  

We want to help you put your best foot forward. Here are a few things we look for:* Clear, specific examples of your work and impact
* Relevant experience aligned with the role’s focus
* A thoughtful response to any application questions
* A resume that highlights both what you did and why it mattered

If you’re unsure whether your background is the “perfect fit,” we still encourage you to apply. We value potential and growth just as much as experience.  

  

**Why this role exists…**  

This role is designed to strengthen our delivery capability across our most strategic accounts in industries like Consumer Goods, Financial Services and Energy.  

As the demand for data and AI\-driven transformation grows, so does the need for structured, proactive project leadership. At Snap Analytics, we help clients unlock the full potential of their data, and we’re scaling fast**.**  

  

We’re building DBT capability on a project. As a small, agile organisation, we’re investing in people who can help us deliver quickly and grow our competency in India with support from UK colleagues. You’ll have clear impact from day one and room to move across projects as you develop.### **What you’ll be doing…**

  

You’ll play a central role in designing and delivering data transformations that power a high‑visibility project. You’ll work closely with project leads, project managers, and senior engineers to ship quality outcomes with increasing autonomy.  

  

**Your responsibilities will include:**
* **Data Modelling:** Design, develop, and maintain complex data models using dbt Core to support various business functions.
* **Pipeline Optimization:** Build and manage scalable data transformation pipelines within Snowflake, ensuring high performance and cost\-efficiency.
* **Code Quality:** Implement software engineering best practices in the data stack, including version control (Git), modularity, and CI/CD.
* **Testing \& Documentation:** Ensure data integrity by writing robust dbt tests and maintaining comprehensive documentation via dbt docs.
* **Performance Tuning:** Optimize Snowflake compute and storage by managing clustering keys, materialized views, and efficient SQL querying.
* **Stakeholder Collaboration:** Work closely with Data Analysts and Business Leads to translate business requirements into technical data schemas.

**In your first 3–6 months, success might look like:*** Delivering the majority of your assigned work independently, to a high standard (quality \+ on‑time)
* Demonstrating holistic project understanding \- how your work fits the wider data flow and business goals
* Building healthy working relationships across the India team and, over time, with UK stakeholders

  

### **What you’ll need to succeed…**

  

We’re looking for someone who brings a mix of experience, curiosity, and collaboration.  

  

**You might be a great fit if you have:**
* **2 years’ experience** in dbt Core, including macros, packages (like dbt\-utils), and Jinja templating (we’re not considering freshers for this role)
* Strong **SQL** fundamentals and practical exposure to **DBT**
* Deep understanding of Snowflake\-specific features such as Tasks, Streams, Snowpipe, and Zero\-copy cloning.
* Familiarity with **Git/Bitbucket** and awareness of **CI/CD** concepts (nice to have)
* **Clear communication \-** you can articulate your thinking to technical and non‑technical partners
* **A** **learning mindset**: proactive, curious, and willing to work “a notch above” expectations (automation, generalising code, improving process)
* **Transparency** and ownership \- comfortable asking for help early and taking accountability for outcomes

**This role might not be the right fit if you’re looking for:*** Highly siloed work with very narrow task scopes (we value holistic project thinking)
* Constant step‑by‑step guidance (we expect growing autonomy and initiative)

  

### **Why choose Snap**

  

* **Impact from day one** on a new, high‑visibility project
* **Growth in a small, agile company** with opportunities to rotate across projects as you develop
* **Supportive team culture \-** mentorship from seniors, collaboration with India \& UK colleagues, open feedback and help‑seeking encouraged

### **About Snap Analytics**


We're a high\-growth data analytics consultancy on a mission to help enterprise businesses unlock the full potential of their data. With offices in the UK, India, and South Africa, we specialise in cutting\-edge cloud analytics solutions, transforming complex data challenges into actionable business insights.  

  

We partner with some of the biggest brands worldwide to modernise their data platforms, enabling smarter decision\-making through Snowflake, Databricks, Matillion, and other cloud technologies. Our approach is customer\-first, innovation\-driven, and results\-focused, delivering impactful solutions with speed and precision.  

  

At Snap, we’re not just consultants, we’re problem\-solvers, engineers, and strategists who thrive on tackling complex data challenges. Our culture is built on collaboration, continuous learning, and pushing boundaries, ensuring our people grow just as fast as our business.  

  

Join us and be part of a team that’s shaping the future of data analytics!

title: Junior Civil Engineer- Product listing BajriX
description:
Junior Civil Engineer – Product Catalog \& Seller Onboarding

Company: BajriX Private LimitedLocation: Jaipur, RajasthanJob Type: Part\-timeExperience: 0–2 YearsQualification: Diploma / B.Tech / B.E. in Civil Engineering or related fieldLaptop Requirement: Candidate must have their own laptop

About BajriX

BajriX is a technology\-enabled platform focused on simplifying the construction and home\-building ecosystem. We help buyers discover building materials, suppliers, and service professionals while enabling local sellers to take their businesses digital.

We are looking for a Junior Civil Engineer – Product Catalog \& Seller Onboarding who can support our seller onboarding and catalog operations team by understanding construction products, researching product information, and creating accurate and structured product listings.

Role Overview

This is primarily an office\-based product catalog and operations role, not a site\-engineering role.

The ideal candidate should have a basic understanding of construction and building materials and should be comfortable with product research, Excel/data entry, internet research, and communicating with sellers and our sales team.

You will convert seller\-provided information such as catalogues, price lists, product photos, WhatsApp messages, brochures, and handwritten lists into accurate and structured product listings on BajriX.

Key Responsibilities

* Support the Sales and Seller Onboarding team in creating product listings for newly onboarded sellers.
* Understand and classify construction products into the correct BajriX categories.
* Research product information using manufacturer websites, official catalogues, brochures, and other reliable sources.
* Identify the correct brand, product name, model, variant, SKU or product family.
* Capture important product attributes such as size, thickness, grade, finish, material, packaging, application, unit, model number, etc.
* Convert unstructured seller information into standardized and structured product data.
* Review seller\-provided product names and descriptions and correct inconsistencies.
* Coordinate with sellers or the onboarding team when important product information is missing.
* Upload and maintain product details, images, specifications, pricing, MOQ, stock information, and other listing data.
* Ensure that duplicate or incorrect products are not created.
* Perform quality checks before product listings are approved or published.
* Maintain product/catalog data in Excel, Google Sheets, and internal BajriX systems.
* Help improve and expand BajriX’s master construction\-product catalogue.

Product Categories You May Work With

Cement, TMT Steel, Sand, Aggregate, Bricks, AAC Blocks, Tiles, Marble \& Granite, Plywood, Laminates, Hardware, Paints, Waterproofing, Plumbing, Sanitaryware, Electricals, Roofing, Doors \& Windows, Furniture Fittings, Construction Chemicals and other building materials.

Required Skills

* Basic understanding of construction materials and terminology.
* Strong internet and product research skills.
* Good attention to detail and accuracy.
* Comfortable working with Excel / Google Sheets.
* Ability to understand technical specifications and product catalogues.
* Good computer and data\-entry skills.
* Ability to differentiate between similar construction products and variants.
* Good Hindi communication skills.
* Basic written English.
* Willingness to learn new product categories.
* Ability to work closely with sales and operations teams.
* Must have a personal laptop and be comfortable using it for day\-to\-day work.

Preferred Candidate

We would particularly like to hear from candidates who:

* Have completed or are pursuing Diploma/B.Tech/B.E. in Civil Engineering.
* Are freshers, students, or have up to 2 years of experience.
* Have worked with a construction\-material supplier, dealer, distributor, contractor, or builder.
* Have exposure to procurement, estimation, billing, BOQ, construction materials, or site work.
* Have knowledge of brands and products commonly used in the Jaipur/Rajasthan construction market.
* Enjoy research and working with structured data.

Important

This position is not primarily a site supervision role.

It is a part\-time role suited for someone who understands construction products and is interested in working in technology, catalog operations, research, and the digital construction ecosystem.

Having your own laptop is mandatory for this role.

Why Join BajriX?

You will get exposure to hundreds of construction\-product categories, brands, suppliers, and real\-world market data while working closely with the sales, product, technology, and founding teams.

You will contribute directly to building one of the most important parts of BajriX — its structured construction\-product catalogue.

If you understand construction materials, enjoy research, and are comfortable working with data and technology, we would love to hear from you.

Pay: ₹8,000\.00 \- ₹15,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Work from home

**Location: Gurgaon** 




  





**About Us** 




 39k Group is a high\-frequency trading firm operating globally across centralized crypto exchanges. We specialize in ultra\-low\-latency strategies and market making, scaling infrastructure to handle billions of events daily with microsecond\-level performance.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We’re hiring a Analyst \- Trading to design and drive trading strategies that sit at the heart of our business. You’ll work at the intersection of markets, quantitative research, and technology — generating ideas, testing them in simulation, and bringing them to live execution with the support of developers and researchers.

**What You’ll Do** 



* Generate trading hypotheses across spot, perpetuals, and futures markets.
* Develop, backtest, and refine alpha signals and strategy logic using large\-scale tick and order book data.
* Collaborate with quantitative developers to bring strategies into ultra\-low\-latency production environments.
* Monitor strategy performance and adapt parameters in real time based on market conditions.
* Analyze execution quality, slippage, and queue positioning to optimize fills and PnL.
* Stay ahead of market microstructure changes, exchange mechanics, and competitive landscape.



  





**Who Are You** 




  





**Must Have** 




  




* 1–2 years of experience in a trading, quant research, or systematic strategy role.
* Strong grasp of probability, statistics, and time\-series analysis.
* Comfort working with tick\-level data and large datasets.
* Familiarity with market microstructure, order books, and execution mechanics.
* Hands\-on experience with at least two of: Python, C\+\+, or Rust.
* High attention to detail, with a systems\-driven and outcome\-focused mindset.



  





**Bonus points for:** 



* Prior exposure to high\-frequency or market making strategies.
* Experience trading crypto or FX markets.
* Ability to formulate strategies under real\-time constraints.
* Cross\-functional ability to communicate with developers on latency, execution, and system constraints.



  





**Why Join Us?** 



* Run live strategies with direct impact on firm PnL.
* Collaborate closely with world\-class quants and developers in a fast\-moving environment.
* Access global markets with cutting\-edge low\-latency infrastructure.
* Hybrid flexibility, high ownership, and exposure to every layer of trading — from signal to execution.



  





 If you thrive in fast markets, love testing ideas, and want your strategies to shape live trading, we’d love to hear from you.

As part of AWAT Technology Operations, you'll play a key role in supporting critical Advisory, Wealth and Asset Management platforms while driving the next generation of Site Reliability Engineering practices. As a Support Engineer, you will be part of a collaborative production support team focused on keeping critical applications and platforms stable and highly available, resilient, and ready to support business growth. You will apply your technical expertise to solve complex operational challenges, strengthen system reliability, and improve the experience of both internal and external business partners. With a strong focus on automation, observability, and continuous improvement, you will help shape a more proactive, scalable SRE support model. If you are energized by ownership, modern support practices, incident management, and building smarter tools that make a real difference, this is a great opportunity to grow your career with Schwab.
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
* 3–5 years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, Production Support, DevOps, or Systems Engineering supporting highly available, client\-facing enterprise applications.
* Understanding of SRE principles, including reliability, scalability, resiliency, observability, automation, toil reduction, and operational excellence.
* Hands\-on experience with incident management, problem management, change management, root cause analysis, post\-incident reviews, and continuous service improvement practices.
* Experience defining, measuring, and improving SLIs, SLOs, SLAs, KPIs, availability, performance, and reliability metrics for production systems.
* Working knowledge of observability and monitoring platforms such as Splunk, Datadog, Grafana Cloud, OpenTelemetry, ThousandEyes, or similar tools, including dashboards, alerting, logs, metrics, and traces.

* Familiar with CI/CD and engineering collaboration tools such as GitHub, Bitbucket, Bamboo, Atlassian products
* Experience supporting applications hosted on cloud or platform environments such as PCF, AWS, GCP, Azure, Kubernetes, or container\-based platforms.
* Familiar with relational and non\-relational databases such as SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or similar technologies, including query execution, scripting, and production support.
* Strong troubleshooting skills across applications, infrastructure, integrations, end\-user workflows, and distributed systems, with the ability to diagnose complex production issues.
* Understanding of incident life cycle and strong background in incident and problem manage
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain technical issues, risks, workarounds, and resolution plans to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to participate in rotational on\-call support, respond to production incidents, and drive timely restoration of service while maintaining clear stakeholder communication.
* Experience working in a regulated enterprise environment, preferably financial services, with a focus on secure, compliant, and reliable technology operations.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience supporting Asset Management, Wealth Management, or Financial Services platforms, with knowledge of the trade lifecycle, investment operations, and front\-to\-back office workflows.

* Real\-world DevSecOps experience.
* Exposure to production\-grade security workflows.
* Direct collaboration with engineering and DevOps teams.
* Ownership of security processes that actually matter.
* Strong foundation for roles in Application Security/DevSecOps.

title: Security Engineer II (Offensive)
description:
**Are you ready to trade your job for a journey? Become a FlyMate!**
  

  

  

 Passion, excitement \& global collaboration are all core to what it means to be a FlyMate. At Flywire, we’re on a mission to deliver the world’s most important and complex payments. We use our Flywire Advantage \- the combination of our next\-gen payments platform, proprietary payment network and vertical specific software, to help our clients get paid, and help their customers pay with ease \- no matter where they are in the world.
   

  





 What more do we need to truly be unstoppable? Perhaps, that is you!
   

  





**Who we are:**




 Flywire is a global payments enablement and software company, founded more than a decade ago to solve high\-stakes, high\-value payments. We’ve scaled into new regions and industry verticals and expanded our product offerings to deliver meaningful value to our clients around the world.
   

  





 Today we support more than 5,300 clients across the global education, healthcare, travel \& B2B industries, with diverse payment methods across 240 countries \& territories and more than 140 currencies.
   

  





 With over 1,400\+ global FlyMates, representing more than 40 nationalities, and in 15 offices world\-wide, we’re looking for FlyMates to join the next stage of our journey as we continue to grow.
   

  





  

  

  

  




**Job Description**

**Job Summary:**




 As a
 **Security Engineer II** 
 on the Active Operational Defender track you will build hands on experience across penetration testing, threat detection and incident response, working under the direction of senior and lead engineers. You will support live operational work within a high velocity fintech environment, developing the manual testing and detection engineering skills needed to take on more independent responsibility over time.
   

  





**Responsibilities and Tasks:**




**1\. Offensive Penetration Testing \& Red Teaming**



* Support penetration testing engagements across financial platforms and product architectures under senior guidance, building practical exploit research experience.
* Assist with manual security reviews including source code audits, API testing and cloud configuration checks, working towards independent delivery of smaller engagements.
* Contribute to adversarial testing of AI features where in scope, learning to identify prompt injection and related LLM specific weaknesses.



**2\. Threat Detection Engineering \& SIEM**



* Help design and tune detection rules and alert workflows within the enterprise SIEM, working from senior engineers' guidance and established detection frameworks.
* Support SecOps in reviewing detection coverage against current threats, referencing frameworks such as MITRE ATT\&CK.



**3\. Incident Response \& Forensics**



* Act as a first line responder during active security incidents, carrying out evidence collection and initial triage under senior direction.
* Support post incident analysis by pulling together logs, timelines and technical findings for senior review.



**4\. Cross Functional Collaboration \& Development**



* Take part in security operations and engineering planning to build a practical understanding of detection and response capability.
* Communicate findings from testing and incidents clearly to immediate team members and stakeholders.
* Actively seek mentorship from senior and lead security engineers on offensive tooling, detection engineering and incident response practice.


**Qualifications**
* **Education:** 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, Software Engineering or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* **Core Experience:** 
 indicative range
 **\[1 to 3 years]** 
 of hands on experience in penetration testing, security operations or a closely related technical role.
* **Foundational Offensive Skills:** 
 exposure to manual web application testing, CTF style exploitation or vulnerability research, gained through work experience, personal projects or study.
* **SecOps \& Forensics Familiarity:** 
 basic working knowledge of SIEM concepts, EDR tooling or network packet analysis, and an interest in frameworks such as MITRE ATT\&CK.
* **Technical Language Foundation:** 
 comfort reading and, ideally, writing scripts in a language such as Python to support testing and automation.
* **AI Security Awareness:** 
 a working interest in the OWASP Top 10 for LLMs and how adversarial testing of AI features differs from traditional application testing.
* **Regulatory Awareness** 
 : a general understanding of standards such as PCI\-DSS, SOC 2 or DORA, with willingness to build practical depth on the job.
   

  

  

  

**Highly Preferred Certifications**
* Hands\-On Offensive \& Red Team: OSCP, OSCE or SANS GXPN (GIAC Exploit Researcher and Advanced Penetration Tester).
* Incident Response \& Defence: GCIH (GIAC Certified Incident Handler), GCFA (GIAC Certified Forensic Analyst) or a specialised Blue Team certification.
   

  

  

  

**Skills and Abilities**
* Combines an aggressive, attacker's mindset used to find vulnerabilities with the analytical discipline required to write clear, actionable detection rules.
* Stays calm and analytically clear under intense pressure during active, live breach events or business critical system failures.
* Communicates exploit chains and log anomalies clearly, turning technical detail into a plain, high impact risk profile for non\-technical leadership.
* Resilience and analytical clarity in high\-pressure scenarios, supporting transparent communication and contributing to risk\-based decisions during active security incidents or compressed financial product launch windows.
* Balances technical risk reduction with business enablement, supporting security infrastructure that serves as a competitive advantage and helps unblock global revenue and enterprise\-client acquisition.
* Modern AI Security: OffSec OSAI (Offensive Security AI Red Teamer).


**Additional Information**

**What We Offer:**



* Competitive compensation
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)
* Competitive time off, including Digital Disconnect and FlyBetter Days to volunteer in a cause you believe in.
* Flying Start \- Our immersive Global Induction Program (Meet our Execs \& Global Teams)
* Work with brilliant people globally Learn more about their journeys by checking out \#InsideFlywire on social media
* Wellbeing Programs (Mental Health, Wellness, Yoga/Pilates/HIIT Classes) with Global FlyMates
* Be a meaningful part in our success \- every FlyMate makes an impact
* Great Talent \& Development Programs (Managers Taking Flight – for new or aspiring managers, OneFlywire Career Mobility)



**Submit today and get started!**




 We are excited to get to know you! Throughout our process you can expect to meet with different FlyMates including the Hiring Manager, Peers on the team, the VP of the department, and a skills assessment. Your Talent Acquisition Partner will walk you through the steps and be your “go\-to” person for any questions.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

* Prepare detailed **2D architectural drawings using AutoCAD**.
* Prepare floor plans, elevations, sections, site plans, and construction details.
* Develop working drawings based on architectural designs and specifications.
* Prepare and modify drawings according to project requirements and site conditions.
* Prepare accurate dimensions, annotations, levels, and schedules.

* Good communication and coordination skills.

* **Revit/SketchUp/BIM knowledge** will be an added advantage.

Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.  

We are proud to be consistently ranked among India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an Employer of Choice is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.
If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, Blue Dart is where you belong. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.  

  

  

Position Overview:
The Territory Service Representative (TSR) – Operations is responsible for the timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within an assigned territory while delivering a superior customer experience and representing the Blue Dart brand with professionalism.
Operating as the face of Blue Dart on the ground, the role ensures safe handling of shipments, timely collections and deliveries, accurate shipment scanning, COD collections, proof of delivery (POD) compliance and adherence to operational procedures. The TSR works closely with the Shift In\-charge and branch operations team to ensure service commitments are consistently achieved while maintaining the highest standards of safety, customer service and operational discipline.  

Job Purpose:
To execute timely pickup and delivery of shipments, ensure accurate shipment handling, customer interactions and COD collections while adhering to Blue Dart's operational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.  

Key Roles \& Responsibilities:
Pickup \& Delivery Operations* Perform timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within the assigned route or territory.

* Report discrepancies immediately.

  

Operational Compliance* Scan shipments accurately using handheld devices or approved digital platforms.
* Ensure shipment status updates are completed in real time.
* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) during pickup and delivery activities.
* Adhere to company policies relating to shipment handling, documentation and customer interaction.
* Support operational requirements during peak business periods.

  

Safety \& Security* Follow all road safety guidelines while operating company or personal vehicles.
* Ensure safe handling and security of customer shipments throughout transit.
* Wear the prescribed company uniform and personal protective equipment wherever applicable.
* Report accidents, incidents or unsafe conditions immediately.
* Protect company assets and customer property.

  

Vehicle \& Asset Responsibility* Maintain the assigned vehicle or personal two\-wheeler in roadworthy condition.
* Ensure all statutory vehicle documents remain valid.
* Maintain cleanliness and basic upkeep of the vehicle.
* Report maintenance requirements promptly.

  

Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation* Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

  

Team Collaboration* Work closely with Shift In\-charges and branch operations teams.
* Support colleagues during operational contingencies.
* Participate in operational briefings and safety meetings.
* Contribute towards achieving branch productivity and service goals.

  

Qualifications \& Experience:
Education:* Minimum 10th Standard Pass.

Experience:* Fresher or up to 2 years of relevant experience in courier, logistics, distribution, retail delivery or field operations.

Eligibility Requirements:* Minimum age 18 years.

* Mobile Device / Scanner Usage

Key Competencies:* Customer Focus

Key Performance Indicators:

title: HR Assistant

* Employee referrals
* Recruitment databases
* Social media

* Coordinate interviews with candidates and department heads.
* Maintain recruitment trackers.
* Follow up with candidates regarding interview status.

Job Overview

Maskoid Technologies is looking for a **multi\-skilled IT Network \& Hardware Administrator** to manage and maintain the company's complete IT infrastructure.

The role involves **office IT support, hardware troubleshooting, system and network administration, server management, website hosting and deployment, DNS/SSL management, WordPress administration, backups, security, monitoring, and basic Python automation**.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable handling day\-to\-day employee IT issues as well as independently managing servers, networks, hosting environments, website deployments, and infrastructure\-related tasks.

Roles \& Responsibilities1\. Office IT Support \& Hardware

* Troubleshoot employee IT issues including system slowness, keyboard/mouse, monitor, audio, and peripheral issues.
* Install and configure operating systems, office applications, security tools, and required software.
* Maintain desktops, laptops, printers, scanners, and other IT peripherals.
* Ensure all office IT systems are operational, secure, and properly maintained.
* Maintain inventory and stock of IT accessories, spare hardware, and components.

2\. System \& Network Administration

* Install, configure, and maintain **Windows and Linux servers**.
* Manage **Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policies, and user accounts**.
* Configure and troubleshoot routers, switches, firewalls, Wi\-Fi access points, and NAS devices.
* Troubleshoot LAN, Wi\-Fi, Internet, and connectivity\-related issues.
* Perform OS updates, security patches, driver installations, and firmware upgrades.
* Manage basic firewall and VPN configurations.

3\. Website Hosting, Deployment \& Server Management

* Deploy websites on **cPanel, Plesk, VPS, and cloud hosting environments**.
* Manage DNS records including **A, CNAME, MX, TXT, SPF, DKIM, and SRV**.
* Perform website and server migrations.
* Install, renew, and troubleshoot SSL certificates.
* Troubleshoot server and hosting issues such as:
* High CPU/RAM usage
* HTTP 500/503 errors
* Database errors
* Email delivery issues
* Maintain backups of hosting accounts, databases, and website files.
* Monitor website uptime and server performance.

4\. WordPress Website Management

* Install and configure WordPress on hosting environments.
* Manage WordPress themes, plugins, and updates.
* Troubleshoot basic WordPress issues including plugin conflicts, theme issues, and database connection errors.
* Perform WordPress website backup and restoration.
* Perform basic performance optimization including caching, image optimization, and plugin cleanup.
* Handle basic page edits, content updates, and layout changes when required.

5\. System Monitoring \& Performance

* Perform daily server and system health checks.
* Monitor server load, storage, memory, and network performance.
* Ensure high uptime and reliability of internal systems and services.
* Identify performance bottlenecks and take corrective action.
* Implement and maintain monitoring and alerting systems.

6\. Backup, Security \& Compliance

* Manage daily and weekly backups of systems, servers, databases, and critical data.
* Perform periodic restoration tests to verify backup integrity.
* Manage endpoint protection, antivirus, and IT security controls.
* Manage access controls and password management systems.
* Follow and maintain IT security and operational standards.

7\. Domain, SSL \& IT Documentation

* Manage domain purchases, renewals, transfers, and DNS updates.
* Manage SSL installation, renewal, and troubleshooting.
* Maintain IT documentation, including:
* SOPs
* Network diagrams
* DNS documentation
* Server and hosting documentation
* IT asset information
* Access and configuration records

8\. Vendor \& Service Provider Coordination

* Coordinate with hosting providers, cloud vendors, IT suppliers, and service providers.
* Manage AMC agreements, warranty claims, and technical support escalations.
* Coordinate software and service renewals.
* Track licenses, subscriptions, and related IT services.

9\. Automation \& Python Scripting

* Develop basic Python scripts to automate repetitive IT tasks.
* Automate tasks such as system checks, log monitoring, and backup validation.
* Create simple automation tools for deployment, reporting, and monitoring.
* Maintain and improve existing IT automation scripts.

Required Technical Skills

Candidates should have practical knowledge of:

* Desktop and laptop troubleshooting
* Windows and Linux server administration
* Network configuration and troubleshooting
* Routing and subnetting fundamentals
* Firewall and VPN configuration
* Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and Group Policy
* Routers, switches, Wi\-Fi access points, and NAS

Soft Skills

* Ability to independently diagnose and resolve technical issues
* Ability to manage multiple IT tasks simultaneously
* Good communication and coordination skills
* Strong documentation skills
* Proactive and responsible approach to IT operations
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced office environment
* Willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies

Experience
