description:
**About Dreamfoot** 





 Dreamfoot is a premier corporate video production and 3D industrial animation studio based in Vadodara, Gujarat. We specialize in producing high\-impact corporate brand films, 3D technical animations, industrial process explainers, and comprehensive safety training films for leading engineering, manufacturing, and infrastructure enterprises.
 




**Role Overview** 





 We're looking for a Technical Content Writer who can research, understand, and explain complex industrial and engineering subject matter through clear, credible, long\-form writing. This is primarily a content writing role — you'll spend most of your time producing technically grounded blogs, case studies, whitepapers, and website content that build trust and establish authority with plant heads, safety VPs, and engineering leaders. A smaller part of the role involves writing narrative AV scripts for our corporate brand films, process videos, and safety training videos.
 




***This is not a copywriting role. We are not looking for persuasive, sales\-driven, conversion\-focused writing (ad copy, landing pages, CTA\-heavy campaigns). We want someone who educates and informs, not someone who sells.***




**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Technical \& B2B Content Writing — Primary Mandate (80%)** 




 •     
 **Technical Content Development:** 

 Research and write in\-depth, technically accurate long\-form content — blog posts, engineering explainers, whitepapers, and detailed guides — that build trust and establish Dreamfoot's (and our clients') technical authority.
 




 •     
 **Case Studies \& Project Stories:** 

 Turn completed video and animation projects into detailed, technically grounded case studies and client success stories for the website and LinkedIn.
 




 •     
 **Client \& SME Discovery:** 

 Participate in discovery sessions with engineers, safety leads, and project directors to translate machinery, workflows, and SOPs into clear written narratives.
 




 •     
 **Website \& SEO Content:** 

 Author SEO\-aligned website copy, service pages, and long\-form articles aimed at informing prospective clients — not pushing an immediate sale.
 




 •     
 **LinkedIn Thought Leadership:** 

 Write long\-form LinkedIn articles and posts sharing engineering insights, behind\-the\-scenes production knowledge, and studio milestones — educational in tone, not promotional.
 




 •     
 **Editorial Consistency:** 

 Maintain a clear, credible, and technically trustworthy voice across all written material.
 




**2\. Corporate \& Safety Video Scriptwriting — Secondary Mandate (20%)** 




 •     
 **AV Script Development:** 

 Write two\-column (Audio/Visual) scripts for corporate brand films, industrial process videos, and safety induction/training modules.
 




 •     
 **Narrative Structuring:** 

 Translate technical or safety information into spoken\-word narratives with clear scene direction and pacing.
 




 •     
 **Production Support:** 

 Coordinate with 3D animators, editors, and voiceover artists to keep scripts aligned with the visual storytelling.
 




**Candidate Requirements** 




 •     
 **Experience:** 

 1–3 years in technical writing, content writing, corporate communications, or B2B writing. Scriptwriting exposure is a plus, not a requirement.
 




 •     
 **Core Skill:** 

 Strong long\-form writing — able to research a technical subject and turn it into a clear, well\-structured blog, whitepaper, or case study.
 




 •     
 **Writing Style:** 

 Informative, educational, conversational — geared toward building trust over time, not toward driving immediate action or sales.
 




 •     
 **Technical Curiosity:** 

 Comfortable learning and simplifying industrial operations, heavy machinery, and technical systems without intimidation.
 




 •     
 **Secondary Skill:** 

 Basic familiarity with AV script structure (two\-column Audio/Visual format) and willingness to write narration for video — this is roughly a fifth of the role, not the core of it.
 




 •     
 **Language:** 

 Excellent written English required; Hindi or Gujarati is a plus for client interactions.
 




 •     
 **Work Mode:** 

 Full\-time, in\-office, Vadodara, Gujarat.

title: Frontend Developer
description:
Frontend Developer (React \& Electron.js)
 



**Typesider \| Noida \| Hybrid \| Full\-time \| 1–3 Years** 




**Compensation: ₹2\-4 LPA** 




  





 About Typesider
 



 Typesider is a
 **reward based Windows desktop application** 
 that turns everyday computer activity into tangible rewards.
 



 Users earn
 **Typoints** 
 based on keyboard keystrokes and mouse clicks while using their computers normally. Typoints can be redeemed for
 **coupons, discounts, exclusive brand offers, and gift cards.** 




 Typesider is designed to work seamlessly in the background and follows a
 **privacy first approach** 
 . It counts activity volume but does not read, record, or store what users type or the content of their computer activity.
 



 We’re building a consumer product where
 **performance, reliability, usability, and privacy** 
 are critical.
 



  





 About the Role
 



 We’re looking for a
 **Frontend Developer specializing in React.js, JavaScript, and Electron.js** 
 to help us build, maintain, and expand Typesider.
 



 You’ll work closely with the
 **founders, product, design, and backend teams** 
 to develop new features, improve existing experiences, solve technical issues, and ensure a smooth and reliable
 **cross platform desktop experience** 
 .
 



 This is a
 **hands on role** 
 where you’ll have direct ownership of frontend features in a live product.
 



  





 What You’ll Do
 



 • Build and maintain
 **reusable React.js components and frontend features** 




 • Develop and improve the
 **Typesider Electron.js desktop application** 




 • Work with
 **Electron main and renderer processes, IPC, windows, local storage, and desktop specific functionality** 




 • Integrate frontend features with
 **REST APIs and backend services** 




 • Debug and resolve
 **React, JavaScript, Electron, and cross platform desktop issues** 




 • Improve application
 **performance, responsiveness, and stability** 




 • Work closely with the design team to turn
 **UI/UX designs into polished interfaces** 




 • Collaborate with backend developers to integrate new features and APIs
 



 • Test features, fix issues, and contribute to smooth product releases
 



 • Write clean, reusable, and maintainable code
 



 • Participate in code reviews and contribute to frontend best practices
 



  





 What We’re Looking For
 



 •
 **1–3 years of experience** 
 in frontend development
 



 • Strong proficiency in
 **JavaScript / ES6\+, HTML5, and CSS** 




 • Hands on experience with
 **React.js** 




 • Practical experience with
 **Electron.js** 




 • Experience building
 **scalable and reusable frontend components** 




 • Good understanding of
 **REST APIs and frontend/backend integration** 




 • Strong understanding of
 **Git and version control** 




 • Good debugging and problem solving skills
 



 • Ability to work independently and take ownership of features
 



 • Good understanding of
 **responsive UI development and user experience** 




  





 Good to Have
 



 • Experience with
 **React Native** 




 • Experience with
 **TypeScript** 




 • Experience with
 **Node.js** 




 • Familiarity with
 **Vite, Electron Forge, Webpack, or similar tools** 




 • Understanding of
 **Electron IPC and main/renderer architecture** 




 • Experience working on
 **Windows, macOS, web, or mobile applications** 




 • Experience with
 **frontend performance optimization** 




  





 What We Value
 



 We’re looking for someone who doesn't just write code, but understands the
 **product and user experience behind the code** 
 .
 



 You should be comfortable thinking about:
 



**How should this feature behave for a real user?** 




**What happens in edge cases?** 




**How can this experience be faster, simpler, and more reliable?** 




**How should a web technology behave inside a desktop environment?** 




 We value people who take ownership, solve problems independently, and are comfortable working in an
 **early stage product where things move quickly** 
 .
 



  





 Why Join Typesider
 



 Typesider is an
 **early stage consumer product** 
 , so you’ll work closely with the team building the product and see your work reach real users.
 



 You’ll have the opportunity to
 **own features end to end** 
 , work with React and Electron in a production environment, and contribute directly to the product as it grows.
 



  





 Work Details
 



**Experience:** 
 1–3 Years
 



**Compensation:** 
 ₹2–4 LPA
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Location:** 
 Noida, Uttar Pradesh
 



**Work Mode:** 
 Hybrid
 



**Working Days:** 
 Monday to Saturday
 



  





 Interview Process
 



 The interview process will focus on your
 **React.js, JavaScript, and Electron.js fundamentals, frontend development experience, debugging approach, problem solving, and ability to build reliable cross platform desktop experiences** 
 .
 



 We’ll also discuss projects you’ve worked on, your technical approach, and how you approach building features for a real consumer product.
 



  




* **To Apply:** 
 Please apply through LinkedIn with your updated resume.

title: SDE-2 (React Native + Full stack)
description:
**Software Development Engineer – II** 




**Frontend Platform (Orion)** 




**Urban Company \| Gurugram** 




  





**About the Company** 




 Urban Company is a technology platform offering customers a variety of services at home. Customers use our platform to book services such as beauty treatments, haircuts, massage therapy, cleaning, plumbing, carpentry, appliance repair, painting, etc., all delivered in the comfort of their home and at a time of their choosing. We promise our customers a high\-quality, standardised, and reliable service experience. To fulfil this promise, we work closely with our hand\-picked service partners, enabling them with technology, training, products, tools, financing, insurance, and brand, helping them succeed and deliver on this promise.
 



  





 Urban Company started as UrbanClap in November 2014, when its founders, Abhiraj, Raghav, and Varun, realized that the home services industry was predominantly unorganized, fragmented, and offline. Customers found it challenging to avail quality services conveniently, and service professionals were struggling to make ends meet, having to rely upon several middlemen, contractors, and local aggregators. The founders felt that the industry was ripe for disruption, and launched Urban Company, with three key principles in mind \-
 



  




1. **Customer love:** 
 Build a platform that offers truly delightful and differentiated services
2. **Partner empowerment:** 
 Build a deep, full\-stack partnership with service partners, helping improve their earnings and overall livelihood
3. **Technology first:** 
 Bring innovation and technology to an age\-old industry



  





**About the Role \& Team** 




**Orion is Urban Company’s in\-house frontend platform** 
 : the framework, component system, rendering layer and release infrastructure that every customer and provider facing entity at Urban Company is built on. It is not a library we adopted; we designed and own all of it.
 



 Orion is deliberately cross\-stack. It spans React Native as the base rendering engine for our customer and partner apps, a micro\-frontend architecture, and native Android and iOS layers underneath, with a single component system across all of them.
 



  





 At UC we follow a micro frontend architecture, every product flow: a booking flow, a category page, a checkout step is built as an independently developed and independently deployed micro\-frontend that renders inside the Orion shell, on both app and web. A team ships its changes without coordinating a release with anyone else.
 



  





 Our pod owns that architecture: the shell and its contracts, routing and lifecycle, isolation between micro\-frontends, shared state and navigation across them. As the number of micro\-frontends grows, holding that boundary clean while keeping the app feeling like one product is among the hardest problems on the platform.
 



  





 Orion’s server\-driven UI lets product teams change what a screen shows without shipping an app release, and its own in\-house over\-the\-air pipeline delivers JavaScript updates straight to users’ devices. Every product engineer at Urban Company builds on Orion, which means a change to the platform is felt across the entire company.
 



  





**Our pod sits inside the Orion team** 
 , and owns the following charters built on top of it:
 



  




* **Merchant Platform** 
 : Letting integrating partners sell their services from inside Urban Company. Their experience runs in a container inside our app session, integrated SSO auth, deeplinks, order lifecycle, discovery touchpoints, and their orders showing up alongside ours in the customer's bookings. The bar is performance good enough that our users cannot tell where our product ends and theirs begins while keeping in mind the security and stability repercussions.
* **Third\-Party Integrations** 
 : Taking Urban Company services into other companies' apps. Their users book us without ever leaving their product, server\-to\-server booking flows, request journeys, catalogue mapping, idempotency, and reconciliation when the other side goes quiet.
* **Release \& Over\-the\-Air Delivery** 
 : OTA bundles for customer and partner apps, Android, iOS and web release pipelines, canary rollouts.
* **Platform itself:** 
 Because the pod is part of the Orion team, whoever joins
 **also owns and contributes to Orion itself** 
 , the shared components, the rendering and navigation layer, the release pipeline. You will not just consume the platform, you will improve it, and what you build there is used by every product team at Urban Company and has a direct impact on both our customer and provider app and website ecosystem.



  





 This is a genuinely cross\-stack charter. A single feature here routinely spans a React Native container, a Node.js service and an event pipeline, which is why we hire strong frontend engineers and grow them across the full stack rather than keeping them on one side of it.
 



  





**What You’ll Do** 



* **Build the Merchant Platform:** 
 Take partner brands live inside the Urban Company app, session handoff, order lifecycle, discovery surfaces. While making it secure and fast enough that our users cannot tell where our product ends and theirs begins.
* **Take Urban Company Into Other Apps** 
 : Design and ship server\-to\-server booking flows that let another company's users book us from inside their product. From the first partner call through contract design, idempotency, rollout and reconciliation.
* **Strengthen Orion Itself:** 
 Improve the shared components, rendering layer and release infrastructure that every Urban Company product team depends on.
* **Own and Scale the Micro\-frontend Architecture** 
 : Evolve the shell, contracts and lifecycle that every product team's surface plugs into, and keep the experience feeling like one app as the number of micro\-frontends grows.
* **Grow Across the Stack:** 
 Start in React Native, then take on the Node.js services behind your own features. We expect this, we plan for it, and you will not be doing it alone.
* **Elevate Technical Standards:** 
 Write production\-grade code, drive architectural design discussions, and raise the bar on performance, correctness and observability.



  





**Technology Stack** 




 You will get hands\-on exposure to:
 


* **Frontend (primary):** 
 React Native, TypeScript, micro\-frontends architecture
* **Native:** 
 Kotlin (Android), Swift (iOS)
* **Backend:** 
 Node.js, TypeScript
* **Databases:** 
 MongoDB, MySQL, redis
* **Events:** 
 Kafka, event\-driven systems
* **Analytics:** 
 Snowflake
* **Observability:** 
 Prometheus, Grafana
* **Architecture:** 
 Micro\-frontends, server\-driven UI, microservices
* **Delivery:** 
 In\-house over\-the\-air pipeline, feature flags and experiments



  





**What We’re Looking For** 



* 2\-4 years of software engineering experience.
* At least 2 years building React Native, or modern web with React/Next.js, shipped to real users at real scale.
* Strong JavaScript and TypeScript.
* Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and system design fundamentals.
* Comfortable debugging on real devices: logs, traces, profilers, network waterfalls.
* You already develop with an AI agent. Claude Code is mandatory for every engineer at Urban Company, it is how we write code, debug production issues and find our way around unfamiliar services. You should be comfortable building with an AI coding agent.
* Strong ownership mindset. You have taken a feature from spec through build and release, and then watched the metrics.
* Open to writing backend. No backend experience needed on day one; genuine interest is the requirement. (Backend code in production in any language is a plus.)
* Native Android or iOS exposure, server\-driven UI, design systems, or hard performance work is a plus.
* Experience with mobile release pipelines, CI, or over\-the\-air delivery is a plus.
* Comfortable working in a large codebase you did not write.



  





**What Can You Expect at UC?** 



* Massive ownership and direct customer impact.
* An AI\-native engineering org: Claude Code is standard for every engineer here. It changes what a small pod can own, and it collapses the time it takes to understand a service you have never opened. We are still working out what good practice looks like, and you will help decide it.
* Work on the surfaces every Urban Company customer touches, and the platform every product team builds on.
* Genuine full\-stack growth, frontend to backend, web to native, rather than a single layer for years.
* A high\-performance, high\-velocity engineering culture.
* Quick iterations with real\-world feedback loops.
* Opportunity to grow into senior technical leadership roles.
* Exposure to problems involving, Cross\-platform rendering, app performance on low\-end devices, over\-the\-air delivery and safe rollback, partner API integration, idempotency and correctness.

 Every booking, every live job, every partner earnings screen at Urban Company lands on a phone across a wide range of devices, in a wide range of network conditions, and it has to feel instant. We are looking for an iOS engineer to own how that feels.
 



  





**About the Company** 




 Urban Company is a technology platform offering customers a variety of services at home. Customers use our platform to book services such as beauty treatments, haircuts, massage therapy, cleaning, plumbing, carpentry, appliance repair, painting, etc., all delivered in the comfort of their home and at a time of their choosing. We promise our customers a high\-quality, standardised, and reliable service experience. To fulfil this promise, we work closely with our hand\-picked service partners, enabling them with technology, training, products, tools, financing, insurance, and brand, helping them succeed and deliver on this promise.
 



  





 Urban Company started as UrbanClap in November 2014, when its founders, Abhiraj, Raghav, and Varun, realized that the home services industry was predominantly unorganized, fragmented, and offline. Customers found it challenging to avail quality services conveniently, and service professionals were struggling to make ends meet, having to rely upon several middlemen, contractors, and local aggregators.  Build a platform that offers truly delightful and differentiated services.
* **Partner empowerment:** 
 Build a deep, full\-stack partnership with service partners, helping improve their earnings and overall livelihood.
* **Technology first:** 
 Bring innovation and technology to an age\-old industry.



  





**About the Role \& Team** 




 We are looking for a mobile engineer who is strong in
 **iOS (Swift)** 
 and also hands\-on with
 **React Native** 
 . Most of our app experience is built with React Native on top of native foundations, so you will work on both sides — writing native iOS code where performance and platform features matter, and React Native code for shared product experiences.
 



 This role is
 **cross\-platform by design** 
 . If you are iOS\-heavy, you should be excited to work on React Native. If you are React Native\-heavy, you should be excited to go deep into native iOS. We are clear about this from day one.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Build and ship user\-facing experiences across our apps — native iOS where performance and platform features matter, React Native for shared product surfaces.
* Work cross\-platform every day: native modules, the RN–native boundary, and the New Architecture (Fabric, TurboModules, JSI).
* Own releases end to end — phased rollout, post\-release monitoring, and the call to halt or roll back when the numbers say so.
* Raise the technical bar — code review, architectural input, and mentoring engineers earlier in their careers than you.



  





**Technology Stack** 




**Mobile:** 
 Swift, React Native, TypeScript
 



**iOS:** 
 UIKit and SwiftUI, Swift Concurrency, SPM and CocoaPods, Instruments, Xcode
 



**React Native:** 
 The New Architecture — Fabric, TurboModules, JSI — and Hermes
 



**Release \& Observability:** 
 CI/CD and Fastlane\-class automation, phased rollouts, crash and ANR monitoring, over\-the\-air updates
 



**Adjacent Exposure:** 
 Node.js and TypeScript services, micro\-frontends
 



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* **People who passed out in 2023 or after:** 
 Building mobile applications, with iOS as your primary platform.
* Strong hands\-on skills in
 **iOS (Swift / UIKit / SwiftUI)** 
 and
 **React Native** 
 — comfortable in both, with depth in at least one.
* You have thought seriously about
 **app performance** 
 and can explain what you measured, what you improved, and how.
* You have debugged
 **production issues on apps at large scale** 
 and can walk through your approach step by step.
* You know which
 **metrics to check after a big release** 
 to make sure the delivery is clean and bug\-free.
* You follow what is new
 **iOS 26 and upcoming platform changes** 
 , or React Native's
 **New Architecture** 
 : what it changes, its benefits, and how you have used or explored it.
* Comfort with React Native and TypeScript, or a real appetite to become good at it quickly.
* You are familiar with Appstore
* Strong ownership. You drive problems end to end rather than handing them across a boundary.



  





**Before You Apply — The Honest Bit** 




**Cross\-platform is the job** 




 This role sits on the iOS and React Native boundary, and you will work on both sides of it. iOS is where we want your depth. React Native and TypeScript will be part of your daily work — not an occasional favour. If you are looking to stay purely native, this is not the right role for you, and we would rather you knew that now.
 



  





**What Can You Expect at Urban Company** 



* Ownership of a platform used by every mobile engineer in the company and felt by every user on it.
* Performance and native problems at real scale, across multiple countries and a wide device spectrum.
* A high\-velocity engineering culture with quick iterations and real\-world feedback loops.
* Architectural influence earlier than most companies would give it.
* The chance to grow into senior technical leadership.

title: Game Developer
description:
AI\-FIRST WEB GAME ENGINEER \- GAME GENERATION \& QUALITY AUTOMATION
   

  

 Pupiltree.ai \| Full\-time \| On\-site \- Ballari, Karnataka
   

  

 ABOUT THE ROLE
   

  

 Pupiltree.ai is building a platform that can create web\-based games in bulk from reusable templates. We are looking for a hands\-on engineer who can build engaging browser\-game templates, integrate them into our AI\-powered generation harness, and create the automated quality\-control systems that make generated games reliable, testable, and continuously better.
   

  

 This is not a one\-game\-at\-a\-time development role. You will help build the factory: reusable templates, standard interfaces, generation workflows, validation rules, automated tests, release gates, feedback loops, and the golden dataset that allow game production to scale without sacrificing quality.
   

  

 WORKING ARRANGEMENT \- PLEASE READ
   

  

 This is a permanent, full\-time position and requires compulsory on\-site work in Ballari (Bellary), Karnataka. It is not a remote or hybrid role. Food and accommodation are provided. Specific arrangements will be explained during the hiring process.
   

  

 WHAT YOU WILL DO
   

  

 • Review our existing web games, templates, generation workflow, and cloud harness.
   

 • Design and build reusable templates for multiple types of browser\-based games.
   

 • Create new games and variants with clear rules, responsive controls, reliable state management, and polished player feedback.
   

 • Define standard interfaces for configuration, assets, levels, scoring, difficulty, win/loss states, telemetry, and lifecycle events.
   

 • Integrate templates into the generation harness using Claude Code and/or the Claude Agent SDK, MCP integrations, cloud SDKs, APIs, storage, queues, deployment workflows, and CI/CD where appropriate.
   

 • Make generation runs versioned and reproducible across prompts, configurations, templates, models, and code revisions.
   

 • Build automated checks for compilation, runtime errors, gameplay rules, scoring, state transitions, responsiveness, performance, assets, and browser compatibility.
   

 • Develop programmatic playtests, simulations, test agents, or deterministic replay systems where they improve confidence.
   

 • Create an automated QC and evaluation layer that scores each generated game and blocks outputs that fail agreed thresholds.
   

 • Capture structured reviewer feedback, player signals, defects, and accepted outputs.
   

 • Convert validated feedback into regression tests, improved evaluation criteria, stronger templates, better generation instructions, and updates to the golden dataset.
   

 • Add observability and reporting so the team can understand failure patterns and quality trends across batches.
   

 • Document the template specification, integration workflow, QC framework, and operating procedures.
   

  

 WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
   

  

 • New game templates can be added through a clear, repeatable process.
   

 • Generated games are automatically built, launched, exercised, evaluated, and accepted or rejected.
   

 • Failures are traceable and easy to diagnose.
   

 • Human and player feedback becomes structured data that improves future templates, tests, evaluations, prompts, and the golden dataset.
   

 • Game output can scale without manual review effort increasing at the same rate.
   

  

 REQUIRED EXPERIENCE
   

  

 • Strong experience building web\-based games or highly interactive browser applications.
   

 • Proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript and modern web\-development fundamentals.
   

 • Experience with Phaser, PixiJS, Three.js, Canvas/WebGL, or an equivalent browser\-game or rendering stack.
   

 • Ability to design reusable architectures, template systems, and clean integration contracts.
   

 • Experience with automated browser testing and programmatic validation using Playwright, Cypress, or similar tools.
   

 • Experience building cloud\-based workflows using SDKs, APIs, storage, queues, containers, serverless services, or CI/CD systems.
   

 • Strong understanding of game state, input handling, scoring, progression, difficulty, deterministic behaviour, and edge cases.
   

 • Ability to translate quality goals into measurable checks and useful evaluation criteria.
   

 • Strong debugging, documentation, and end\-to\-end ownership skills.
   

  

 NICE TO HAVE
   

  

 • Production experience with Claude Code, the Claude Agent SDK, MCP, or equivalent coding\-agent workflows.
   

 • Experience with LLM\-assisted code generation, AI agents, evaluation harnesses, or synthetic\-data workflows.
   

 • Experience designing golden datasets, regression corpora, rubric\-based evaluations, or human\-in\-the\-loop review systems.
   

 • Knowledge of telemetry, experimentation, player analytics, or automated gameplay simulation.
   

 • Familiarity with procedural content generation and configuration\-driven game systems.
   

 • Experience optimizing browser games for performance, accessibility, touch devices, and multiple screen sizes.
   

 • Experience operating large batch pipelines with traceability, retries, idempotency, and cost controls.
   

  

 HOW TO APPLY
   

  

 Please apply with your resume or LinkedIn profile and include:
   

  

 • Links to browser games, interactive products, developer tools, or generation systems you have built.
   

 • A short description of the most relevant game architecture or automation pipeline you owned.
   

 • An example of how you tested game logic or evaluated generated software or content at scale.
   

  

 Code samples, playable demos, technical write\-ups, and architecture diagrams are welcome. Please explain how you would use AI\-powered agents and automated QC to generate and validate many games without manually reviewing every output.

title: Enterprise Solutions & Deal Enablement Associate
description:
**Role Overview**
-----------------


TartanHQ builds **HyperSync** (a unified API layer connecting HRMS, ERP, and CRM systems) and **HyperVerify** (a unified verification platform for KYC, KYB, income, employment, and contact\-point checks, used by banks, NBFCs, insurers, and lenders).  

We're hiring three **Enterprise Solutions \& Deal Enablement Associates** to sit directly with the solutioning lead, founders and CBO, and become the connective tissue between our enterprise clients and every internal team that has to say "yes" before a deal goes live \- Product, Engineering, InfoSec, Legal, and Finance.  

This is not a pure sales role and not a pure support role. You will:* Help scope and move new business opportunities forward with enterprise prospects across travel, employee benefits, BFSI/NBFC and lending, and pension/insurance players.
* Own the internal chase: security questionnaires, MSAs/DPAs, commercial paperwork, technical scoping so deals don't stall waiting on an internal team
* Stay the client's single point of contact through the entire journey, from first solutioning conversation through contracting to go\-live, so they never feel dropped between teams
* Bring an end\-to\-end ownership mindset: if something is blocking a deal or a client, it's your job to notice, chase, and resolve it, not to wait for someone to ask


You'll be working alongside the solutioning lead, founders and CBO on a near\-daily basis, so this role has an unusually high amount of visibility and room to grow into a broader BD/solutions leadership track as we scale.**Key Success Metrics (KPIs)**
------------------------------

* **Deal Cycle Turnaround:** Reduce time from first solutioning call to signed contract through proactive internal coordination
* **InfoSec/Vendor Questionnaire Turnaround:** Coordinated response within 3\-7 business days of receipt
* **Contract\-to\-Go\-Live Time:** \< 30 days for standard integrations, tracked jointly with Product/Engineering
* **Client Response Time:** \< 4 hours during business hours for any active deal or account query
* **Internal SLA Adherence:** 90%\+ of InfoSec/Legal/Finance/Product touchpoints closed within agreed internal timelines
* **Active Relationships Managed:** Ability to concurrently manage 8–12 live deals/accounts without dropped threads
* **Stakeholder Satisfaction:** Positive feedback from both external clients and internal teams (Product, InfoSec, Legal, Finance) on responsiveness and clarity

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **1\. Deal Support \& Solutioning (35%)**

* Support the leaders through discovery calls, solution walkthroughs, and RFP/RFI responses for enterprise prospects
* Translate client requirements (HRMS/ERP/CRM integration needs, or KYC/KYB/income/employment verification needs) into a clear internal brief for Product/Engineering
* Prepare first\-cut proposals, solution decks, sample payloads, and commercial summaries to keep deal momentum going
* Track every open opportunity in a shared pipeline/tracker and flag stalled deals before they go cold

### **2\. Cross\-Functional Coordination – InfoSec, Legal, Finance, Product (30%)**

* Own the InfoSec review process for prospects (security questionnaires, ISO 27001/ISO 27701/AICPA/DPDP compliance documentation, VAPT reports) in coordination with the infosec teams, chase, don't wait
* Coordinate MSA, DPA, SOW, and NDA drafting and redlines between the client and TartanHQ's legal counsel, keeping a clear track
* Work with Finance on commercial proposals, pricing confirmations, PO tracking, and invoicing setup for new accounts
* Liaise with Product/Engineering to confirm technical feasibility, connector availability, and realistic go\-live timelines before commitments are made to clients

### **3\. Client Relationship \& Communication (25%)**

* Act as the client's primary point of contact through the deal cycle and into early production, so the relationship survives handoffs between internal teams
* Run a regular communication cadence (calls, status emails, WhatsApp where appropriate) with enterprise stakeholders including BFSI, NBFC, travel, insurance and pension\-sector clients
* Represent client context accurately back to the leaders and internal teams, no information getting lost in translation
* Identify expansion signals (new use cases, additional endpoints) during ongoing conversations and flag them to the leaders

### **4\. Documentation, Reporting \& Process (10%)**

* Maintain a single source of truth for every deal's status: commercial, legal, security, and technical via CRM
* Provide the leaders with a clear weekly view of what's moving, what's stuck, and what needs their direct involvement

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
-------------------------------------

* 1–3 years in a client\-facing, coordination\-heavy, or B2B support role (sales support, business operations, account management, pre\-sales, or similar) \- strong freshers with excellent communication will be considered
* Excellent written and verbal communication in English (Hindi fluency a plus for BFSI/enterprise stakeholder conversations)
* Demonstrated ownership mindset, comfortable chasing multiple internal teams without being told to
* Strong organizational skills; comfortable running trackers/spreadsheets across many parallel deals
* Professional, composed, and articulate when dealing with senior enterprise stakeholders
* Comfortable operating with ambiguity in a fast\-moving startup environment
* Basic working understanding of APIs/integrations sufficient to coordinate (not required to write code)
* Proficiency with Google Sheets/Excel; comfort learning CRM/tracker tools quickly

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Prior exposure to B2B SaaS, fintech, BFSI, or API\-first companies (internships count)
* Familiarity with enterprise procurement processes: security reviews, legal redlines, vendor onboarding
* Exposure to the lending, insurance, travel, or pension ecosystem
* Familiarity with HRIS, accounting / expense tools like Darwinbox, Keka, Greythr, Zoho, Tally, SAP, etc.
* Familiarity with tools like HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce, Notion, or similar
* Bachelor's degree in any discipline; MBA or equivalent is a plus but not required

**What We Look For**
--------------------

* **Client\-first mindset:** Genuinely cares whether the client had a good experience, not just whether the task got closed
* **Ownership mentality:** Drives things to completion with minimal supervision; treats "not my job" as not an option
* **Professional \& sincere:** Represents TartanHQ credibly in front of senior stakeholders at large enterprises
* **Coordination discipline:** Can hold 8\-10 moving threads at once without dropping any of them
* **Composure under pressure:** Enterprise deal cycles involve last\-minute asks and shifting timelines, stays steady through it
* **Growth mindset:** This function is being built from scratch; you'll help shape the playbook, not just follow one

title: Digital Marketing Executive (Remote) – SaaS / WhatsApp Automation
description:
**About Mobius Bloom Ventures**

Mobius Bloom Ventures is a technology venture studio building SaaS and AI\-powered products for Indian MSMEs. Our flagship product, **Whalexy**, is a WhatsApp Business Automation SaaS platform focused on smarter customer communication, automation, broadcasts, chatbot flows, and conversion tracking.

**About the Role**

We're looking for a Digital Marketing Executive to own day\-to\-day digital marketing execution — social media, content, paid campaigns, SEO, lead generation, WhatsApp/email marketing, and performance tracking. This is a remote role, but you'll work closely with our creative team to turn marketing ideas into campaigns that drive awareness, engagement, leads, and conversions.

**What You'll Do**

*Social Media Marketing*

* Plan and manage the social media calendar
* Schedule and publish content across Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook
* Research trends, topics, competitors, and content opportunities
* Coordinate remotely with the Graphic Designer \& Video Editor
* Monitor engagement and optimize content based on performance

*Content Marketing*

* Develop content ideas around WhatsApp Business API, automation, SaaS, AI \& technology, and MSME growth
* Write captions, post copy, CTAs, campaign copy, and marketing content
* Collaborate with the creative team on posts, carousels, reels, blogs, and campaigns

*Paid Advertising \& Lead Generation*

* Plan, set up, run, monitor, and optimize paid campaigns
* Hands\-on Meta Ads experience required; Google Ads strongly preferred
* Set campaign objectives, audiences, budgets, placements, creatives, and conversion goals
* Monitor CPM, CPC, CTR, CPL, conversion rate, ROAS
* Test audiences, creatives, copy, offers, and landing pages
* Manage budgets and reduce acquisition costs while improving lead quality

*SEO \& Website Marketing*

* Basic keyword research and SEO opportunity identification
* Coordinate website/blog content and on\-page SEO
* Monitor website traffic and content performance

*WhatsApp \& Email Marketing*

* Plan and execute WhatsApp campaigns using Whalexy
* Support broadcasts, customer communication flows, email campaigns, and basic automation
* Track and improve messaging performance

*Analytics \& Reporting*

* Track organic and paid campaign performance
* Prepare clear marketing reports and recommendations
* Use data to decide what to scale, change, test, or stop

**Required Skills**

* Solid understanding of digital marketing fundamentals and social media marketing
* Hands\-on experience running paid campaigns, especially Meta Ads
* Understanding of campaign setup, targeting, budgets, creatives, tracking, optimization
* Strong copywriting and written communication
* Basic SEO and website content knowledge
* Comfort with analytics and performance data
* Strong ownership, organization, and self\-management — this is a remote role, so independent execution matters
* **Genuine, hands\-on marketing judgment.** We use AI tools as aids, not crutches — we're looking for someone who can think, strategize, and write independently, and who uses AI to support their work rather than fully outsourcing thinking, writing, or creative decisions to it.

**Good to Have**

* Google Ads experience
* Experience with SaaS, B2B, technology, or startup marketing
* WhatsApp marketing experience
* Email marketing / CRM / marketing automation experience
* Google Analytics / Search Console experience

**Experience \& Eligibility**

0–3 years of relevant experience in digital marketing, paid advertising, social media, or content marketing. Freshers with strong internships or practical paid\-ad campaign experience are welcome to apply.

Paid advertising is a core responsibility — candidates should be comfortable actually running and optimizing campaigns, not just understanding the concepts.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Campaigns launched correctly, monitored consistently, optimized based on data
* Paid campaigns generate qualified leads at improving acquisition efficiency
* Organic and paid content work together to strengthen brand visibility and demand
* Marketing decisions increasingly reflect real performance data

**How to Apply**

Send your updated resume and a portfolio/work samples (mandatory for consideration) to careers@mobiusbloom.com

**Subject line:** Application – Digital Marketing Executive (Remote) \| \[Your Name]

Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

title: Resident Staff Nurse
description:
We are actively hiring **dedicated and qualified Staff Nurse** to join our school as a campus resident at The Peepal Grove School, Gongivaripalli, Sadum mandal.

**Positions Available**:

* **Resident Staff Nurse**

**Minimum Requirements**:

* Certified nursing degree (GNM/B.Sc. Nursing, A.N.M).
* Freshers and experienced candidates are welcome to apply.
* Compassionate, team\-oriented, and committed to patient care.
* Single/ready to stay in single accommodation on campus.

**Duties \& Responsibilities1\. Healthcare \& Medical Duties**

* Provide **first aid and emergency care** to students and staff whenever on campus.
* Administer **medications and treatments** as per prescriptions and standing medical orders.
* Conduct **regular health check\-ups** and monitor students with **chronic illnesses** (asthma, diabetes, epilepsy, etc.).
* Maintain a **clean, well\-stocked infirmary** with necessary medicines and first\-aid supplies.
* Maintain all medical equipment in working order and ensure its hygiene for use.
* Track **immunisations and vaccinations**, ensuring compliance with health regulations.
* Implement **quarantine protocols** during outbreaks of contagious diseases.
* Offer **counselling and health guidance** for minor ailments, injuries, and preventive care.
* Coordinate with **doctors, hospitals, and specialists** for referrals and emergency cases.
* Maintain **confidential medical records** for all students and report health concerns to the **Principal and/or Bursar**.

**2\. Emergency \& Safety Preparedness**

* Be **on\-call for first aid and emergencies** whenever on campus.
* Develop and implement **medical emergency protocols** for injuries, illnesses, and other incidents.
* Train **students and staff in first aid, CPR, and basic health protocols**.
* Ensure **first\-aid kits are stocked** across key school areas (dormitories, classrooms, sports grounds, etc.).
* Conduct **health and safety drills** in coordination with school administration.

**3\. Procedural \& Administrative Responsibilities**

* Maintain a **daily log of infirmary visits** and submit **weekly/monthly reports** to the Bursar.
* Monitor and **replenish medical inventory**, ensuring timely procurement. Track expiry dates of medicines in stock and discard periodically while maintaining the stock of essential medicines and vaccines.
* Liaise with **kitchen staff to accommodate dietary restrictions** for students with medical needs.
* Ensure proper **sanitation and hygiene** in the infirmary and coordinate with housekeeping if required.
* Submit timely monthly reports (by the 1st of every month) on doctor’s visits for timely remuneration to the visiting doctor.
* Reviewing health records and medical requirements of boarding students at the time of returning to school and while departing to home. Confidentiality of medical records is to be maintained.
* Attend **staff meetings** and contribute to discussions on student well\-being.
* Ensure compliance with **health and safety regulations** applicable to residential schools.

**4\. Mental Health \& Wellness Support**

* Identify and address **stress, anxiety, or mental health concerns** in students.
* Work closely with the principal, **teachers and house parents** to monitor students’ emotional well\-being by providing inputs proactively.
* Actively promote **healthy lifestyle habits** through awareness sessions on hygiene and nutrition through assemblies and hostel visits.

**5\. Campus Engagement**

* **Dine in the school’s dining hall**, ensuring familiarity with students’ health\-related dietary needs.
* Provide medical cover in **sports meets, evening sports activities, and other school events**, whenever it does not interfere with core medical duties.
* Provide **medical supervision during outdoor activities, field trips, and school treks**.
* Be a **visible and approachable figure** in the school community to encourage students to seek medical help when needed.

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent

Pay: ₹12,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Food provided
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Pileru, Andhra Pradesh: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

Application Question(s):

* Do you have any experience in child care?

Education:

* Bachelor's (Required)

License/Certification:

* Nursing License (Required)

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist - Technology (7+ years onwards)
description:
**Job Description**


As a Talent Acquisition Specialist at MRI Software, you will partner with global business leaders and hire managers to attract, assess, and hire top talent across Product and Engineering functions. You will play a key role in driving recruitment strategies, delivering exceptional candidate experience, and supporting business growth through effective talent acquisition practices.


If you are looking to join a fast paced, growing global organization, MRI Software may be the place for you. In this role, you will find yourself professionally challenged with the ability to identify top talent while building relationships with hiring managers and business leaders across the globe. With a proven full\-cycle recruitment process that focuses on mutual fit and candidate experience, our team is helping to build innovative teams of passionate members that are pioneering the real estate technology space.

**Job duties include:**

* Own the end\-to\-end recruitment lifecycle for Product and Engineering positions in Baroda, including workforce planning support, sourcing strategy, candidate assessment, offer management, and onboarding coordination.
* Learn and follow our proven recruiting process designed to identify qualified candidates through various recruiting tools.
* Evaluate candidate strengths against position requirements to include cultural fit within the business.
* Negotiate terms and conditions of employment with candidates including salary, benefits and other offerings wherever applicable.
* Complete necessary pre\-employment processes including assessments, reference checks and background/drug tests.
* Provide top notch experience to candidates, hiring managers, peers, and other internal and external stakeholders in order to create a productive and diverse environment.
* Execute candidate screening process, which may include but is not limited to application reviewing, conducting HR phone screens, reference checks, and onsite/virtual interviews
* Manage the employment offer process, including preparing offer letters conducting reference and background checks, and presenting employment offers
* Coordinate new employment onboarding from a paperwork perspective, including data hygiene of employee into HRIS and collection and completion of needed forms.
* Track, analyze and report metrics and effectiveness of recruiting programs; analyze new trends and share best practices

**Requirements:**

* **7\+ years as a Talent Acquisition Specialist** or a similar role.
* **Proven experience recruiting for Product Management, Software Engineering, or related technology roles within the Baroda talent market.**
* Excellent oral and written communication, presentation, time management, decision\-making, organizational, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to thrive in a fast paced, deadline driven environment while being self\-motivated and highly engaging.
* Hands\-on experience using Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), preferably Workday Recruiting.
* High degree of integrity and ability to work with confidential information.
* Desire to build relationships both internally and externally while ensuring a top\-notch candidate experience.

**Benefits:**

* Hybrid working arrangements (3 days in the office)
* **Competitive base salary and TA monthly commission**
* Flexi any day (knock 2\.5 hours off your day on any day)
* Medical insurance coverage for extended family members.
* Engaging, fun \& inclusive culture: check out the MRI Software APAC Insta feed and stories!

**About Us**

  

From the day we opened our doors, MRI Software has built flexible, game\-changing real estate software that powers thriving communities and helps make the world a better place to live, work and play. Fulfilling that mission is only possible because of one thing: exceptional people. People like you!

  

Our people\-first approach to PropTech is defining a new industry standard for client experiences that, quite frankly, can’t be duplicated. Experiences that deliver real value every day. And we know those experiences begin with our people.

  

We believe MRI is more than just a workplace; it’s a connected community of people who truly feel they belong. Whether we’re investing in employee resource groups or providing tailored resources for each person to reach their full potential, we’re passionate about creating a work environment that makes you excited to show up every single day.

  

At MRI, one of our core values is to *strive to amaze.* From the intelligent solutions we create to the culture we cultivate, that’s our goal every day. Because that’s what industry leaders do. Whether you’re joining as a new Pride member or rejoining us after a short time away, your talent is vital to us, our partners and our clients.

 **Amazing growth requires amazing employees. Are you up to the challenge?**


We know confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting remarkable candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply. We’d love to hear from you!

title: Assistant, People Operations
description:
***World Change Starts with Educated Children®***
=================================================

**IMPORTANT: All applicants must be legally eligible to work in the country where the position is located. Room to Read is not able to provide sponsorship.**
=============================================================================================================================================================

**Position Overview:**
----------------------


Primary responsibilities are tactical in nature, involving the implementation and administration of HRIS/Workday, POSH processes, Performance Management Support, Employee Orientation and Induction, Employee Engagement support and Learning \& Development support. This position reports to the Sr. Manager, People Operations. The following duties are exemplary of the type of tasks that may be assigned at the discretion of the Director, People Operations.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

### **Workday HRIS End\-to\-End Management:**

* Manage end\-to\-end employee lifecycle transactions in the HRIS, including creation of employee IDs and onboarding of new joiners.
* Create and manage Supervisory Organizations and ensure accurate organizational structures in the system.
* Process and update employee transfers, reporting changes, terminations, and other employee movements.
* Process Leaves of Absence, including maternity, paternity, and other applicable leaves.
* Conduct monthly HRIS audits to identify discrepancies, ensure data accuracy, and maintain up\-to\-date employee records.
* Ensure timely and accurate HRIS updates in line with organizational policies and processes.

### **POSH Process Management:**

* Manage and coordinate the end\-to\-end POSH (Prevention of Sexual Harassment) process across the organization in accordance with the POSH Act and organizational policies.
* Coordinate with the Internal Committee (IC) and relevant stakeholders for POSH\-related processes, including complaint management, documentation, meetings, and proceedings.
* Support the planning and coordination of POSH awareness sessions, IC orientations, and employee sensitization programs.
* Maintain confidential POSH records, documentation, and reports while ensuring timely and appropriate follow\-up on cases and related processes.
* Support periodic compliance activities and ensure adherence to statutory and organizational POSH requirements.

### **Employee Orientation \& Induction Management:**

* Plan, coordinate, and conduct employee orientations and induction programs for new joiners across the organization.
* Coordinate with relevant departments and stakeholders to ensure timely completion of functional, organizational, and policy\-related orientations.
* Schedule and facilitate virtual and in\-person induction sessions and track completion of mandatory onboarding activities.
* Gather feedback and continuously improve the orientation and induction process based on employee and stakeholder inputs.

### **Annual Performance Management \& Promotion Support:**

* Support and coordinate the end\-to\-end annual performance appraisal process across the organization.
* Coordinate with managers, employees, and relevant stakeholders to ensure timely completion of goal setting, performance reviews, evaluations, and final ratings.
* Maintain and update performance\-related records and HRIS data throughout the appraisal cycle.
* Support the communication and implementation of appraisal outcomes, including salary revisions, promotions, and related HR actions.
* Monitor timelines, follow up on pending activities, and ensure the appraisal process is completed accurately and within defined timelines.

### **L \& D Support:**

* Provide backend and logistical support for learning and development programs across the organization.
* Coordinate with facilitators, participants, and relevant stakeholders for scheduling and smooth execution of training programs.
* Manage training calendars, participant lists, invitations, attendance, and completion records.
* Support the coordination of training venues, virtual meeting links, materials, and other logistical requirements.
* Maintain and update training\-related data, records, and documentation.
* Support communication and follow\-up with employees to ensure timely completion of assigned learning programs.

### **Employee Engagement Support:**

* Plan and organize employee engagement activities across all states, in both virtual and in\-person formats.
* Coordinate and facilitate Town Halls and direct management communication forums to promote transparent communication between employees and leadership.
* Support the planning and execution of the Annual Awards Ceremony across all states, including coordination with state teams and relevant stakeholders.
* Provide end\-to\-end coordination and logistical support for organizational events, ensuring smooth execution within defined timelines.
* Develop innovative and inclusive engagement initiatives aligned with organizational objectives and employee needs.
* Coordinate event communication, participation, feedback, and post\-event activities to enhance the overall employee experience.
* Support in conducting 2\-3 internal surveys (GPTW, ESS) annually.

### **Other support to People Operations:**

* Operate within the HR Budget and monitor spending monthly.
* Ensure that the organizations and the employee’s interests are protected, and the policies/ practices of the organization are legally compliant.
* Manage the audits related to people operations.
* Review employee appeals through compliant procedure.
* Extend any other support people operations team may need.

**Qualifications:**
-------------------

### **Required:**

* Demonstrated ability to design and implement Human Resources programs and initiatives, preferably in the development sector.
* Bachelor’s degree with minimum of 1\-2 years of professional experience in HR position.
* General knowledge of the principles and practices of personnel administration.
* Demonstrated strategic approach to HR with the ability and willingness to also execute the tactical elements of the job.
* Ability to work within narrowly defined objectives under general supervision
* Ability to effectively address well defined problems of moderate complexity and complete moderately complex assignments.
**Compensation:**
-----------------

Room to Read offers a competitive salary with excellent benefits. Benefits include a thirteenth month bonus, health insurance and a retirement plan. The non\-monetary compensation includes a unique opportunity to be part of an innovative, meaningful, and rapidly growing organization that is changing transforming the lives of millions of children in developing countries on literacy and gender equality in education.

**Room to Read is a child\-safe organization.**
-----------------------------------------------

**Read is a child\-safe organization; all personnel must adhere to Room to Read’s Child Protection Policy, Child Protection Code of Conduct and Prevention of Sexual Exploitation and Abuse (PSEA) Policy.**
============================================================================================================================================================================================================

**Room to Read is an equal opportunity employer committed to identifying and developing the skills and leadership of people from diverse backgrounds.**
=======================================================================================================================================================

  

**Child Protection Principles**
===============================

* Room to Read is committed to the education and welfare of children and protecting them from abuse and exploitation
* Room to Read has zero tolerance for child abuse and exploitation.
* All children have the right to be free from abuse and exploitation, including neglect, maltreatment, and physical, mental or sexual violence, injury or abuse.
* All children should be treated with respect and dignity.
* The well\-being of the child is Room to Read’s first priority when dealing with all identified or suspected cases of child abuse.
* Room to Read shall integrate child protection into all its organizational strategies, structures and work practices.

**Protection from Sexual Exploitation and Abuse (PSEA) Principles**
===================================================================

* Room to Read Representatives must create and maintain an environment that prevents sexual exploitation and sexual abuse.
* Room to Read has zero tolerance for adult sexual exploitation and abuse.
* Sexual exploitation and abuse are serious violations of fundamental human rights and will not be accepted or tolerated.
* All adults should be treated with respect and dignity.
* Room to Read implements a survivor\-centered approach, putting the survivor’s rights and dignity at the forefront.
* Survivors referred to available professional assistance (e.g. mental health counselling), upon consent.

 ***About Room to Read:***

  



Founded in 2000 on the belief that World Change Starts with Educated Children®, *Room to Read envisions a world free from illiteracy and gender inequality, where all children have room to read, learn and grow – creating lasting change*. Through our Literacy Portfolio, we train and coach teachers of the early grades in literacy instruction; create and publish quality books and curricular materials in local languages; and establish children’s libraries filled with diverse children’s books that can be enjoyed at school and home. Our Gender Equality Portfolio supports adolescents, particularly girls, in developing life skills that promote gender equality, helping them to pursue lifelong learning and make informed decisions.


We support young people of all genders to overcome gender biases and build the knowledge and skills to create a gender\-equal world. Room to Read collaborates with local communities, partner organizations, publishers, and governments to test and implement innovative models that can be integrated into the education system to deliver positive outcomes for children at scale. To date, Room to Read has benefited more than 50 million children in 28 countries.


Learn more at www.roomtoread.org.

title: Senior Manager - ServiceNow Development
description:
Overview:

ServiceNow Developer is a senior hands\-on technical role responsible for leading complex platform development, guiding developers, reviewing code, enforcing standards and ensuring high\-quality delivery across ITSM, HRSD and ESM. The role combines deep development expertise with leadership accountability for technical execution.

  

This role works closely with Technical Leads, Product Managers, Architects and Scrum teams to translate product priorities into technically sound and maintainable ServiceNow capabilities. The Lead Developer also mentors junior developers and supports global/offshore delivery teams through clear guidance, reusable patterns and high\-quality technical documentation.


Responsibilities:
**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**ServiceNow Development \& Configuration**
-------------------------------------------

* Develop ServiceNow configurations, customizations and enhancements based on approved user stories and technical designs.
* Build and maintain Service Catalog items, Record Producers, catalog variables, workflows, Flow Designer flows and approvals.
* Create and maintain Business Rules, Client Scripts, Script Includes, UI Policies, UI Actions, ACLs, notifications and scheduled jobs.
* Configure forms, lists, dashboards, reports, knowledge articles and employee\-facing portal experiences.
* Maintain development documentation, configuration notes and deployment records.

**ITSM Delivery**
-----------------

* Develop enhancements for Incident, Problem, Change Enablement, Request Management, Service Catalog, Knowledge and CMDB processes.
* Support workflow automation, SLA configuration, assignment logic, notifications, templates and reporting requirements.
* Assist with ITSM process improvement by translating functional requirements into platform configuration and scripts.

**HRSD Delivery**
-----------------

* Configure and enhance HR Case Management, Employee Center, Lifecycle Events, Employee Journeys and HR Knowledge capabilities.
* Support confidential HR workflows through proper role, group, data and access\-control configuration.
* Improve employee self\-service through catalog design, knowledge surfacing, case deflection and digital experience improvements.

**ESM Delivery**
----------------

* Build enterprise service workflows for Workplace Services, Facilities, Finance, Procurement, Legal and Corporate Functions.
* Develop request intake, approvals, routing, case handling, fulfillment workflows and reporting for non\-IT service teams.
* Support expansion of ServiceNow as a shared enterprise workflow platform.

**Testing, Deployment \& Support**
----------------------------------

* Perform unit testing, peer testing and support system, integration and user acceptance testing.
* Prepare update sets or deployment packages in alignment with release management practices.
* Support production troubleshooting, root cause analysis, defect remediation and go\-live hyper\-care.
* Contribute to upgrades, patching, regression testing and platform health activities.


Qualifications:
**Required Qualifications \& Experience**
=========================================

* Candidate should have 9\-11 Years of total experience
* 4–6\+ years of ServiceNow development and administration experience.
* Hands\-on experience with ITSM and exposure to HRSD and/or ESM workflows.
* Strong JavaScript knowledge and experience with ServiceNow scripting patterns.
* Experience working with Agile delivery teams, user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Experience developing integrations using REST, SOAP or Integration Hub.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or equivalent practical experience.

**Technical Skills**
====================

* ServiceNow: Service Catalog, Flow Designer, ITSM, HRSD, Employee Center, Knowledge, Reports, Dashboards and CMDB fundamentals.
* Scripting: JavaScript, Glide APIs, Business Rules, Client Scripts, Script Includes, ACLs and UI Policies.
* Web Technologies: HTML, CSS, Angular, AJAX, JSON, XML and web services.
* Integration: REST, SOAP, Integration Hub, OAuth concepts and API troubleshooting.
* Delivery Tools: Azure DevOps or similar backlog tools, release tracking, test documentation and deployment checklists.

**Certifications**
==================

* Required: ServiceNow CSA; ServiceNow CAD preferred for hands\-on development roles.
* Preferred: CIS\-ITSM, CIS\-HRSD and ITIL v4 Foundation.

Job Summary
  
  

* Group Internal Audit and Investigations (GIAI) is looking for an accomplished and highly motivated audit professional with a robust background and strong expertise around the key risks and controls in the Human Resources (HR); Corporate Affairs Brand and Marketing (CABM) and Strategy portfolio which fall within the wider Functions and Group Chief Operating Officer (GCOO) portfolios..
* The role\-holder will be an integral part of the Functions and GCOO Audit teams. The team provides independent assessments of risk management and internal control environment of HR, CABM and Strategy globally.
* We pride ourselves in being auditors of the future, forward\-looking and agile with a keen focus on smarter auditing. When you join us, you will enter a role that challenges the status quo and moves mindsets and be a part of the future of banking


Key Responsibilities
  
  

Strategy
  
* Support Audit Directors and Senior Audit Managers where required, in the development of the GIA risk assessment and development of an appropriate audit plan for the HR, CABM and Strategy portfolio;
* Propose audits for coverage during the audit cycle based on their knowledge of the business;
* Audits assigned to the individual in the audit plan should address the key risks identified in the detailed risk assessment and in the audit planning process and meet relevant regulatory requirements and expectations that are required to be covered by GIAI.
* Ensure that audit team operates in line with the Audit Charter during engagements, remains independent from management and free from interference.
* Build the knowledge, awareness and confidence across the GIAI teams so that over time, support for HR, CABM and Strategy audits outside of the GCOO and Functions team can be tailored to need and that functional and product teams are confident in completing relevant audit tests.


Business
  
* Effectively manage the cost of assigned audits within the allocated budget for their areas within audit engagements


Processes
  
* To act as Team Lead/ Team Member on assigned audit work across the Group.
* Provide technical input and challenge on audit work being undertaken within the scope of assigned product area of responsibility. This will include working with the audit team to produce outputs of high quality which address the areas of greatest risk.
* When Team Leading to provide clear guidance, detailed review and supervision of the audit team’s work so that audit deliverables meet quality standards and timelines in line with the GIA methodology.
* When Team Leading to provide guidance on business/audit technical knowledge and management skills to team members to enable them to effectively deliver their assigned contributions for an audit.
* Support adherence to the GIA methodology in all areas of the audit engagement, as well as raising awareness and understanding of the methodology.
* Demonstrate sound knowledge of both business/technical areas and expert knowledge in the audit process, including the GIAI system, so that audit work is carried out to a high standard that meets all methodology and GIAI system requirements.
* Monitor the implementation/delivery of the agreed issues/audit plans for the audits assigned, understanding the key risks arising, provide advice on resolution of issues to auditees/action plan owners and escalate audit findings that remain unresolved.
* Demonstrates strong foundational analytics skills, with the ability to independently design, execute and interpret data driven audit tests. Proficient in using data analytics tools (e.g., SQL, Python, Excel advanced functions, Tableau, Power BI, or equivalent) to support audit planning, fieldwork and continuous monitoring activities.


Analytics Responsibilities
  
* Apply data and analytics techniques during the audit cycle for better efficiency and effectiveness
* Contribute to the design and implementation of effective continuous monitoring and automated testing strategies using analytics
* Work with key stakeholders to understand data flow, data points for key systems relevant to the audit portfolio


People \& Talent
  
* Share knowledge to increase specialism within the function.
* Influence change within the department by highlighting potential enhancements.
* Identify growth areas on an ongoing basis and identify how best to develop them.
* When Team Leading provide performance feedback, as appropriate at the end of an audit.
* Identify and successfully complete key internal training for self\-development.
* Facilitate the development of audit team members by providing on the job training and recommending formal training to support GIAI activities.


Risk Management
  
* Assist in the update of the assigned Continuous Risk Assessment on a regular basis to identify changes in risk profiles and document these in a timely manner, proposing changes to the assigned audit plan, as appropriate.
* Promote early identification and escalation of risks, issues, trends and developments to relevant stakeholders. Be prepared to raise issues/concerns outside the normal audit process.
* Adopt an anticipatory approach to risk assessment through stakeholder engagement and monitoring of the external environment to improve audit planning; and
* Review MI and reports regularly to keep up\-to\-date with key trends within the business and audit deliverables.


Governance
  
* Manage the relevant portfolio stakeholders and establish good working relationships to help the businesses improve the control environment and keep updated with changes in the business impacting their risk profile.
* Use networks and relationships to build engagement and achieve results.
* Escalate delays in the execution of audit work, both to auditee management and GIA Management.
* Be able to clearly explain issues identified along with the risks and root causes to GIA and business management, using language designed to be understood by non\-experts


Regulatory \& Business Conduct
  
* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.


Key stakeholders
  
* Designated business stakeholders, typically related to assigned portfolio; and
* GIAI stakeholders – team leaders, team members, team managers, Audit Directors, Senior Audit Directors.


Other Responsibilities
  
* Embed Here for good and Group’s brand and values in GIA; and
* Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures.


Skills and Experience
  
  

* GIA Methodology and Systems
* Stakeholder Engagement
* Risk Assessment
* Audit Planning
* Audit Report Writing
* Continuous Monitoring
* Ability to work within a global team
* Data analysis
* Data insights (generation and interpretation)
* Basic Tools (MS Excel, Power BI etc.)


Qualifications
  
  

* Experience in Audit, Governance, Risk or business environment.
* Professional Audit or Accounting Certification preferred
* Good Communicator, both written and verbal, with an ability to influence and gain respect of senior management, stakeholders, peers and their teams.
* Confident and courageous to raise / escalate issues in a pro active, professional and timely manner.
* Self\-directed and able to work with minimum supervisions
* Demonstrates understanding and commitment to the Group’s Core Values
* Familiarity with Banking Regulations,
* Working experience with analytics/visualisation tools such as PowerBI, Tableau, or similar tools, and is able interpret and generate data insights using data visualisation
* Certifications around analytics and AI/Gen AI will be an advantage


About Standard Chartered
  
  

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.
  
  

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.
  
  

**Together we:**  

Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  
Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  
Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term
  
What we offer
  
  

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  
  

Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  
Time\-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  
Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  
Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market\-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first\-aiders and all sorts of self\-help toolkits
  
A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  
Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies \- everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

**Position Summary**

Serves as a key partner to Program Managers, Portfolio Leadership, Finance, and Governance stakeholders to ensure projects and programs comply with organizational governance standards. Leads governance and delivery management activities across multiple programs and projects within the MCM portfolio, ensuring alignment with enterprise standards and controls.

Coordinates monthly and bi\-weekly forecasting, financial reporting, budget tracking, variance analysis, and project financial governance activities.


Develops and maintains governance artifacts including PWG/PSG materials, project health checks, RAID reporting, decision logs, dependency tracking, and audit evidence repositories.


Facilitates cross\-functional governance forums, stakeholder reviews, working groups, and status review sessions with program leadership, delivery teams, and senior management.
