title: Sr. People & Talent Operations Partner
description:
**Senior People \& Talent Operations Partner**
==============================================


**This one's going to move fast.** We're expecting a lot of interest, so we're running this as a focused hiring sprint. **Applications and assessments close September 20**, with interviews happening over the two weeks after that. Apply quickly to avoid disappointment!


**Where do we hire from?** Almost everywhere. Check that your country appears on this page. For this role, you'll have **at least 4 hours daily overlap** with your UK\-based manager.


Hi there, I'm **Olive Turon, Head of People \& Culture** at TestGorilla. I'm excited to share more about the **Senior People \& Talent Operations Partner** role and our team.

**About TestGorilla**
---------------------


At TestGorilla, we're on a mission to place 1 billion people in their dream jobs. To democratize opportunity, we're building the world's leading skills\-based talent discovery platform \- one that replaces reliance on resumes with scientific validation of what people can truly do.


Founded as a 100% remote company in 2020, our global team is united by high standards, a lot of heart, and a relentless drive to conquer new technological frontiers. We're all AI\-fluent builders who care deeply about replacing bias with fairness.


After empowering thousands of companies to hire smarter and faster, we're now unlocking the next phase of our scale\-up journey \- where you'll play an instrumental role in creating a world where skills matter most!

**About the role**
------------------


As our **Senior People \& Talent Operations Partner**, you'll own People Ops as a product: the systems, compliance, and self\-serve workflows that let most of People \& Culture run itself day to day, plus the tooling behind how we hire. You'll join a lean, two\-person team, working directly with me, with proper and lasting ownership from day one.


Payroll, compliance, and HR systems across every (35, currently!) country we operate in are foundational elements of this role. Just as critically, you'll build and own the AI/automation and self\-serve layer that keeps our People function lean, bringing a product mindset to everything you touch. Let’s face it: we’re a scale\-up, so you’ll also need to be happy wearing other People hats when the moment requires.


We're looking for someone autonomous, opinionated and candid, who'll tell me when I've got it wrong. You'll be dealing with real people and real problems, so you'll need to stay empathic but boundaried, structured and organized even when the pace picks up.


I’m biased, but I think it’s a dream job: this is an HR role in an HRTech company changing the world of work for the better, we’ll have immense amounts of fun, there’s plenty of uncharted territory for you to make your own, and I’m committed to helping you to do the best work of your life.

**A quick check:** if you've never built objectively clever automations (not just used one someone else built), please don't apply. Automation is just that central to the job.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------


In this role, your responsibilities will include:

* Upholding TestGorilla's behaviors and fostering an inclusive, supportive culture.
* Designing, building and maintaining a smart, automated and AI\-enabled people journey \- from pre\-boarding to off\-boarding \- that frees up capacity for bespoke, white\-glove treatment where it matters
* Being the technical owner and orchestrator of our HR tech stack: evaluating and enhancing it, ensuring these tools are not siloed but unified and integrated.
* Owning the non\-Finance side of payroll, invoicing, contract administration, and compliance end to end, across every country we operate in.
* Owning data privacy and recordkeeping, and the day\-to\-day relationship with our EOR vendor.
* Owning configuration and troubleshooting of our hiring tooling, so hiring managers can run their own searches independently.
* Owning the documentation that makes self\-serve actually work in practice, ensuring that it’s structured in a way that is easily accessible to both humans and P\&C AI agents.
* Working with me to maintain a clean line between what's self\-serve and what needs a person. We do not aspire to automate our entire People journey here.

**What you'll bring**
---------------------


We're looking for someone who:

* Is passionate about TestGorilla's mission to help one billion people find their dream jobs.
* Has excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Has built and owned sophisticated automations (Zapier, n8n, Make.com, and the like) as a core part of an integrated HR tech stack, not just used AI tools day to day. Arguably the most important thing on this list.
* Has managed payroll, compliance, or HR operations across multiple countries, ideally through an Employer of Record or a mix of EOR and direct entities.
* Has deep, hands\-on HRIS experience. HiBob experience is a big plus, and so is experience assessing or migrating HR systems.
* Brings a product mindset: builds for the people who use them (employees and managers), listens to their feedback, and iterates rather than building in isolation.
* Thrives in a high\-autonomy, async\-first, remote\-only environment, and has worked in these kinds of teams and working cultures before.
* Marries operational rigor with genuine empathy and a real interest in people. You'll be dealing directly with team members, sometimes on sensitive matters.
* Is opinionated and candid, with excellent feedback and stakeholder management skills.


Most people in this role will have acquired these skills over five years of relevant experience. That being said, we care far more about what you've owned, your impact and how you've progressed, than the exact number of years.


We seek diversity and encourage applications from everyone, even if your experience doesn't exactly match the description. Studies show that women and underrepresented groups can be hesitant to apply unless they meet every requirement \- let's buck that trend!

**Bonus skills**
----------------


While these skills aren't a requirement, we'd be very interested to hear from you if you have any of the following:

* Experience with an ATS or hiring platform such as Ashby, Greenhouse, or Lever.
* Experience with an EOR provider such as Remote, Deel, or Oyster.
* HRIS implementation or migration project experience.
* Experience supporting a team through organizational change.

**What's in it for you?**
-------------------------

**Please note:** In this role, you'll be hired as an Individual Contractor.

* **Global Team:** Join a fully remote, mission\-driven team from around the world.
* **Competitive compensation:** €56,520 \- €70,650 base pay \+ Share Appreciation Rights (SARs). This role doesn't carry a bonus component.
* **Remote \& flexible work:** Work from almost anywhere\*. Enjoy flexible hours and asynchronous work to balance work and life.  


	+ Check out the countries we currently hire from here.
* **Remote work budget:** €1,000 available each year, or up to €2,000 from day 1 if you're buying a laptop!
* **Growth \& development:** Invest in yourself and your career with a 3\.5% L\&D budget per year and clear growth opportunities.
* **Parent/Caregiver support:** We provide a caregiver\-friendly work environment with paid 8\-16 week parental leave and tailored return\-to\-work approaches.
* **Work\-life balance:** Our unlimited and flexible time off policy empowers you to take the time you need to recharge and maintain your well\-being.

**Interested?**
---------------


At TestGorilla, we believe your skills speak louder than your resume. That's why we champion a skills\-first approach, using cutting\-edge, AI\-powered assessments to uncover your true skills and experience match.


When you apply, you'll get to experience our platform firsthand by taking an assessment – it's your invitation to shine and show us what you can do! While our platform is powered by AI, every hiring decision is made by humans. Check out our Applicant Privacy document to see how we protect your data.


Given the hiring sprint timeline above, we'd love to see your application land before September 20\.

**Concerned about test anxiety or need help with the assessment?** We've got you covered. Please check out our candidate support page for any questions. Accommodations are readily available as part of the assessment setup, and requesting support will never impact your application.

title: Senior Manager – Founder’s Office (HR)
description:
**About Ditto** 




 Ditto’s mission is to help people make well\-informed insurance decisions — from expert advisory and policy purchases to dedicated claim support. We pioneered the industry\-first “No\-spam” policy, and over the past three years, we’ve assisted over 700,000 users with personalised advice on health and term insurance. We carry a 4\.9 rating with 14,000\+ reviews on Google.
 



 Ditto is part of the Finshots family (500K\+ subscribers) and is backed by Zerodha, India’s largest stockbroker. We won LinkedIn’s Top Startup award in both 2022 and 2023\.
 



  





**The Context** 




 In 2024, Ditto was a team of 350\. By 2025, we were 700\. Today, we’re at 1,400 — and we’ll cross 2,000 by the start of 2027\.
 



 Ditto is a service company. Our people are our product — the quality of advice we give customers is only as good as the people giving it. How well we hire, how well we retain good talent, and how well we develop them directly determines how well the company grows. At our scale, getting this wrong isn’t a minor inefficiency — it’s an existential risk.
 



 Growth at this pace breaks things. Hiring processes that worked at 350 don’t hold at 1,400\. Retention strategies that were informal now need structure. Performance systems that were manager\-dependent now need to be organisation\-wide. This role exists to fix what’s breaking and to build what doesn’t exist yet.
 



  





**The Role** 




 You will report to the HR Lead and work closely with the co\-founders on two critical problem areas. Depending on your experience and expertise, you’ll own one of these:
 



  





**Problem Area 1: Hiring at Speed Without Dropping the Bar** 




 We need to close roles faster while ensuring quality doesn’t slip. This means:
 


* Redesigning hiring workflows to reduce time\-to\-close across roles
* Building reliable, sustainable sourcing channels that don’t depend on a single pipeline
* Identifying bottlenecks in the current process and implementing fixes that hold at scale



  





**Problem Area 2: Talent Management \& Retention for a 2,500\-Person Organisation** 




 Our current people systems were built for a much smaller team. This means:
 


* Revamping talent management frameworks — performance cycles, career progression, development paths
* Rethinking employee retention policies so they work at 2,500 people, not just 700
* Ensuring our systems are robust enough to run smoothly as the organisation continues to scale



  





**How This Role Evolves** 




 The first six months will be about understanding how our current systems operate, identifying what needs to change, and designing better ones — but not just on paper. We expect you to start executing early. You’ll work closely with the co\-founders and HR team to get the foundations right, but you’ll also be measured on what you ship, not just what you propose.
 



 After six months, based on how things shape up, this role could go one of two ways: you take ownership of the entire function you’ve built, or you move to the next 0\-to\-1 problem. The same applies to team structure — whether this becomes a team\-lead role or stays as a high\-impact IC will depend on the work and your trajectory.
 



  





**What We’re Looking For** 



* 4\+ years of experience in HR business partnering, people operations, org consulting, or a generalist Founder’s Office role with strong HR exposure
* Experience in a startup that went through a significant scaling phase, or at an established company with a large, complex team — you’ve seen what happens when organisations grow fast
* Deep understanding of HR systems and people processes — not just theory, but how things actually work on the ground
* Strong analytical ability with comfort working with people data and dashboards
* Clear, structured communicator who can influence both leadership and cross\-functional teams
* High ownership mindset — you operate independently and drive outcomes without waiting for direction
* Ability to build relationships, earn trust quickly, and navigate ambiguity with confidence



  





**A note on what this role is not:** 
 We’re not looking for someone who advises from the sidelines. This role requires you to get your hands dirty — to design systems, yes, but also to execute projects on your own when needed. If you’re looking for a pure advisory or consulting role, this isn’t the right fit.
 



  





**Why Join Ditto** 



* Work on high\-priority problems with direct business impact — not maintenance work
* A front\-row seat to how a fast\-growing startup scales its people function
* Exposure to multiple verticals and a real path to leadership roles
* Direct access to co\-founders and the opportunity to shape how the organisation operates



  





**Perks** 



* Comprehensive health and term insurance
* ESOPs
* Compensation as per industry standards



  





**Our Interview Process** 




 We respect your time. There are 4 rounds, and we aim to complete all of them within 2 weeks.
 


1. Introductory call with HR
2. Task submission
3. Task presentation \+ Managerial round
4. Founders round



  





**This is an in\-office role (with flexibility for remote working). Our address is:** 
 Fortuna\-1, No 680, 15th Cross, J.P Nagar 2nd Phase, J P Nagar, Bangalore, Bangalore South – 560078, Karnataka, India.
 



  





***Please Note:***
*Beware of recruitment scams. Ditto does not charge any fees for the hiring process. We’ve seen fraudulent hiring messages impersonating Ditto. Please verify any communication through our official channels.*

title: Financial Analysis & Marketing
description:
**Job Description \- Financial Analysis \& Marketing**

**Location\-**Mulund/Malad\-Mumbai

**About the Company**

We are a Corporate Finance and Loan Syndication Advisory firm specializing in Debt Syndication, Working Capital Finance, Project Finance, Equipment Finance, Invoice Discounting, CGTMSE Loans, Builder Finance, NPA Resolution, Surety Bonds, NCDs ,Credit rating enhancement and Structured Financial Solutions. We work closely with banks, NBFCs, AIFs, financial institutions, and corporates across India.

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a highly motivated MBA (Finance/Marketing) to join our Corporate Finance team. The role offers hands\-on exposure to financial analysis, credit appraisal, loan syndication, business development, client relationship management, and interaction with leading banks and financial institutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Financial Analysis**

\- Analyse financial statements, CMA data, bank statements, and business performance.

\- Prepare financial models, ratio analysis, cash flow projections, and project feasibility reports.

\- Assist in preparing credit appraisal notes and lender information memorandums.

\- Conduct industry, market, and competitor research.

\- Support preparation of presentations, investment notes, and loan proposals.

\- Coordinate with clients for financial information and documentation.

**Loan Syndication**

\- Assist in structuring Working Capital, Term Loans, Project Finance, and Unsecured Business Loans.

\- Coordinate with Banks, NBFCs, and Financial Institutions throughout the loan process.

\- Track sanctions, documentation, disbursements, and post\-disbursement compliance.

\- Maintain MIS of ongoing transactions.

**Marketing \& Business Development**

\- Generate and qualify leads through networking, digital platforms, referrals, and corporate outreach.

\- Participate in client meetings, presentations, and business discussions.

\- Develop relationships with Chartered Accountants, Company Secretaries, Builders, SMEs, and Corporate Clients.

\- Support digital marketing campaigns, LinkedIn outreach, and email marketing initiatives.

\- Conduct market research to identify new business opportunities.

**Documentation \& Reporting**

\- Prepare proposals, reports, pitch decks, and client presentations.

\- Maintain CRM records and transaction databases.

\- Ensure timely follow\-up with clients and lending institutions.

**Eligibility**

\- MBA/PGDM in Finance, Marketing, or equivalent (Freshers welcome).

\- Strong academic background with interest in Corporate Finance and Banking.

**Desired Skills**

\- Understanding of Financial Statements and Ratio Analysis.

\- Knowledge of Excel, PowerPoint, and MS Office.

\- Excellent communication and presentation skills.

\- Analytical and problem\-solving ability.

\- Willingness to travel for client meetings.

\- Self\-driven, disciplined, and eager to learn.

**Preferred Knowledge**

Exposure to any of the following will be an added advantage:

\- Corporate Finance

\- Loan Syndication

\- Credit Analysis

\- Project Finance

\- Working Capital Assessment

\- CMA Data Preparation

\- Banking Products

\- Financial Modelling

\- RBI Guidelines

\- Accounts and tally

\- GST and Basic Taxation

\-AI, Chat GPT Perplexity etc

**Career Growth**

Successful candidates will receive structured training and can grow into roles such as:

\- Assistant Manager Corporate Finance

\-Manager Corporate Finance

Job Title\- **Corporate Finance Analyst**

**Compensation**

\- Competitive fixed salary

\- Performance\-based incentives

\- Training and mentorship from industry professionals

title: Product Analyst Intern
description:
**Product Analyst Intern**

**Remote (Kochi) \| ₹5,000 Monthly Stipend \| Fresher\-Friendly**

Don't just design screens. Help build the product.

A good product starts with understanding a problem, seeing it from the user's perspective, asking the right questions and finding a solution that works.

At Nexeor, you'll work closely with our Head of Operations across websites, SaaS, ERP, CRM and e\-commerce products — learning what happens beyond the Figma file and how ideas become real products.

**What Your Journey Will Look Like**

* Start with the problem — Understand the requirement, the user and the problem worth solving.
* Think through the experience — Shape features, user journeys and interfaces into practical product concepts.
* Build and experiment — Use modern AI tools to research, prototype and bring ideas to life.
* Challenge the obvious — Study competitors, trends and product data to find better solutions.
* Build with the team — Work with Design, Development and QA to turn concepts into real products.

**What We're Looking For**

*You don't need to arrive as a product expert.*

We're looking for someone who:

* Has a genuine interest in UI/UX, Products or Technology.
* Thinks from the user's perspective and enjoys solving problems.
* Has a basic understanding of digital products and interfaces.
* Is curious about AI, websites, SaaS, e\-commerce and modern technology.
* Communicates ideas clearly and is comfortable asking questions.
* Learns quickly, experiments and takes initiative.
* Brings full\-on power, curiosity and the drive to build.

**What You'll Learn**

This isn't an internship where you'll simply observe from the sidelines. You'll gain practical exposure to:

* Product Thinking — Understanding users, problems and business requirements.
* UI/UX \& Prototyping — Turning ideas into user flows, interfaces and prototypes.
* AI\-Assisted Product Building — Using modern AI tools to research, experiment and build faster.
* Analytics \& Research — Using product data, competitors and trends to make better decisions.
* Product Collaboration — Working with Design, Development and QA to take ideas from concept to reality.
* Real\-World Products — Contributing to websites, SaaS, ERP, CRM and e\-commerce projects.

title: Quality Inspector
description:
Job Description – PCB Quality EngineerPosition

**PCB Quality Engineer**

Department

Quality Assurance / Quality Control

Reports To

Quality Manager / Production Head

**Job Purpose**

The PCB Quality Engineer is responsible for ensuring that **Printed Circuit Boards (PCBs)** are manufactured according to approved customer specifications, Gerber data, drawings, IPC standards, and internal quality procedures.

The engineer will monitor quality from **raw material inspection to final PCB inspection and dispatch**.

1\. Incoming Material Quality Inspection

* Inspect incoming copper\-clad laminates (CCL), prepreg, copper foil, chemicals, solder mask, legend ink, and other materials.
* Verify material specifications against purchase orders and approved specifications.
* Check material thickness, copper thickness, dimensions, and physical condition.
* Maintain incoming inspection records.
* Raise NCR for rejected or non\-conforming material.
* Coordinate with Purchase and suppliers for quality issues.

2\. Gerber \& Engineering Data Verification

* Verify customer Gerber files, drawings, specifications, and manufacturing requirements.
* Check PCB dimensions and tolerances.
* Verify layer details for single\-sided and double\-sided PCBs.
* Review drill data, hole sizes, slots, cut\-outs, and routing requirements.
* Verify copper thickness and finished board thickness.
* Check solder mask and legend requirements.
* Ensure the correct revision is released to production.

3\. In\-Process Quality Control

Monitor quality at different stages of PCB manufacturing:

Cutting \& Material Preparation

* Check panel size and material identification.
* Verify laminate thickness.

Drilling

* Check drill diameter and hole accuracy.
* Monitor burrs, breakout, and hole quality.
* Verify PTH and NPTH requirements.

Imaging / Etching

* Check track width and spacing.
* Inspect for open circuits and short circuits.
* Monitor over\-etching and under\-etching.
* Check unwanted copper and pattern accuracy.

Plating

* Monitor copper plating quality and thickness.
* Check hole\-wall coverage for plated\-through holes.
* Identify voids, pits, nodules, and other defects.

Solder Mask

* Check solder\-mask coverage and alignment.
* Inspect for pinholes, scratches, bubbles, and exposed unwanted copper.
* Verify solder\-mask registration.

Legend / Silkscreen

* Check text accuracy and readability.
* Verify alignment with the approved artwork.

Routing / V\-Groove

* Verify board dimensions.
* Check cut\-outs, slots, edge routing, and V\-groove dimensions.
* Ensure there are no burrs or mechanical damages.

4\. Final PCB Inspection

Inspect finished PCBs for:

* Correct dimensions
* Board thickness
* Copper thickness
* Hole diameter
* PTH and NPTH quality
* Track width and spacing
* Open and short circuits
* Etching defects
* Plating quality
* Solder mask defects
* Silkscreen accuracy
* Surface finish quality
* Scratches and physical damage
* Cut\-outs and slots
* Routing quality
* Warpage and bow/twist
* Cleanliness

Ensure final PCB meets the approved **Gerber data, drawings, customer specifications, and applicable IPC acceptance criteria**.

5\. Electrical Testing

* Conduct or coordinate continuity testing.
* Perform open\-circuit and short\-circuit testing.
* Use appropriate electrical test fixtures or test equipment.
* Maintain electrical test records.
* Ensure defective PCBs are identified and segregated.

6\. Non\-Conformance \& Rejection Control

* Identify and segregate rejected PCBs.
* Prepare **NCR (Non\-Conformance Report)**.
* Record defects and rejection quantities.
* Coordinate with Production to control further defects.
* Monitor rework and scrap.
* Maintain rejection analysis reports.

7\. Root Cause Analysis \& Corrective Action

Analyze repeated quality issues using:

* **5 Why Analysis**
* **Fishbone Diagram**
* **Pareto Analysis**
* **CAPA – Corrective and Preventive Action**

Common PCB defects to analyze include:

* Open circuit
* Short circuit
* Under\-etching
* Over\-etching
* Drill breakout
* Plating void
* Solder mask defects
* Copper peel\-off
* Scratch
* Wrong dimensions
* Warpage
* Incorrect Gerber revision

8\. Customer Complaint Handling

* Receive and record customer quality complaints.
* Analyze returned/rejected PCBs.
* Identify the root cause.
* Coordinate with Production and Engineering.
* Prepare corrective action reports.
* Follow up until complaint closure.
* Maintain customer complaint and rejection records.

9\. Quality Documentation

Maintain:

* Incoming Material Inspection Reports
* In\-Process Inspection Reports
* Final Inspection Reports
* Electrical Test Reports
* NCR Reports
* CAPA Reports
* Customer Complaint Reports
* Rejection Reports
* Supplier Quality Records
* Inspection Checklists
* SOPs and Work Instructions
* Calibration Records

Key Performance Indicators (KPI)KPITarget / MeasurementCustomer rejectionMinimum / Zero major rejectionInternal rejectionReduction in rejection %ReworkReduction in rework %Final inspectionHigh first\-pass acceptanceCustomer complaintsMinimum complaintsNCR closureClosed within defined timelineRepeat defectsContinuous reductionInspection accuracy100% as per inspection planDocumentation100% complete and updatedCalibration compliance100% valid instrumentsRequired Qualification

* Diploma / BE / B.Tech in **Electronics, Electrical, Mechanical, Production, or Manufacturing Engineering**.
* PCB manufacturing experience preferred.
* Freshers with good electronics and quality knowledge may also be considered.

Required Skills

* Understanding of **Bare PCB Manufacturing Process**
* Gerber file and PCB drawing understanding
* Knowledge of single\-sided and double\-sided PCBs
* Knowledge of PCB defects
* Measuring instruments
* Vernier caliper and micrometer
* PCB inspection techniques
* Root Cause Analysis
* 5 Why and Fishbone Analysis
* NCR and CAPA
* MS Excel and quality documentation
* Basic knowledge of **IPC standards** preferred

Overall Responsibility

**To ensure that every PCB manufactured and dispatched meets the approved customer requirements, Gerber specifications, dimensional requirements, electrical performance requirements, and applicable quality standards while continuously reducing rejection, rework, and customer complaints.**

 Build defined components of RAG pipelines, agents, and LLM/SLM\-backed features from specs handed off by senior engineers.

 Team player — collaborates well in a hybrid setup with distributed (US/India/APAC) colleagues.

 Personal projects, open\-source contributions, or hackathon work involving LLMs/GenAI.
   

  

 Exposure to Big Data tools (Spark/Hive) or basic ML/data science coursework.
   

  

 Any experience, even academic, with model evaluation or prompt engineering.
   

  

 Contribution to open source projects, academic papers published, filled patents What You will Gain.
   

  

 Direct mentorship from senior Application Engineers and Technical Program Leads on real enterprise GenAI/SLM engagements.
   

  

 Hands\-on exposure to air\-gapped/sovereign AI deployments — a niche, high\-value skill set.
   

  

 A fast track to owning full features independently within 12\-18 months.

title: System Software Engineer - Performance Verification Infrastructure
description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self\-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.
   

  

 Join NVIDIA's GPU Performance Infrastructure team and be part of a brand\-new journey in validating and shipping next\-generation GPU architectures. At NVIDIA, we empower our engineers to innovate and drive powerful performance through innovative infrastructure and workflows. This role is uniquely positioned to influence the entire lifecycle of GPU performance verification, from early\-stage modelling to post\-silicon validation. With our bold standards and extraordinary team, you'll have the chance to define a significant impact on the future of computing!
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Design and maintain automated chip performance verification pipelines spanning workload trace generation, multi\-target test execution, results post\-processing, and correlation with architectural performance targets.
* Develop performance monitoring and measurement infrastructure that provides consistent observability across simulation, emulation, and silicon environments.
* Build scalable data pipelines and full\-stack dashboards to ingest, visualize, and compare performance metrics across builds and environments.
* Coordinate with GPU architects to craft infrastructure for performance verification of upcoming architectures.
* Work closely with HW teams to automate and accelerate verification workflows, enabling faster GPU build iteration.
* Empower GPU architects by providing insights to understand current performance and model industry\-leading performance for future builds.
* Improve the daily workflows of the world's top chip architects, contributing to the creation of the next greatest generation of GPUs!


**What We Need To See**
* BS/MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* 3\+ years of software engineering experience, primarily in C\+\+, with Python for tooling and automation.
* Strong CS fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, OOP, and system design.
* Full\-stack experience with backend (Java/Python), REST APIs, and modern frontend (React/Ember) for data\-intensive applications is a plus.
* Proficiency in databases (SQL, MongoDB) for metrics storage and querying is a plus.
* Hands\-on experience with Git, CI/CD, Kubernetes, Docker, and messaging systems (RabbitMQ) is a plus.
* Exposure to GPU/CPU/SoC chip performance verification is a plus.
* Familiarity with AI development tools.
* Excellent interpersonal skills.

description:

icogz is a technology company focused on building innovative digital solutions that help businesses improve operations, streamline processes, and make informed decisions. We are looking for a detail\-oriented and eager\-to\-learn **WordPress/CMS Intern** to join our team on a 3\-month internship, with a clear pathway to a full\-time role based on performance and business requirements.

This role is focused on **WordPress CMS administration** — publishing and maintaining website content, keeping pages and blogs updated, and supporting the quality and structure of our web properties. It's a great starting point for someone who wants hands\-on experience with real websites and a foundation in web fundamentals like **HTML** and **CSS**.

Key ResponsibilitiesContent Publishing \& CMS Administration

* Perform day\-to\-day **CMS administration** tasks within **WordPress**, including **page/blog creation** and formatting content for publication.
* Handle **media upload** of images, documents, and other assets, ensuring files are optimized and properly organized.
* Maintain consistency in layout, formatting, and style across published pages and posts.
* Support ongoing **website maintenance**, including content updates, minor edits, and routine housekeeping tasks.

Quality Assurance \& Testing

* Conduct **cross\-device QA** to confirm pages display and function correctly across desktop, tablet, and mobile.
* Perform **broken link testing** across the website and coordinate fixes for any issues found.
* Carry out general **content QA**, checking for typos, formatting errors, broken layouts, and inconsistencies before and after publishing.
* Review and help maintain **navigation/menu structure** to ensure the site stays organized and easy to navigate.

SEO \& On\-Page Optimization

* Apply **SEO basics** to published content, including keyword\-aware titles and headings.
* Write and update **meta descriptions** for pages and posts.
* Add and maintain **alt tags** for images to support accessibility and search visibility.
* Support **internal linking** between related pages and blog posts to improve site structure and user navigation.

Technical Support

* Use basic **HTML** and **CSS** to make small formatting adjustments within the CMS as needed.
* Assist with troubleshooting minor content or display issues, escalating technical problems where appropriate.

Collaboration

* Work closely with the marketing, content, and design teams to publish content accurately and on schedule.
* Communicate progress, questions, and blockers clearly with your team.
* Stay curious and proactive about learning more of the WordPress ecosystem over time.

Required Skills

* Basic understanding of **WordPress** and general **CMS administration** concepts.
* Comfort with **page/blog creation** and formatting content within a CMS environment.
* Basic knowledge of **HTML** and **CSS**.
* An eye for detail, especially for **content QA** and spotting inconsistencies.
* Good communication and organizational skills.
* Willingness to learn and take feedback in a fast\-paced environment.

Preferred Skills

* Familiarity with **SEO basics**, including **meta descriptions**, **alt tags**, and **internal linking**.
* Prior exposure to **broken link testing** or **cross\-device QA** processes.
* Basic understanding of **navigation/menu structure** and information architecture.
* Any personal projects, coursework, or portfolio involving WordPress or website content management.

Qualifications

* Pursuing or recently completed a degree, diploma, or certification in Computer Science, Information Technology, Digital Marketing, Web Development, or a related field.
* 0–1 years of experience; freshers and students are encouraged to apply.
* Equivalent self\-taught experience, certifications, or bootcamp training will also be considered.

Employment Details

* **Employment Type:** Internship (3 Months)
* **Work Mode:** On\-site
* **Location:** Mumbai, India

What We Offer

* Hands\-on experience managing real websites within a live WordPress environment.
* Mentorship and guidance from experienced professionals.
* Exposure to content publishing, CMS administration, and on\-page SEO practices.
* A collaborative, fast\-paced work environment.
* Potential conversion to a full\-time role based on performance and business needs.

How to Apply

Please share your resume and any relevant coursework, projects, or links to websites you've contributed to.

We work across **2D and 3D game development, Unity, Unreal Engine, game design, UI/UX, animation, 3D modeling, multiplayer development, optimization, and QA**.

You will get practical exposure to gameplay programming, game mechanics, UI integration, debugging, optimization, and other aspects of the game development process.

* Knowledge of physics and particle systems.
* Android game development/build experience.
* Basic knowledge of multiplayer game development.
* Experience with **Photon / Photon Fusion**.

Who Can Apply?

* Freshers

* Recent graduates

What You Will Learn

title: Analyst — Threat Research & Client Reporting
description:
About BrandLock

BrandLock is a revenue\-protection platform for e\-commerce merchants. We stop unwanted browser extensions and injected scripts — ads, coupon overlays, competitor price comparisons — from hijacking our clients’ online stores and leaking their revenue.

The Role

This role has two sides, and we want to be upfront about both.

**Roughly 70–80% of your time** is threat research: identifying and classifying the adware, malware and unwanted extensions injecting content into our clients’ websites, and working out how to block them. You will investigate unfamiliar domains, inspect pages in browser developer tools, test extension behaviour, and work with QA to confirm what you found is genuinely blocked in production.

**The remaining 20–30%** is client\-facing reporting and analytics. When clients need reporting, you will work in Google Analytics 4, verify that dashboards and tracking are correct, capture and package evidence of what we blocked, and communicate the findings to clients over email.

We do not expect you to arrive knowing how to classify malware — that is what we will teach you. What you need to bring is **strong logical reasoning**, the ability to draw sound analytical conclusions from data, and clear written English.

What You’ll Do

**Threat research and classification — the majority of the role**

* Analyse and categorise adware, malware and unwanted extensions by behaviour, type and risk level
* Classify resources collected from client sites at the domain and subdomain level — legitimate, unwanted, malicious or unknown
* Research unfamiliar domains in depth: who runs them, how they make money, and whether they belong on a client’s site
* Propose ways to block injected content — HTML/CSS selectors, DOM mutation detection, domain\-level blocking, or new approaches you research yourself
* Investigate extensions that stop being blocked or start evading detection, and find the root cause
* Work with the QA team to validate every blocking rule before release
* Write scripts and queries to automate parts of the classification workflow, and document findings clearly

**Client reporting and analytics — when client requirements come in**

* Work in Google Analytics 4 to produce the analysis behind client reports
* Verify that tracking and dashboards are correct — events firing as expected, metrics defined properly, numbers reconciling
* Investigate discrepancies between GA4, our internal dashboards and client\-side figures
* Capture, annotate and organise screenshot evidence of blocked injections for client reports
* Write clear, professional emails to clients explaining findings and answering questions about their numbers
* Audit reports and dashboards before they reach a client

What You’ll Need

* 0–2 years of experience — **freshers are encouraged to apply**. Bachelor’s degree in any discipline
* **Strong logical reasoning.** You can reach a defensible conclusion from partial evidence and explain how you got there. This is the single most important requirement
* **Analytical ability with data.** You can look at a set of numbers, work out what they do and do not show, and notice when something looks wrong
* **Clear written English.** You will email clients directly; professional, jargon\-free writing is essential
* Genuine research instinct and real attention to detail
* Fundamental knowledge of HTML, CSS and JavaScript
* Comfort with browser developer tools
* Working familiarity with Excel or Google Sheets

Nice to Have

*None of these are required. We will teach the domain knowledge.*

* Any hands\-on exposure to Google Analytics 4

 India is in the middle of an extraordinary AI revolution, powered by a young, tech\-savvy generation and visionary leaders who see the future in code and creativity. **About the Role** 








 At Neysa, our SOC Analysts are the first line of defence in our security ecosystem. title: Product Engineer — AI-Native Development
description:
**Company:** Vardaam Web Solutions Pvt. Ltd.

**Location:** Onsite

**Experience Level:** Open to both exceptional Freshers and Experienced Professionals

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Product Engineer who can use AI as a core part of the development workflow to turn ideas into production\-ready SaaS products. You will work across product thinking, development, testing, debugging, and delivery—not just writing code.

AI will write a significant portion of the code. Your responsibility is to give it the right direction, review what it produces, verify that it actually works, and make the right product and engineering decisions.

**Our Philosophy**

We believe the future of software development is AI\-native. The advantage is not simply using AI to write code faster; it is knowing what to build, how to instruct AI effectively, and how to recognize when its output is wrong. We value engineers who can ship more product without compromising correctness, usability, or quality.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Take features and modules from idea → specification → development → testing → production.
* Use AI coding agents extensively for development, debugging, testing, research, and refactoring.
* Review and validate AI\-generated code rather than blindly accepting it.
* Build and integrate frontend, backend, APIs, databases, third\-party services, and automated tests.
* Identify edge cases, incorrect assumptions, security issues, and scalability problems.
* Make practical product decisions about what to build, simplify, or not build.
* Work independently within existing codebases and take ownership of what you ship.
* Continuously improve how our team builds and ships products using AI.

**Qualifications \& Requirements**

**1\. The Foundation**

Strong software engineering fundamentals with the ability to understand requirements, design solutions, debug systems, work with APIs/databases, and build reliable production software.

**2\. The AI Edge**

AI should already be part of how you build. You should know how to break problems down for AI agents, provide context, iterate effectively, and critically review their output.

**3\. The Tooling**

Hands\-on experience with tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar AI development tools is highly valued. You should be comfortable learning new tools quickly.

**4\. For Freshers**

Strong projects, internships, open\-source work, or personal products can demonstrate your ability. We care about what you have built, how you built it, and how effectively you use AI, not just your academic background.

**5\. For Experienced**

Demonstrated experience shipping real products or SaaS applications and working independently across a codebase. You should be able to make engineering and product decisions without depending on detailed instructions or constant supervision.

description:
**Job DescriptionJob** 

Title: Marketing Manager

**Company:** NEXASEC Cyber Solution

**Website:** nexasec.in

**Location:** Remote

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

**Open Positions:** 1

About NexaSec

NexaSec is a cybersecurity services company helping businesses protect their digital assets through Vulnerability Assessments, Penetration Testing (VAPT), Security Audits, Compliance Consulting, Managed Security Services, and Cybersecurity Awareness Training.

We help organisations identify security risks, improve their cybersecurity posture, address vulnerabilities, meet compliance requirements, and build stronger security practices.

Role Overview

We are looking for a creative, analytical, and results\-oriented **Marketing Manager** to develop and execute marketing strategies that increase NexaSec's brand visibility, generate business opportunities, strengthen our online presence, and support overall company growth.

The Marketing Manager will plan marketing campaigns, manage digital marketing activities, create and coordinate content, support lead\-generation initiatives, analyse marketing performance, and build NexaSec's presence across relevant digital platforms.

The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of digital marketing, content strategy, social media, SEO, lead generation, and B2B marketing, along with an interest in cybersecurity and technology.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop and implement marketing strategies aligned with NexaSec's business objectives.
* Plan and execute digital marketing campaigns for cybersecurity services.
* Develop marketing strategies for services such as VAPT, security audits, compliance consulting, MSSP, and cybersecurity awareness training.
* Manage and strengthen NexaSec's online brand presence.
* Plan and manage social media marketing activities.
* Create and coordinate professional cybersecurity\-related content.
* Develop content for LinkedIn, website pages, blogs, articles, newsletters, and other relevant platforms.
* Research cybersecurity industry trends, market developments, and competitor activities.
* Identify target industries, customer segments, and potential markets.
* Develop campaigns designed to generate qualified business leads.
* Coordinate with the Business Development team to support lead\-generation activities.
* Support email marketing and professional outreach campaigns.
* Develop content and campaigns for specific target industries and customer segments.
* Manage the company's content calendar and marketing schedule.
* Coordinate with designers, developers, cybersecurity professionals, and business development teams.
* Review marketing materials to ensure accuracy, consistency, and professional presentation.
* Improve website content and support website\-based marketing activities.
* Assist with SEO strategy, keyword research, and content optimisation.
* Monitor website traffic, social media performance, campaign engagement, and lead\-generation metrics.
* Analyse marketing campaign performance and identify areas for improvement.
* Prepare regular marketing performance reports.
* Maintain consistent branding across marketing channels.
* Identify new marketing channels, platforms, and business opportunities.
* Support webinars, online events, awareness campaigns, conferences, and other promotional activities.
* Build NexaSec's authority and visibility within the cybersecurity industry.
* Develop partnerships and promotional opportunities where appropriate.
* Stay updated on cybersecurity industry trends and use relevant developments in marketing campaigns.

Daily Activities

* Review ongoing marketing campaigns and their performance.
* Research cybersecurity news, trends, and industry developments.
* Research competitors and their marketing strategies.
* Plan and create social media content.
* Coordinate with the technical team for cybersecurity\-related content.
* Prepare or review blogs, articles, posts, newsletters, and marketing materials.
* Manage the marketing content calendar.
* Monitor website and social media analytics.
* Research potential target industries and customer segments.
* Coordinate with the Business Development team on lead\-generation campaigns.
* Review email marketing and outreach campaigns.
* Track campaign engagement and lead\-generation results.
* Identify new marketing opportunities.
* Participate in team meetings and provide marketing updates.
* Maintain documentation of marketing activities and results.

Skills Required

* Strong understanding of digital marketing fundamentals.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong content creation and editing skills.
* Understanding of social media marketing.
* Knowledge of B2B marketing strategies.
* Understanding of lead\-generation concepts.
* Basic knowledge of SEO and content marketing.
* Strong research and analytical skills.
* Ability to develop and execute marketing campaigns.
* Good project and time\-management skills.
* Ability to analyse marketing performance and metrics.
* Strong creativity and ability to develop new marketing ideas.
* Good understanding of branding and professional communication.
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
* Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
* Willingness to learn about cybersecurity and technology.
* Ability to collaborate with technical, sales, and management teams.

Preferred Skills

Knowledge or experience in any of the following will be an advantage:

* Digital marketing
* B2B marketing
* Content marketing
* Social media marketing
* LinkedIn marketing
* SEO
* Search Engine Marketing (SEM)
* Email marketing
* Lead generation
* Marketing analytics
* Google Analytics
* Google Search Console
* Social media analytics
* WordPress or other CMS platforms
* Canva or similar design tools
* Basic graphic design
* Video/content marketing
* Marketing automation
* CRM platforms
* Competitor research
* Cybersecurity or technology marketing
* IT services marketing
* SaaS marketing
* Brand management

Candidates do not need to have experience with all of these tools or areas. Strong marketing fundamentals, creativity, analytical thinking, communication skills, and willingness to learn are more important.

Eligibility

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, Management, Commerce, Digital Marketing, or a related field is preferred.
* Candidates with relevant marketing, digital marketing, content, or brand\-management experience are encouraged to apply.
* Candidates with experience in B2B, IT, technology, SaaS, or cybersecurity marketing will be preferred.
* Candidates with relevant marketing projects, campaigns, portfolios, or certifications are encouraged to apply.
* Freshers with strong marketing knowledge and practical project experience may also be considered.
* Candidates should have access to a computer/laptop and a reliable internet connection for remote work.

What You'll Learn

* B2B cybersecurity marketing
* Digital marketing strategy
* Cybersecurity industry marketing
* Content marketing
* Social media marketing
* LinkedIn marketing
* SEO and content optimization
* Lead\-generation campaigns
* Email marketing
* Marketing analytics
* Brand positioning
* Competitor and market research
* Campaign planning and execution
* Marketing performance analysis
* Client and industry research
* Professional technology marketing practices
* Working with cybersecurity and business development teams

Performance Goals (First 30 Days)

The Marketing Manager should aim to:

* Develop a clear understanding of NexaSec's services and target markets.
* Understand the company's existing marketing channels and brand positioning.
* Develop a structured marketing plan aligned with business objectives.
* Establish or improve the company's content calendar.
* Create and publish consistent, professional marketing content.
* Identify relevant target industries and customer segments.
* Research competitors and cybersecurity market trends.
* Develop initial campaigns to improve brand visibility.
* Support lead\-generation initiatives in coordination with Business Development.
* Establish measurable marketing KPIs.
* Track website, social media, and campaign performance.
* Prepare regular marketing performance reports.
* Identify opportunities to improve NexaSec's digital presence.
* Demonstrate consistent progress toward agreed marketing objectives.

Performance goals may vary depending on business requirements, marketing priorities, and the candidate's experience.

Why Join NexaSec?

* Opportunity to work with a growing cybersecurity services company.
* Practical experience in cybersecurity and technology marketing.
* Exposure to real\-world B2B marketing activities.
* Opportunity to work with cybersecurity professionals and business development teams.
* Develop digital marketing and brand\-management skills.
* Opportunity to build a professional marketing portfolio.
* Exposure to cybersecurity industry trends and technologies.
* Opportunity to work on campaigns targeting businesses across different industries.
* Remote working environment.
* Performance\-based growth opportunities.
* High\-performing employees may be considered for increased responsibilities and leadership opportunities based on business requirements and performance.

Important Professional Requirement

All marketing activities must be conducted professionally and in accordance with applicable laws, company policies, platform policies, and ethical marketing practices.

Employees are expected to protect NexaSec's confidential information, client information, business data, marketing strategies, internal processes, and other company information.

Marketing campaigns, content, email communications, lead\-generation activities, and promotional materials must use legitimate and authorised sources and must follow applicable privacy, data\-protection, anti\-spam, and platform requirements.

All cybersecurity\-related marketing content must be accurate, professionally presented, and reviewed appropriately before publication.

How to Apply

Send your resume through Indeed. Candidates are encouraged to include links to their **LinkedIn profile, marketing portfolio, previous campaigns, content samples, professional website, or relevant certifications**, if available.

**Subject:** Application – Marketing Manager

Please include a brief note explaining your interest in marketing, your relevant experience or projects, and why you would like to work with NexaSec.

**Work Location:** Remote

Pay: From ₹15,000\.00 per month

EcoKranti is an initiative of Art of Living focused on sustainable, socially impactful and environmentally responsible initiatives.

We are looking for a **reliable, energetic and detail\-oriented Packaging \& Logistics Executive** to support our day\-to\-day packaging, dispatch and logistics operations.

The role is ideal for someone who is comfortable with **hands\-on work, packing materials, coordinating deliveries, maintaining basic records and ensuring that products/materials reach the right destination safely and on time.**

Role Overview

The candidate will be responsible for:

**Picking → Checking → Packing → Labelling → Dispatch → Tracking → Delivery Coordination**

The person will work closely with the **Warehouse, Operations, Purchase and Accounts teams** to ensure smooth movement of materials.

Key Responsibilities1\. Packaging

* Pack products/materials safely and appropriately as per requirements.
* Check quantity and condition of items before packing.
* Ensure correct products are packed against the order/request.
* Use appropriate cartons, boxes, tapes, wrapping and other packaging materials.
* Label packages correctly with destination and shipment details.
* Ensure fragile or sensitive items are packed with appropriate protection.
* Check packages before sealing and dispatch.
* Maintain cleanliness and organization of the packing area.

2\. Picking \& Material Handling

* Pick materials from the warehouse as per approved requirements.
* Verify item name, quantity and specifications before packing.
* Handle materials carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Assist in loading and unloading materials when required.
* Arrange packed materials systematically for dispatch.

3\. Dispatch \& Logistics

* Coordinate daily dispatches with the Warehouse/Operations team.
* Arrange courier, transport or local delivery services as instructed.
* Coordinate with drivers, courier partners and transporters.
* Ensure shipments are handed over on time.
* Track dispatched shipments and update delivery status.
* Follow up on delayed or pending deliveries.
* Coordinate returns, undelivered shipments and damaged packages.

4\. Documentation

Maintain basic records relating to:

* Packing
* Dispatch
* Delivery
* Courier bookings
* Material movement
* Packing materials
* Returns
* Damaged goods

Prepare and maintain:

* Packing lists
* Dispatch records
* Delivery challans, wherever applicable
* Courier/transport records
* Shipment tracking details

5\. Inventory \& Packaging Material

* Monitor availability of cartons, boxes, tapes, labels and other packing materials.
* Inform the supervisor when packaging materials are running low.
* Maintain proper storage of packing materials.
* Avoid unnecessary wastage of packaging materials.
* Assist with periodic physical stock verification.

6\. Quality \& Accuracy

Before every dispatch, ensure:

**Correct Product \+ Correct Quantity \+ Correct Packaging \+ Correct Label \+ Correct Destination**

* Identify damaged or incorrect materials before dispatch.
* Report discrepancies immediately to the Warehouse Manager/Supervisor.
* Ensure all packages are securely sealed before handing them over for transportation.

7\. Logistics Coordination

* Coordinate with courier companies and transporters.
* Compare shipment details with dispatch documents.
* Follow up for pickup schedules.
* Ensure timely vehicle/courier pickup.
* Maintain shipment tracking information.
* Escalate delivery delays or issues to the concerned supervisor.

8\. Team Support

As we scale, the volume of learners and conversations increases, but maintaining trust, clarity, and quality in each interaction becomes harder. This role exists to ensure that every learner interaction is thoughtful, consultative, and outcome\-driven, not transactional.

**The Role** As a Business Development Associate, you will work closely with learners to understand their goals and guide them toward the right programs. You will own the journey from the first conversation to final enrollment, ensuring clarity, trust, and a strong learner experience throughout.

This is a role built for people who are early in their careers and hungry to grow fast. We will give you the training, the environment, and the support. What we are looking for is the drive to make it count.

**What You'll Own**

* End\-to\-end learner conversations from first touchpoint to enrollment
* Understanding learner goals and guiding them with clarity and empathy
* Follow\-ups, objection handling, and decision support
* Maintaining quality and consistency across all interactions
* Accurate documentation of conversations, follow\-ups, and outcomes
* Building relationships through calls, events, and networking opportunities

**What Problems You'll Solve**

* Helping learners make informed decisions instead of rushed choices
* Reducing drop\-offs caused by confusion or lack of clarity
* Building trust in a high\-volume, fast\-moving sales environment
* Ensuring conversations are consultative, not script\-driven

**How This Role Evolves** In the initial phase, your focus will be on understanding the product, learner personas, and running effective conversations.

Over time, you will be expected to improve conversion quality, handle more complex conversations, and contribute to refining sales processes.

Based on performance, this role can evolve into owning larger pipelines, mentoring junior team members, or moving into high\-impact sales or growth roles.

**What We're Looking For**

* Fresh graduates, freshers with internship experience, or candidates with up to 10 months of experience
* Strong communication skills, both verbal and written
* Ability to build trust quickly and handle conversations with clarity
* Comfort working in a fast\-paced, target\-driven environment
* Ownership mindset, proactive and accountable
* A genuine interest in sales and helping people make the right decisions

*Nice to have:*

* Prior internship or experience in sales, inside sales, or customer\-facing roles
* Exposure to edtech or consultative sales environments

**Compensation and Growth**

* During the 3\-month probation period, the salary will be Rs. 17,000 to 20,000 per month, plus incentives
* On successful confirmation, your fixed pay increases by 90% to 150%, along with incentives
* This is a performance\-driven role, and your growth here is directly tied to the impact you create

**What This Role Is Not** This is not a script\-driven or transactional sales role.

We are not looking for someone who pushes for closures. We are looking for someone who understands learners, builds trust, and helps them make the right decisions.

**Why Join Airtribe**

* High\-impact role with direct business visibility from day one
* A clear and fast growth path in a performance\-driven environment
* Significant salary growth on confirmation
* Collaborative and ambitious team culture
* Comprehensive medical insurance

At Airtribe, Business Development is about building trust and driving meaningful outcomes, not just closing deals.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
Job Purpose

The primary responsibility of this role is to **develop and maintain strong professional relationships with doctors, hospitals, clinics, and healthcare professionals to generate patient referrals for Carebees Healthcare**.

The candidate will be responsible for increasing Carebees' visibility among the medical community, generating qualified patient leads, converting referrals into Carebees services, and contributing directly to **patient acquisition, revenue growth, and business expansion**.

The role requires regular field visits, relationship management, lead generation, follow\-ups, and achievement of monthly sales targets.

2\. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Doctor Referral \& Relationship Management

* Identify and develop relationships with:
* Orthopaedic surgeons
* Neurologists
* Neurosurgeons
* Physiotherapists
* General physicians
* Geriatricians
* PM\&R/Rehabilitation specialists
* Other relevant medical professionals
* Regularly visit doctors and clinics to introduce Carebees Healthcare services.
* Explain Carebees' home healthcare and physiotherapy services to doctors and their staff.
* Build long\-term professional relationships with doctors and referral partners.
* Maintain regular follow\-up with existing referring doctors.
* Ensure doctors are aware of Carebees' services, service areas, pricing, and patient\-care process.
* Identify opportunities for hospital and clinic referral partnerships.

B. Lead Generation

* Generate qualified patient leads through doctor and healthcare\-professional referrals.
* Collect complete patient information and referral details.
* Ensure every referral is immediately communicated to the Carebees operations/customer\-care team.
* Follow up on every lead until:
* **Referral → Contact → Assessment → Service Start → Conversion**
* Maintain accurate records of all leads and their status.
* Reactivate inactive or old referral sources.C. Sales \& Revenue Generation
* Achieve monthly and quarterly patient acquisition targets.
* Convert doctor referrals into paid Carebees services.
* Increase the number of active referring doctors every month.
* Focus on high\-value cases such as:
* Post\-operative physiotherapy
* TKR rehabilitation
* ACL rehabilitation
* Neurological rehabilitation
* Spine rehabilitation
* Geriatric physiotherapy
* Home physiotherapy
* Home nursing
* Long\-term rehabilitation
* Track revenue generated from each referral source.
* Identify high\-potential doctors and develop them into consistent referral partners.

D. Carebees Brand Visibility

* Increase Carebees' visibility within the local healthcare ecosystem.
* Introduce Carebees to new hospitals, clinics, doctors, nursing homes, senior\-living facilities and rehabilitation centres.
* Distribute Carebees brochures, visiting cards, service information and other approved marketing materials.
* Coordinate doctor awareness activities, professional meetings and healthcare camps when required.
* Communicate Carebees' key differentiators and service quality professionally.

E. Hospital \& Institutional Business Development

* Identify hospitals and clinics where Carebees can develop referral partnerships.
* Meet hospital administrators, consultants, discharge coordinators and relevant healthcare staff.
* Explore opportunities for:
* Post\-discharge home physiotherapy
* Home rehabilitation
* Elderly care
* Home nursing
* Follow\-up rehabilitation
* Corporate wellness/healthcare programs
* Support the management in developing new institutional partnerships.

F. Lead Follow\-up \& Coordination

* Coordinate closely with the Carebees customer\-care and operations teams.
* Ensure quick response to all doctor\-generated leads.
* Follow up with patients when required to support conversion.
* Monitor whether the referred patient has received the required service.
* Collect feedback from referral partners regarding patient experience.
* Escalate complaints or service issues immediately to management.

G. Reporting \& CRM

The employee must maintain daily and weekly sales activity records.

Daily reporting should include:

* Doctors visited
* New doctors contacted
* Existing doctors followed up
* Hospitals/clinics visited
* Leads generated
* Leads converted
* Pending leads
* Lost leads
* Revenue generated
* Follow\-up activities
* Next\-day action plan

All leads and referral activities must be updated in the **Carebees CRM/lead management system** or approved reporting format.

3\. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated based on measurable business outcomes.

Primary KPIs

* **Number of new doctors acquired as referral partners**
* **Number of active referring doctors**
* **Number of qualified patient leads generated**
* **Lead\-to\-patient conversion rate**
* **Monthly revenue generated through referrals**
* **Number of new hospital/clinic partnerships**
* **Repeat referrals from existing doctors**
* **Geographical expansion of Carebees' referral network**

Activity KPIs

* Daily doctor/clinic visits
* Weekly new doctor meetings
* Follow\-up calls/messages
* Hospital visits
* Referral\-partner meetings
* Lead follow\-up completion

**Important:** The role will be measured primarily on **quality of leads, patient conversion and revenue**, and not merely on the number of visits.

4\. Ideal Candidate ProfileQualification

* Bachelor's degree in any discipline.
* Healthcare, physiotherapy, pharmacy, life sciences, business development or sales background preferred.
* Candidates with experience in healthcare sales/business development will be preferred.

Experience

**1–5 years of experience** in any of the following:

* Healthcare sales
* Hospital sales
* Doctor referral marketing
* Pharmaceutical sales
* Medical representative role
* Diagnostic sales
* Home healthcare sales
* Healthcare business development
* Medical equipment sales

Freshers with excellent communication skills and strong sales ability may also be considered.

5\. Required Skills

The candidate should have:

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Strong relationship\-building ability
* Good sales and negotiation skills
* Confidence in meeting doctors and healthcare professionals
* Ability to conduct field visits independently
* Strong follow\-up skills
* Target\-oriented approach
* Good presentation skills
* Basic knowledge of healthcare services
* Ability to maintain CRM/reporting records
* Ability to convert relationships into measurable business results

Personal Attributes

* Professional and well\-groomed
* Energetic and proactive
* Positive attitude
* Self\-motivated
* Persistent in follow\-ups
* Honest and ethical
* Result\-oriented
* Comfortable with field work
* Willing to travel across Bangalore

6\. Expected Daily Work Pattern

A typical working day may include:

**Morning**

* Review pending leads
* Plan doctor visits
* Follow up with previous referrals

**Daytime**

* Visit doctors/clinics/hospitals
* Meet new referral sources
* Present Carebees services
* Generate and collect patient leads

**Afternoon/Evening**

* Follow up on leads
* Coordinate with operations
* Update CRM
* Track conversions
* Plan the next day's visits

7\. Key Objective for the First 90 DaysFirst 30 Days

* Understand Carebees services and processes.
* Map assigned geographical areas.
* Build a database of potential doctors and hospitals.
* Start regular doctor visits.
* Generate initial qualified leads.

31–60 Days

* Develop a consistent doctor referral network.
* Increase monthly referral leads.
* Establish relationships with key specialists and hospitals.
* Improve lead conversion.

61–90 Days

* Develop a strong base of active referring doctors.
* Generate predictable monthly patient referrals.
* Establish hospital/clinic partnerships.
* Achieve agreed monthly revenue targets.

8\. Career Growth

Successful candidates can progress into:

**Business Development Executive → Senior Business Development Executive → Area Sales Manager → Business Development Manager → Regional/City Head**

High\-performing employees will have opportunities to manage larger territories, hospital partnerships and sales teams.

9\. Compensation

**Salary:** ₹\_\_\_\_\_ – ₹\_\_\_\_\_ per month

**Performance Incentive:** Additional monthly/quarterly incentives based on:

* Qualified leads
* Patient conversions
* Revenue generated
* New active referral partners
* Hospital/clinic partnerships

A **fixed salary \+ performance incentive** structure will be followed to reward measurable business growth.

10\. Core Success FormulaDoctor Relationship

**↓**

Qualified Patient Referral

**↓**

Fast Carebees Follow\-up

**↓**

Patient Assessment

**↓**

Service Conversion

**↓**

Excellent Patient Experience

**↓**

Repeat \& Additional Referrals

**↓**

Revenue GrowthRole Summary

**This is not just a field\-visiting job.**

The selected candidate will be responsible for building a strong **doctor referral network for Carebees Healthcare**, generating qualified patient leads, converting those leads into patients, increasing Carebees' visibility in the healthcare community, and contributing directly to **monthly revenue growth**.

We're looking for someone who can build and fix things across the company — software, systems, and whatever else needs building — in a fast\-moving, engineering\-driven environment.

 You'll be the person who tinkers, builds, and fixes — internal tools, trackers, integrations, small apps, the company website, even some marketing/content work when needed. You won't be doing deep propulsion engineering, but you'll work alongside engineers, picking up context fast and building whatever they need without hand\-holding. This is a builder role for someone who's genuinely curious and doesn't want to be boxed into one lane.
 



  





**Educational Qualification:** 
 Bachelor's in Computer Science, Electronics, IT, or a related technical field. No specific certifications required — projects and demonstrated ability matter more than credentials.

* Handle general technical/IT admin: accounts, tools, basic troubleshooting, company website upkeep.

* Help maintain the company website, write occasional articles or updates, and support outreach/BD conversations — this isn't a marketing hire, but comfort writing and representing the company matters.
* Support documentation — trackers, one\-pagers, whatever needs to exist and doesn't yet.



*General* 



* Fill gaps across engineering support, admin, and ops — the role is deliberately broad; what you work on will shift based on what the company needs that week.



  





**Required Qualities:**

* Demonstrated project or work history building real things — apps, tools, automations, contributions (open source, personal projects, or work experience all count).
* Comfortable working with minimal direction — this is a "figure it out" role, not a "follow the ticket" role.
* Some exposure to cloud platforms (AWS/Azure), databases, or DevOps\-adjacent tools is a plus.
* Willingness to be based full\-time in Thoothukudi, Tamil Nadu.

 BlackRock’s active fixed income portfolio strategies stretch across a range of investment styles and segments of the fixed income universe. With a focus on alpha generation and risk management, the team uses a top\-down view from lead portfolio managers and bottom\-up expertise from our sector specialists
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking to hire a an Analyst\-level Software Engineer who understands the software development lifecycle very well. The individual The individual will design, develop, test, and maintain backend\-focused software applications, APIs, data workflows, and analytical tools. * Understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) and software testing lifecycle (STLC)

* Familiarity with test automation concepts and tools such as Selenium or similar frameworks
* Experience with version control systems and collaborative development workflows
* Awareness of API testing, integration testing concepts, and quality assurance best practices
* Understanding of REST APIs, databases, data pipelines, and application integration.
* Basic knowledge of React, JavaScript, TypeScript, or another front\-end technology is beneficial.

**Education \& Qualifications**
* 1\-3 years of relevant work experience


**Problem\-Solving**
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, including root\-cause analysis.
* Ability to gather requirements and translate business needs into technical solutions.
* Clear communication with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.


**Our Benefits**
 To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
   

  

**Our hybrid work model**
 BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
   

  

**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
 At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision\-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
 **guidance** 
 on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
   

  

**About BlackRock**
 At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well\-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
   

  

 This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
   

  

 To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
