title: Network Engineer II
description:
**Who We Are**
 Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.
   

  

 Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video\-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.
   

  

**About the role:**
 In Samsara’s Business Technology Core IT team, we work to deliver awesome systems, support, and experiences that enable our teams to be as impactful as possible. As a member of the team, you’ll help own network technology and processes that enable our people to do their best work. We are responsible for identifying, designing, implementing, and supporting the applications and networks to create a streamlined experience for Samsarians. As a Network/Infrastructure Engineer on the team, you will work alongside our senior network engineers to help maintain, optimize, and troubleshoot our global on\-premise network infrastructure, with a particular focus on our Cisco Meraki environment. This is a great opportunity for someone early to mid\-career in network engineering to build hands\-on expertise while learning from experienced mentors, all while helping ensure high availability and performance for a growing company. You will work closely with operations team members to operate, repair, and improve existing network infrastructure, including providing tier\-1 and tier\-2 support to other members of the Information Technology team and escalating more complex issues to senior engineers as needed.
   

  

**This role is based at our Bangalore office and requires on\-site presence 3 days a week.**
**You should apply if:**
* You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real\-world impact helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
* You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role is a launchpad rather than your last stop at Samsara. You’ll work alongside senior network engineers who will mentor you, and we’ve built a culture that encourages rapid career development and countless opportunities to grow your networking craft in a hyper growth environment.
* You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
* You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high\-caliber team that will encourage you to do your best.


*Click here* 
*to learn about what we value at Samsara.*
**In this role, you will:**
* Configure, install, and maintain network hardware and software components, including Meraki switches, access points, and firewalls, under the guidance of senior network engineers.
* Perform hands\-on troubleshooting and issue resolution for day\-to\-day network incidents, using the Meraki Dashboard, Wireshark, and packet captures to help identify root cause, escalating more complex issues to senior team members.
* Assist in developing and deploying network automation scripts and tools to enhance efficiency, partnering with senior engineers on more advanced automation projects.
* Support network maintenance activities including hardware and software upgrades, migrations, capacity upgrades, and decommissioning.
* Collaborate with other IT team members to integrate network systems with other applications and systems.
* Help build and maintain dashboards and reporting to monitor the health and performance of our network environments.
* Provide technical support and training to end\-users as needed.
* Create and update documentation for network designs, best practices, and operational procedures.
* Support hardware lifecycle management, from procurement to decommissioning.
* Assist in system deployment and configuration for new projects or initiatives.
* Partner with vendors and service providers to help procure and maintain hardware and software.
* Participate in duty rotation of 7\-day by 24\-hour on\-call support.


**Minimum requirements for the role:**
* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent professional experience.
* 1\-3 years of hands\-on experience in network engineering, IT infrastructure, or a related technical role, with exposure to Cisco Meraki hardware.
* Hands\-on familiarity with the Cisco Meraki platform, including configuring VLANs, SSIDs and wireless settings, group policies, and site\-to\-site VPN (Auto VPN) across MX, MS, and MR devices.
* Solid understanding of the OSI model and core TCP/IP networking concepts, including routing and switching fundamentals, DHCP, DNS, and QoS/DSCP.
* Ability to troubleshoot common network issues using the Meraki dashboard, packet captures, and tools like Wireshark, digging in before escalating more complex problems to senior engineers.
* Exposure to network monitoring and diagnostic tools (e.g., SolarWinds, LogicMonitor, PRTG, ELK, Meraki dashboard alerts and reporting, or similar).
* Comfortable learning and applying SD\-WAN specific features such as firewall and content filtering rules and adaptive policy, with eagerness to grow into more advanced protocols over time.
* Strong documentation habits, including experience creating and maintaining network diagrams using tools like Visio or Lucidchart or similar platforms documentation is a critical part of this role.
* Experience with IT asset and inventory management, tracking network hardware from procurement through deployment and decommissioning.
* Willingness to participate in a rotational on\-call schedule, responding to production network incidents outside of standard business hours.
* Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset, partnering with senior network engineers and cross\-functional IT teams on incident tickets and SLA\-based response and resolution.


**An ideal candidate also has one or more:**
* Early experience or strong interest in designing, deploying, and operating networks at scale.
* Familiarity with the Atlassian suite (Jira, Confluence, OpsGenie, StatusPage).
* Familiarity with Splunk or similar log analysis tools.
* Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA), or actively working toward it.
* Basic proficiency in API or other scripting/programming languages.
* Familiarity with Google Workspace and Google Cloud Platform.
* Exposure to cloud network management in AWS and/or GCP.


**Total Rewards**
 At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high\-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above\-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance\-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high\-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above\-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.
   

  

 Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long\-term success: a flexible, employee\-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.
   

  

**Flexible Working**
 At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in\-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on\-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.
   

  

**Belonging at Samsara**
 At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.
   

  

**Accommodations**
 Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.
   

  

**Our Commitment to Authenticity**
 We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.
   

  

**Fraudulent Employment Offers**
 Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us\-greenhouse\-mail.io or @mail3\.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

**Continuous Improvement**

**Experience**

**Technical Skills**

title: Data Center Technician, Data Center Operations (DCO)
description:
**Description**
 AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
   

  

 You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is growing rapidly, and we are looking for Data Center Technician to join our expanding Infrastructure Operations team.
   

  

 Data Center Operations designs, installs and maintains the world’s largest Computing Infrastructure. Our scope of work includes systems, repairing, dealing with issues, handling and tracking parts and assisting in Data Center maintenance. Amazon Data Centers are large\-scale high\-density centers where you will help change the face of Technology in the region.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 As Data Centre Operations Engineer, you will be the primary point of contact for internal customers. There is never a dull moment as each day presents itself with different challenges. Some of the key responsibilities you will undertake are:
   

  

* You will troubleshoot technical issues on advanced hardware, ranging from servers, storage and networking devices on a 24/7 basis.
* You will maintain a high level of system reliability and availability.
* You will participate in projects to enhance operational efficiencies with opportunities to share experiences and knowledge with our global network of technical experts.
* You will share knowledge and help train less technical staff on the best practices related to all service owner issues
* You will contribute towards building a great team by getting involved in the Amazon hiring process/candidate interviews


 A day in the life
   

  

 As a successful Data Center Operations engineer, your day\-to\-day work will include:
   

  

* Installation and configurations on Data center Servers and Network systems
* Installation, troubleshooting and replacement of internal and external hardware parts of Servers and Network devices
* Work within a ticket\-based environment and work on systematic problem resolution
* Work on rotational shift\-based schedule to maintain high system reliability
* Collaborate with internal teams and share ideas and contribute in innovative projects to improve DC work environment and overall efficiencies.
* This is a physically active role, we are always on the move onsite.


**About The Team**
 About AWS
   

  

 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship and Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field
* Can lift and rack equipment up to 40 pounds


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience dealing effectively with customers during problem resolution and operating efficiently under pressure
* Experience managing work and priorities through a ticketing system
* Experience with cabling infrastructure best practices and methodologies
* Experience working in a data center environment (racking and stacking gear, cable management, hot/cold aisle containment)


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R\&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem\-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.
   

  

**Group/Division**
 With over 40 years of semiconductor process control experience, chipmakers around the globe rely on KLA to ensure that their fabs ramp next\-generation devices to volume production quickly and cost\-effectively. Enabling the movement towards advanced chip design, KLA's Global Products Group (GPG), which is responsible for creating all of KLA’s metrology and inspection products, is looking for the best and the brightest research scientist, software engineers, application development engineers, and senior product technology process engineers. The Broadband Plasma Division (BBP) provides market\-leading patterned wafer optical inspection systems for leading\-edge IC manufacturing. title: 3D Generalist
description:
**About us:** 




  






 Integra Robotics develops modular robotic systems for industrial automation, inspection, material handling and operations in hazardous or difficult\-to\-access environments. Its portfolio spans collaborative robotic arms, end\-of\-arm tooling, underwater manipulators and mobile robotic platforms. A shared architecture combines mechanical systems, electronics, controls, teleoperation and simulation, with a roadmap towards increasingly autonomous operation.
 





 Join a multidisciplinary team translating robotics engineering into practical products and customer applications. These openings support commercial adoption and the digital assets used to demonstrate, simulate and refine robotic systems.
 




  





**Experience:** 

 Minimum 1 year of hands\-on 3D modelling and model\-rigging experience specifically involving robotics.
 




  





**Work arrangement:** 

 Mandatory work from the office. Flexible working hours, Monday–Friday, coordinated with engineering reviews and project deadlines.
 




  





**Office location:** 

 Integra Robotics (Research \& Fabrication) Space.
 




  





**Role purpose:** 




  






 Create mechanically accurate, articulated 3D assets for robotic arms, grippers, underwater manipulators and mobile platforms. Support product visualisation, customer demonstrations, immersive teleoperation interfaces and simulation workflows in collaboration with mechanical, robotics and software engineers.
 




  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  




* Build and refine hard\-surface robot models from engineering CAD, drawings, dimensions and physical references while preserving component identity and assembly structure.
* Create mechanical rigs with correct pivots, local axes, parent–child relationships, degrees of freedom and joint limits; apply forward and inverse kinematics where appropriate.
* Animate manipulation, gripping, assembly and mobility sequences with plausible motion; avoid unintended deformation of rigid robot parts and check for visible interpenetration.
* Convert detailed CAD into efficient real\-time assets through mesh cleanup, retopology, UV mapping, material setup and level\-of\-detail optimisation.
* Prepare organised visual meshes, simplified collision geometry and link\-based asset structures; work with engineers to validate robot descriptions and physical parameters.
* Import and test assets in the team’s real\-time or simulation environment; resolve scale, orientation, hierarchy, material and animation\-transfer issues.
* Produce product renders, exploded views and demonstration sequences that accurately communicate mechanisms and applications.
* Maintain reusable asset libraries, naming conventions, revision history and handover notes; update models when engineering designs change.



  





**Required Skills:** 




  




* At least 1 year of relevant robotics modelling and rigging experience, supported by a portfolio showing articulated robot models and the applicant’s own contribution.
* Proficiency in Blender, Autodesk Maya or an equivalent 3D package for both hard\-surface modelling and mechanical rigging; mastery of one primary package is sufficient.
* Understanding of rigid\-body articulation, revolute and prismatic joints, joint hierarchies, coordinate systems, scale, transforms and FK/IK rig behaviour.
* Practical ability in topology cleanup, UVs, physically based materials, lighting and efficient asset preparation.
* Ability to interpret CAD assemblies or engineering drawings, incorporate technical feedback and deliver clean, editable project files.



  






 Software \& Tools:
 




  




* Core: Blender or Autodesk Maya for modelling, rigging and animation.
* Preferred: Unreal Engine, including Control Rig and Sequencer, for interactive assets and animation; Unity experience is also relevant.
* Preferred: SolidWorks, Autodesk Fusion or an equivalent CAD tool for inspecting assemblies and preparing geometry for the 3D pipeline.

 At Vir Innovations, we are a team of driven pioneers working together to create meaningful impact. Our diverse professionals, brought together from different cultures and backgrounds across the country, share a common goal: to innovate and contribute to national security through cutting\-edge technology.
 



 Our core values: Passion, Integrity, Innovation, Quality, and Growth form the foundation of our vibrant culture. These pillars guide us as we build groundbreaking solutions that inspire creativity and foster collaboration.
 



  





 When one joins Vir Innovations, they step into an environment that empowers to:
 


* Learn and Grow: Gain new skills and knowledge while working on projects that challenge and inspire.
* Innovate and Lead: Contribute to cutting\-edge advancements in robotics, automation, and defence technologies.
* Make an Impact: Be part of something bigger your work here directly or indirectly strengthens national security.



  





 We believe in providing equal opportunities to talented individuals from all backgrounds and experiences. If someone is passionate about technology, innovation, and making a difference, Vir Innovations is the place for him. Shape the future of technology with us. Join our team and embark on a career that truly matters!
 



  





**Job Overview** 




 We design and develop advanced robotic systems for
 **defence** 
 applications, including Unmanned Ground Vehicles (UGVs) with manual and autonomous navigation, Remote Controlled Weapon Systems (RCWS) with manual and autonomous operation, robotic arm payloads, EO\-IR computer vision systems, and IoT\-based safety applications such as fire detection \& suppression systems. We are looking for a skilled Embedded Systems Firmware Engineer to join our engineering team and contribute to mission\-critical, field\-deployed platforms.
 



  





 As an Embedded Systems Firmware Engineer, you will design, develop, and validate firmware for embedded platforms powering our robotic and
 **defence** 
 systems. You will work closely with hardware, controls, computer vision, and systems engineering teams to deliver robust, real\-time, and safety\-critical firmware across multiple product lines — from ground vehicle motion control to weapon system actuation and sensor payload integration.
 



  





 Industry focus is
 **Defence** 
 – Robotics, Computer Vision Systems, IoT, Simulators, Fire Control Systems.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



1. Design, develop, and debug embedded firmware (C/C\+\+) for microcontrollers and embedded processors used in UGVs, RCWS, robotic arm payloads, EO\-IR systems, and IoT devices.
2. Develop real\-time control software for motor drives, actuators, servo/gimbal control, and motion control systems.
3. Implement and maintain communication protocols/interfaces: CAN, RS\-232/485, SPI, I2C, UART, Ethernet, MAVLink/custom protocols for command \& telemetry.
4. Integrate firmware with sensors (IMU, GPS/GNSS, encoders, LiDAR, cameras) and actuators for both manual (teleoperated) and autonomous operation modes.
5. Develop low\-level drivers and BSPs (Board Support Packages) for custom hardware boards.
6. Work on safety\-critical interlocks and fail\-safe logic for weapon system fire\-control and actuation subsystems, per defined safety and operational requirements.
7. Collaborate with the autonomy/navigation team to integrate firmware with higher\-level autonomous navigation and control stacks.
8. Support EO\-IR payload firmware: camera control, stabilization, video/image data handling, and integration with computer vision pipelines.
9. Develop firmware for IoT\-based systems such as fire detection \& suppression units, including sensor data acquisition, wireless communication, and alert/actuation logic.
10. Conduct unit testing, integration testing, HIL (Hardware\-in\-the\-Loop) testing, and field trials of firmware on live platforms.
11. Debug and resolve issues using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, JTAG/SWD debuggers, and other lab equipment.
12. Prepare technical documentation: design documents, test reports, interface control documents (ICDs), and firmware release notes.
13. Ensure firmware compliance with applicable defence quality, reliability, and safety standards.
14. Participate to travel for field trials, integration, and testing at customer/trial sites
15. Support production, integration, and troubleshooting during system assembly and field deployment.



  





**Desired Candidate Profile** 




**Required Skills and Qualifications:** 



1. Bachelor's/Master's degree in Electronics, Electrical, Computer Engineering, or related field.
2. 1\-4 years of hands\-on experience in embedded firmware development in
 **defence** 
 robotics domain.
3. Strong proficiency in C/C\+\+ for embedded/bare\-metal and RTOS\-based systems.
4. Experience with 32\-bit microcontrollers/processors (ARM Cortex\-M/A, STM32, TI, NXP, or similar).
5. Working knowledge of RTOS (FreeRTOS, Zephyr, VxWorks, or equivalent).
6. Strong understanding of embedded communication protocols: CAN/CANopen, UART, SPI, I2C, Ethernet/TCP\-IP.
7. Experience with motor control (BLDC/PMSM), servo systems, and closed\-loop control (PID).
8. Experience with wireless communication modules (RF, Wi\-Fi, LTE, radio telemetry links).
9. Hands\-on experience with debugging tools: JTAG/SWD, oscilloscope, logic analyzer.
10. Familiarity with version control (Git) and embedded development toolchains (GCC, IAR, Keil).
11. Understanding of schematics and ability to work closely with hardware/PCB design teams.
12. Strong analytical, debugging, and problem\-solving skills.



  





**Preferred / Good to Have:** 



1. Exposure to autonomous systems, sensor fusion, or navigation stacks (ROS/ROS2\).
2. Knowledge of EO\-IR camera/gimbal systems and video processing pipelines.
3. Familiarity with functional safety concepts (e.g., IEC 61508, MIL\-STD standards) and safety\-critical firmware design.
4. Experience with bootloaders, firmware OTA updates, and secure firmware practices.
5. Exposure to weapon system electronics, fire\-control logic, or similar safety\-critical actuation systems.
6. Experience with IoT protocols (MQTT, LoRa, Zigbee) for sensor/alert systems.
7. Prior experience taking products through prototype\-to\-production and field trials.



  





**What We Offer:** 



1. Opportunity to work on cutting\-edge
 **defence** 
 robotics technology with real\-world field impact.
2. Cross\-functional exposure across mechanical, electrical, software, and AI/CV domains.
3. Competitive pay in accordance with industry \& company Standards.



  





**Note:** 




 To apply for this opportunity, you may also email your resume to
 **hr@virinnovations.in** 
 with the email subject as "
 **Application for Embedded System Firmware Engineer Role"** 
 .

 Systems Engineering ist eine funktionsübergreifende technische Disziplin, die sich auf einen Ansatz, eine Denkweise und einen Prozess konzentriert. Die Disziplin zur Umsetzung eines soliden Prozesses zum Entwerfen, Erstellen und Optimieren von Systemen, der aus der Identifizierung und Quantifizierung von Systemanforderungen, der Erstellung alternativer Systementwurfskonzepte, der Durchführung von Design\-Trade\-off\-Studien, der Auswahl und Implementierung der besten Entwürfe und der Überprüfung der Tatsache besteht, dass das Design ordnungsgemäß integriert ist und ausgeführt wird. Die Disziplin zur Umsetzung eines soliden Prozesses zum Entwerfen, Erstellen und Optimieren von Systemen, der aus der Identifizierung und Quantifizierung von Systemanforderungen, der Erstellung alternativer Systementwurfskonzepte, der Durchführung von Design\-Trade\-off\-Studien, der Auswahl und Implementierung der besten Entwürfe und der Überprüfung der Tatsache besteht, dass das Design ordnungsgemäß integriert ist und ausgeführt wird. title: Simulation Engineer
description:
ET robotics is looking for a simulation engineer to join its highly dynamic team working at the intersection of Locomotion, Manipulation and Physical AI. The  simulation engineer would work on bridging the gap between real world and state\-of\-the\-art simulation platforms.  The role involves running physical experiments with robots, tuning model parameters, and improving simulation fidelity. You will collaborate on projects that connect simulation environments with real robotic systems.
 



  





**Responsibilities:**

* MTech (or higher) in Robotics, Mechanical Engineering, Applied Mechanics, Mechatronics, Control Systems, Aerospace, Electrical, or a related field
* Working knowledge of multibody dynamics, contact and friction, flexible bodies, cable or wire simulation, deformable objects, stiffness handling etc.
* Hands\-on experience with physics\-based simulation tools (MuJoCo, Isaac Sim, Gazebo, or with physics engines in Unity/Unreal Engine).
* Programming skills in Python and/or C\+\+



  





**Desirable skills:** 



* Experience with real robotic hardware
* Knowledge of deep learning (reinforcement learning and transfer learning)
* Interest in sim2real transfer methods.
* Familiarity with Omniverse, PhysX, Newton, Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, or industrial digital twin platforms.

title: Validation Engineer
description:
**Role: Robotics Validation Engineer** 




**Team: Automation \& Robotics** 




  





**Role Overview:** 




 We are seeking a mid\-level Robotics Validation Engineer to ensure the safety, reliability, and performance of our autonomous systems. You will bridge the gap between software development and real\-world deployment by designing, executing, and automating robust test suites. Working deeply within our ROS2 and Ubuntu\-based stack, you will validate complex behaviors in both simulation and physical hardware to catch edge cases before they reach production.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* **Test Development:** 
 Design, implement, and maintain automated Software\-in\-the\-Loop (SITL) and Hardware\-in\-the\-Loop (HITL) test frameworks for robotic systems.
* **System Validation:** 
 Execute comprehensive functional, performance, and stress tests on physical robots and in simulated environments.
* **ROS2 Debugging:** 
 Record, parse, and analyze rosbags and system telemetry to identify regressions, latency issues, or node crashes.
* **Collaboration:** 
 Work directly with perception, navigation, and control engineers to reproduce complex field bugs and verify fixes.
* **Infrastructure:** 
 Maintain and optimize Linux/Ubuntu testing environments, CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Docker, GitHub Actions), and automated deployment scripts.
* **Reporting:** 
 Document test plans, validation metrics, and release readiness reports for cross\-functional teams.

title: Product Manager I
description:
**Job Summary** 




 As a Product Manager for Search \& Conversational Discovery, you will work at the intersection of product, data, engineering, design, and AI/ML to build experiences that help millions of users discover and engage with content. You will own well\-defined product problem areas across Search and Conversational Voice Discovery (CVD), from identifying user and business opportunities to defining solutions, running experiments, and measuring impact.
 



  





 You will use data, user insights, experimentation, and structured problem\-solving to improve how users find, discover, and interact with content. This is an opportunity to work on highly visible consumer experiences across JioHotstar's 500M\+ user base while developing deep expertise in Search, conversational experiences, and AI/ML\-powered product development.
 



**About the Team** 




 At JioHotstar, we're on a mission to deliver delightful experiences to our 500\+ million customers across the globe. Our technology spans 25\+ countries, with more on the horizon. The Search team sits within the Viewer Experience org and is responsible for helping every user find exactly what they're looking for through text search.
 



 We blend world\-class engineering, ML/NLP, design, and data to deliver a fast, relevant text search experience at massive scale. If you're passionate about building intelligent search and query\-understanding systems that measurably improve how hundreds of millions of users discover content, join us in shaping the future of entertainment discovery.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own specific product problem areas across Search and/or CVD, taking them from problem discovery and definition through execution, launch, experimentation and measurement.
* Analyze user behavior, search/query data, product funnels, and key metrics to identify gaps and opportunities that can improve content discovery and engagement.
* Translate user and business problems into clear product requirements, hypotheses, success metrics, and actionable product roadmaps.
* Partner closely with Engineering, ML/Data Science, Design, and other stakeholders to prioritize, build, test, and launch product improvements.
* Work on areas such as search relevance, query understanding, suggestions, content discovery, conversational flows, voice interactions, and AI\-powered discovery experiences, depending on the problem area.
* Design and evaluate A/B experiments, interpret results, and use learnings to continuously improve the product.
* Develop an understanding of how ML/AI systems work in production, including model inputs, outputs, evaluation metrics, limitations, and their implications for product decisions.
* Monitor product performance after launch and take ownership of key KPIs and quality metrics for the areas you own.
* Work with the broader Search/CVD team to understand dependencies and ensure that improvements are consistent with the overall product strategy.
* Benchmark competitor experiences, conduct user research where relevant, and bring external insights into product decisions.
* Respond quickly to changing user needs, content launches, live events, and other business priorities that impact discovery and conversational experiences.
* Communicate product decisions clearly through PRDs, product reviews, GTM documents, data analysis, and stakeholder discussions.



**Skills and Attributes for Success** 



* Strong product thinking: Ability to break ambiguous problems into structured, solvable problems and identify the highest\-impact opportunities.
* Data\-driven mindset: Comfortable working with product metrics, funnels, query/user data, experiments, and using data to make decisions.
* Strong execution: Demonstrated ability to work with cross\-functional teams and consistently take products/features from idea to launch.
* Customer empathy: Ability to understand user pain points and translate them into meaningful product improvements.
* Analytical thinking: Ability to form hypotheses, evaluate alternatives, interpret experiment results, and make clear recommendations.
* AI/ML curiosity: Working understanding of AI/ML concepts and a strong interest in applying them to consumer products. Familiarity with LLMs, NLP, recommendation/search systems, or conversational AI is a plus.
* Clear communication: Ability to articulate problems, product decisions, trade\-offs, and requirements with clarity and structure.
* Ownership: Takes responsibility for outcomes rather than simply completing assigned tasks; proactively identifies issues and drives them to resolution.
* Collaboration: Comfortable working closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Data Science, ML, and other teams.
* Learning agility: Able to quickly build domain expertise in complex areas such as Search, relevance, conversational AI, and content discovery.



**Preferred Education and Experience** 



* Bachelors/Masters degree or equivalent with minimum
 **2\+ years of experience** 
 in product management preferably building consumer\-facing digital products.
* Experience owning products/features end\-to\-end, from problem definition to launch and post\-launch measurement.
* Strong experience with data\-driven product development and experimentation.
* Exposure to Search, Recommendations, AI/ML, NLP, GenAI, conversational products, voice interfaces, or content discovery is preferred.
* Experience working with engineering and/or ML teams on technically complex products is a plus.
* Demonstrated track record of measurable product impact, rather than only feature delivery.



**About JioStar** 




 Perched at the nucleus of spellbinding content and innovative technology, JioStar is a leading global media \& entertainment company that is reimagining the way audiences consume entertainment and sports. Its television network and streaming service together reach more than 750 million viewers every week, igniting the dreams and aspirations of hundreds of million people across geographies.
 



 JioStar is an equal opportunity employer. The company values diversity and its mission is to create a workplace where everyone can bring their authentic selves to work. The company ensures that the work environment is free from any discrimination against persons with disabilities, gender, gender identity and any other characteristics or status that is legally protected.

title: Scrum Master
description:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision\-making through our leading AI\-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.
 



 What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.
 



 Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50\. Coca\-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400\+ global companies who rely on our best\-in\-class platform.
 



 Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating
 
 our wins – big and small.
 



 Supported by operating principles of being strategy\-led, values\-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next \- together!
 



 We are seeking an experienced and passionate Scrum Master to be the agile leader and performance coach for our engineering development teams. In this role, you will champion a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, and predictable delivery. You will be the hands\-on partner to your teams, empowering them to deliver high\-quality, valuable software while fostering an environment where they can do their best work. If you are passionate about building teams that are both happy 
 *and* 
 high\-performing, and you thrive on guiding people to achieve tangible results, this is the role for you.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities** 



* Empower the team to run their own team ceremonies by providing the necessary support, tools, and guidance. Acting as a supportive figure to ensure meetings become team\-led, productive, and value\-driven.
* ensuring they are engaging, productive, and focused on delivering value.
* Act as a subject matter expert on lean and agile principles, ensuring the team to develop, own, and refine an effective process that consistently delivers value based on the chosen frameworks principles and practices.
* Promote transparency by maintaining clear reporting and visible Agile dashboards (e.g., burn\-down charts, flow metrics), making the team's progress and challenges understood by all.
* Coach the team towards greater self\-organization, cross\-functional collaboration, and a strong sense of ownership for their outcomes.
* Drive a culture of continuous improvement, guiding the team to use metrics to identify and solve bottlenecks or delays in their workflow
* Partner closely with the Product Owner to ensure the product backlog is healthy, well\-groomed, and prioritized to deliver maximum business value.
* Proactively identify, track, and relentlessly remove impediments and risks that are impacting the team's progress, protecting their flow and productivity.
* Act as a key collaborative partner to the Agile Delivery Manager (ADM), providing on\-the\-ground visibility into team\-level risks and working together to resolve systemic, domain\-level blockers.
* Facilitate productive communication and collaboration between the team and external stakeholders, ensuring alignment and clear expectations.



**Your Qualifications** 



* Proven Experience: 3\+ years of dedicated experience as a Scrum Master or Agile Coach in a software development environment, with a track record of improving team performance and health.
* Deep Agile Knowledge: Certified Scrum Master (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), or equivalent certification is required. You have a deep understanding of the principles behind Scrum, Kanban, and other agile methodologies, and you know when and how to apply them to get results.
* A Coach's Mindset: You don't just facilitate; you coach. You have demonstrable experience mentoring teams and individuals to foster self\-organization and a growth mindset. You are an empathetic listener and a powerful question\-asker.
* Data\-Driven Facilitator: You are comfortable using agile metrics not as a report card, but as a tool to help teams have insightful conversations and drive their own improvement.
* Exceptional Communicator: You have excellent moderation, facilitation, and conflict\-resolution skills. You can communicate complex topics clearly and effectively to a variety of audiences, from engineering teams to stakeholders.
* Technical Fluency: You are proficient with agile project management tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence).



**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)** 




 We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!
 



 We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.  
 



**Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer** 
  
 



 It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.
 



 Anaplan does not:  
 


* Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.
* Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.



 All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

Join us in shaping a future where technology seamlessly aligns with purpose.
   

  

 Job Description: Scrum Master with DevSecOps expertise
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* 20–25% Team Oversight \& Coordination: Provide team oversight and coordination, ensuring alignment, timely delivery, effective resource utilization, and adherence to project objectives.
* Agile \& JIRA: Manage JIRA in line with Agile practices, including backlog management, sprint planning, refinement, progress tracking, sprint reviews, and governance.

title: Scrum Master
description:
Join us as a Scrum Master at Barclays, where you will drive agile delivery excellence across cross\-functional teams, enabling the successful delivery of strategic business and technology outcomes. You will facilitate Agile ceremonies, remove impediments, foster a culture of continuous improvement, and work closely with Product Owners, Engineers, Architects, and stakeholders to maximize value delivery and team performance.
   

  

 To be successful as a Scrum Master, you should have experience with:
   

  

  

* Agile delivery leadership within Scrum and/or SAFe environments
* Facilitating Agile ceremonies and driving continuous improvement
* Managing dependencies, risks, impediments, and stakeholder engagement
* Agile tooling such as Jira, Confluence, and reporting dashboards


**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**
* SAFe Scrum Master (SSM), CSM, PSM or equivalent Agile certification
* Experience supporting large\-scale transformation and change initiatives
* Data\-driven delivery management using metrics and KPIs
* Financial Services, Payments, Banking, or Regulatory programme experience


 You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific Agile delivery and stakeholder management skills.
   

  

 The role is based out of Pune, India.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 Facilitates and supports Agile teams by ensuring they follow Scrum principles. To remove obstacles, enhance team collaboration, and ensure smooth communication, enabling the team to focus on delivering high\-quality, iterative results. Facilitate Scrum events, promote continuous improvement, and act as a bridge between the team and external stakeholders.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Facilitate Events: Facilitate events, as needed, and ensure that all events take place and are positive, productive, and kept within the timebox
* Support Iteration Execution: Ensure quality of ceremony artefacts and continuous customer value through iteration execution, maintain backlog refinement, and iterate on stakeholder feedback
* Optimize Flow: Identify and facilitate the removal of conflict impacting team flow, utilizing metrics to empower the team to communicate effectively, making all work visible
* Mitigate Risks: Identify and escalate risks to remove impediments and shield the Squad from interruptions
* Build High\-Performing Teams: Foster and coach Agile Team attributes and continuous improvement, encourage stakeholder collaboration, deputise ‘in the moment leadership’, and drive high\-performing team attributes
* Stakeholder Management: Facilitate stakeholder collaboration (e.g., business stakeholders, product teams, vendors) and build trust with stakeholders
* Governance and Reporting: Ensure data quality and provide representation at required governance forums, if applicable


**Assistant Vice President Expectations**
 To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
   

  

 Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
   

  

 If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
   

  

 OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
   

  

 Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
   

  

 Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
   

  

 Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
   

  

 Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
   

  

 Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
   

  

 Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
   

  

 Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
   

  

 Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.
   

  

 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: UX Designer (2 to 4 years)
description:
Join us as we work to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high\-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.
   

  

**Position Summary:** 
 Design is evolving as AI blurs the boundaries between research, UX design, product thinking, prototyping and development. In this role, you will help shape human\-centered design in an AI\-native product environment, using AI\-assisted and specification\-driven development (SDD) practices while ensuring evidence, creativity and human judgment remain central.
   

  

 You will solve complex healthcare problems involving interconnected systems, large amounts of information and decisions where clarity and accuracy matter. The primary focus is document interoperability—helping healthcare professionals find, review, understand and act on clinical information—as well as referrals and other cross\-organization experiences.
   

  

 Research is central to the role. You will work with healthcare professionals, practice staff, clients and clinical/domain experts, combining research insights with product and behavioral data to make evidence\-based design decisions.
   

  

**About the Team:** 
 You will be part of a collaborative team working closely with
 **Design, Product, Engineering, clients and clinical/domain experts** 
 to create clear, accurate and usable healthcare experiences.
   

  

 The team is exploring how
 **AI** 
 can support research, synthesis, problem framing, specification, exploration, prototyping and validation. You will contribute to evolving
 **SDD practices** 
 and critically evaluate AI\-generated output for
 **accuracy, evidence, bias, usability and human value** 
 .
   

  

 Together, the team works on complex, data\-rich healthcare workflows where users need to understand information, make decisions and take action across interconnected systems.
   

  

**Essential Job Responsibilities**
* Use AI across research, synthesis, problem framing, specification, exploration, prototyping and validation as part of an AI\-native design approach.
* Contribute to evolving specification\-driven development (SDD) practices and critically evaluate AI\-generated output for accuracy, evidence, bias, usability and human value.
* Help plan and conduct user research with healthcare professionals, practice staff, clients, clinical experts and domain experts.
* Ask thoughtful questions, build rapport, listen closely and identify meaningful patterns from qualitative research and customer feedback.
* Combine qualitative insights with product and behavioral data to understand both what users do and why they do it.
* Translate research and evidence into clear problem definitions, workflows, experience principles and product concepts that help the team determine what to build and why.
* Design understandable enterprise experiences, including user flows, information architecture, wireframes, prototypes and detailed interface designs.
* Design for document interoperability, referrals and cross\-organization healthcare workflows, accounting for different users, dense information, edge cases and system constraints.
* Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Design, clients and domain experts to evaluate trade\-offs and build shared understanding.
* Drive clearly scoped work forward, communicate progress and risks, seek feedback and take on increasing complexity as your capabilities grow.


**Additional Job Responsibilities**
* Develop a strong understanding of complex healthcare systems and workflows, even without prior U.S. healthcare expertise.
* Apply human\-centered judgment to determine where AI should and should not influence an experience.
* Experiment with AI in research, design, prototyping, technical exploration and other creative practices, adapting approaches based on learnings.
* Reason about complex systems, data, relationships, constraints and downstream consequences.
* Use evidence to separate assumptions from validated insights and respond constructively when new information challenges your initial thinking.
* Communicate clearly with users and colleagues across different disciplines, cultures and levels of technical knowledge.
* Show initiative, follow through on commitments, seek feedback and maintain a high standard for the quality and consequences of design decisions.
* Work directly with U.S.\-based healthcare professionals and clinical experts as part of research activities.
* Maintain planned evening availability in India when required for scheduled research sessions with U.S.\-based users.
* Continue developing UX capabilities and take on increasing levels of responsibility and complexity as your capabilities grow.


**Expected Education \& Experience**
* 2–4 years of relevant experience in UX design, product design, UX research, service design, data, engineering, healthcare, psychology, customer experience or another related discipline.
* Experience researching or designing complex, data\-rich products and workflows involving multiple users, constraints and dependencies.
* Experience in healthcare, health technology, fintech, insurance, enterprise software, logistics, security, data products or another systemic or regulated environment is valuable.
* Ability to use qualitative research, customer feedback and/or behavioral product data to inform product, service or design decisions.
* Curiosity about analytics tools such as Amplitude is valuable, even if you are not currently a quantitative researcher.
* Ability to communicate ideas through workflows, information architecture, wireframes, prototypes and/or detailed interface designs.
* Demonstrated experimentation with AI in research, design, prototyping, technical exploration or another creative practice, with an ability to adapt based on what you learn.
* Healthcare or health technology experience is a plus, particularly familiarity with clinical workflows, document exchange, interoperability, referrals or care coordination.
* A bachelor’s or master’s degree in Design, Human\-Computer Interaction, Cognitive Psychology, Computer Science, Business or a related discipline is welcomed; equivalent skills developed through practical experience are also valued.
* We care more about the quality of your thinking, research instincts, curiosity and ability to grow than a specific job title or list of tools.

title: Scrum Master
description:
**Job Title:** 
 Tribe ScrumMaster and ISPL TeamLead
   

  

**Department** 
 : ETO Strategic Protection Platform (IT Tribe Business Platforms)
   

  

**About Business Line/Function**
 BNP Paribas Cardif is a world leader in bancassurance partnerships, providing its customers with products and services that let them realise their goals while protecting themselves from unforeseen events. BNP Paribas Cardif is committed to having a positive impact on society and to making insurance more accessible. A subsidiary of BNP Paribas, the insurer has a unique business model anchored in partnerships. It creates solutions for more than 500 partner distributors in a variety of sectors – including banks and financial institutions, automotive sector companies, retailers and telecommunications companies – as well as for financial advisors and brokers who market the products to their customers. With a presence in 30 countries and strong positions in Europe, Asia and Latin America, BNP Paribas Cardif is a global specialist in personal insurance, the world leader in creditor insurance and a major contributor to financing for the real economy. With 9,000 employees worldwide, BNP Paribas Cardif had gross written premiums of €40\.5 billion in 2025\.
   

  

 Within BNPP Cardif, the mission of ETO (Efficiency, Technology \& Operations) Directorate is to deliver our value proposition by steering and transforming our operational setups and information systems to support the company’s development and serve our clients and partners safely, sustainably, and efficiently.
   

  

 The Protection business line is currently confronting strong industrial challenges that limit Cardif’s ability to operate with a competitive cost‑to‑serve and to sustain activity growth at marginal cost. This overall situation stems from a highly fragmented, locally‑focused industrial set‑up with heterogeneous processes, operations, and IT systems.
   

  

 The creation of a new Global COO Protection department aims to address these issues by deploying the new Protection platform (IT BizPlatform) and its Target Operating Model on a global scale. The IT BizPlatform team will be responsible for the rollout and maintenance of the technology platform. The establishment of a new Global Protection Operations team is intended to define and implement the Target Operating Model linked to the new Protection platform.
   

  

**Position Purpose**
 The Scrum Master /Team Lead is accountable for steering the end‑to‑end delivery of our Platform initiative. Acting as the servant‑leader of our agile tribe, the role ensures the adoption of Scrum/Agile best practices, removes impediments, and drives continuous improvement while simultaneously providing operational leadership to the ISPL team of our tribe.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Direct Responsibilities
   

  

 The candidate will work in an extended team mode with colleagues in France, and his major responsibilities will be to:
   

  

* Facilitate High‑Performance Agile Delivery – Conduct all Scrum ceremonies, mentor the team on Agile values and principles, and champion a self‑organising, collaborative culture that consistently meets sprint commitments and quality standards.
* Provide Operational Leadership – Define delivery activities to guarantee robust, secure, and scalable solutions aligned with BNP Paribas Cardif’s IT governance.
* Synchronise with Tribe Stakeholders – Act as the primary interface between the ISPL team, on‑shore product owners, business analysts, and other groups; ensure transparent, timely communication of progress, risks, and dependencies.
* Drive Team Growth \& Capability Building – Coach and mentor ISPL team in both Agile practices and delivery competencies, fostering a learning mindset, ownership, and career development to build a high‑calibre, future‑ready delivery capability.
* Ensure Delivery Excellence \& Compliance – Monitor key performance indicators (velocity, defect leakage, cycle time, etc.), enforce compliance with security, data‑privacy, and regulatory requirements, and champion process improvement initiatives that enhance efficiency and reduce delivery risk.


**Technical \& Behavioral Competencies**
 The Successful Candidate Must Have Some Knowledge On IT Development; He Should Also Be Proficient In JIRA And Confluence For The Following Tasks
   

  

* JIRA Administration
* Confluence administration of the dedicated space for Protection Platform (Standard content management)


 Other aspects of the function will also involve the following:
   

  

* Liaise and cooperate with many different teams, in France and other Countries where our platform is deployed


**Specific Qualifications**
 Minimum 5 years of experience.
   

  

**Technical Skills**
**Skills Referential (Required knowledge, skills and abilities)**
* Proficient in JIRA and Confluence administration.
* Knowledge of IT and Project Management
* Provide reporting for delivery status, KPIs and risks


 Appendix for ScrumMaster expected activities
   

  

 Must Have :\-
   

  

**Agile Ceremonies**
 Daily\-Stand
   

  

 Time‑box 15 min max – start and end at the same time each day
   

  

 Round‑robin: What did I do yesterday? – What will I do today? – Impediment?
   

  

 Update the sprint board (Azure DevOps \- TFS) before the stand‑up so the discussion is based on the latest status
   

  

 Sprint Planning
   

  

 Verify each developer’s available capacity (consider holidays, meetings, training). Adjust the forecast if needed.
   

  

 Compare planned story points with the average velocity of the last 3‑5 sprints. Do not exceed the average unless a formal capacity increase is approved by the Product Owner.
   

  

 Sprint Goals :\- Draft a concise, business‑valued statement (1‑2 sentences). Validate with the Product Owner that it reflects the highest‑priority outcomes.
   

  

 Pull highest‑priority, “Ready” items from the Product Backlog. Ensure each story meets the Definition of Ready (clear acceptance criteria, sizing, dependencies identified).
   

  

 Team collectively signs‑off on the sprint backlog.
   

  

 Make sure that the team do not exceed their velocity
   

  

 Make sure that the Team understand what needs to be done (Sprint Goals)
   

  

 Backlog refinement
   

  

 1‑2 h every week (or every other week) – keep it time‑boxed.
   

  

 Scope :\- Review the next 2‑3 sprints of items: ‑ clarify description, ‑ add acceptance criteria, ‑ re‑estimate if needed, ‑ remove stale items.
   

  

 DoR :\- Verify each candidate story satisfies DoR before moving it to the sprint‑planning pool.
   

  

 Risk and dependencies :\- Identify blockers, external dependencies, or technical spikes; create corresponding tickets.
   

  

 Updated, prioritized backlog with all items Ready for the next planning session.
   

  

 Sprint Retro
   

  

 What went Right? What could be Enhanced? What needs to be Resolved? ownership followup's.
   

  

 Celebrate successes; capture repeatable practices. Identify small, actionable improvements. Highlight impediments that persisted across the sprint.
   

  

 Assign owners, set due dates, and agree on a follow‑up check in the next retro.
   

  

 Record the RERO items in a “Retro Action Log” (e.g., SharePoint list) and review progress at the start of the next retro.
   

  

**After The Ceremony, Generate a Sprint Review Report Containing**
* Sprint Goal \& overall achievement %
* List of delivered stories (incl. demo link)
* Stakeholder feedback summary
* Action items for the next sprint


 Sprint Review
   

  

 Prior to the meeting, run a quick “Done‑vs‑Committed” check on the sprint board. Highlight any incomplete items and the reasons.
   

  

 Each story owner prepares a 2‑5 min demo (screens, data, walkthrough). Verify that the demo aligns with acceptance criteria and is clear \& precise.
   

  

 Ensure ISPL, business stakeholders, and any external partners are invited via calendar (include a link to the demo environment).
   

  

 1️) Sprint Goal recap 2️) Demo of completed stories 3️) Discuss partially done items \& next steps 4️) Collect feedback
   

  

 Template reuse – Store the above tables as Word/Confluence templates; copy‑paste each sprint.
   

  

 Automation – If you use Azure DevOps/Jira, link the “Sprint Review Report” to the sprint’s Summary field for automatic traceability.
   

  

 Visibility – Pin the current sprint’s Definition of Done and Definition of Ready on the team’s SharePoint home page.
   

  

 Metrics – Capture “% of committed stories delivered” and “Retro action completion rate” in a quarterly dashboard to show continuous improvement to ISPL leadership.
   

  

 Should have :\-
   

  

 Facilitate Scrum Events – Lead daily stand‑ups, sprint planning, review, and retrospectives, ensuring they stay time‑boxed, purposeful, and outcome‑focused.
   

  

 Remove Impediments – Identify, track, and resolve blockers that hinder the Development Team’s progress, escalating when necessary.
   

  

 Coach Teams on Agile Principles – Mentor the team and stakeholders on Scrum, Kanban, and lean practices, fostering a culture of continuous improvement.
   

  

 Shield the Team – Protect the team from external disruptions and unrealistic demands, enabling a sustainable pace of delivery.
   

  

 Promote Transparency \& Visibility – Maintain and update Scrum artifacts (Product Backlog, Sprint Backlog, Increment, Burndown charts) to provide clear insight into progress and quality.
   

  

 Guide Product Owner Collaboration – Assist the Product Owner in backlog refinement, prioritization, and defining clear, testable user stories.
   

  

 Drive Continuous Improvement – Capture lessons learned, implement actionable improvements, and track their impact across sprints.
   

  

 Foster Cross‑Functional Collaboration – Encourage open communication among developers, QA, UX, and other disciplines to deliver integrated, high‑value increments.
   

  

 Measure and Report Agile Metrics – Track velocity, cycle time, defect trends, and other key performance indicators, using data to inform decision‑making.
   

  

 Champion Agile Mindset – Advocate for adaptability, self‑organization, and a fail‑fast, learn‑fast approach throughout the organization.
   

  

**Behavioral Skills**
* Ability to collaborate in an international environment (Europe, India and LATAM indirectly)
* Organizational skills
* Problem solving


**Soft Skills**
* A good team player with problem\-solving attitude.
* Leadership to act as a pivot between ISPL team and other Platform delivery contributors


**Education Level:** 
 Master Degree or equivalent
   

  

**Location:** 
 Chennai
   

  

**About BNP Paribas Group**
 BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking \& Services for the Group’s commercial \& personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment \& Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate \& Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial \& personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast\-growing business in Asia\-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability.
   

  

**About BNP Paribas India Solutions**
 Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 10000 employees, to provide support and develop best\-in\-class solutions.
   

  

**Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
 At BNP Paribas, we passionately embrace diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all employees are valued, respected and can bring their authentic selves to work. We prohibit Discrimination and Harassment of any kind and our policies promote equal employment opportunity for all employees and applicants, irrespective of, but not limited to their gender, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, ethnicity, race, colour, national origin, age, religion, social status, mental or physical disabilities, veteran status etc. As a global Bank, we truly believe that inclusion and diversity of our teams is key to our success in serving our clients and the communities we operate in. description:
**Product Designer** 




  





**About WorkIndia** 




 WorkIndia is India's largest blue\- and grey\-collar hiring platform, built with a clear purpose: to provide meaningful livelihoods to 23\.7 crore blue\-collar individuals across India.
 



 WorkIndia helps millions of job seekers connect with employers across the country. On the employer side, WorkIndia serves tens of thousands of businesses every month, enabling them to discover, evaluate, and hire relevant candidates at scale.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We're looking for a Product Designer to help shape simple, intuitive and effective experiences for millions of candidates and employers on WorkIndia.
 



 You'll work on complex product problems where the right experience can directly influence whether a candidate finds a relevant job or an employer successfully hires.
 



 You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data, Consumer Insights and business teams to understand user problems, define the right experience, explore solutions, and take them through execution and iteration.
 



 This role requires strong product judgment, deep user empathy and excellent design craft — but most importantly, the ability to solve the right problem rather than simply design the solution you're given.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 




  





**Product \& User Thinking** 



* Understand user and business problems deeply before jumping into solutions
* Challenge briefs and help identify the highest\-impact problems to solve
* Leverage user research and product data to form and validate design hypotheses
* Collaborate with PMs to define measurable success criteria



**Experience Design** 



* Design end\-to\-end experiences across mobile and web, from concepts to production\-ready UI
* Translate problems and requirements into flows, wireframes and prototypes
* Simplify complex workflows while thinking through edge cases and real\-world scenarios
* Maintain a high bar for interaction and visual design quality



**Systems \& Scalability** 



* Build and evolve reusable patterns aligned with WorkIndia's design system
* Identify recurring experience problems and solve them systematically
* Design experiences that can scale across users, categories, geographies and use cases



**Validation \& Iteration** 



* Conduct usability testing and integrate findings into design decisions
* Use user feedback and funnel data to identify and solve usability issues
* Iterate quickly based on evidence and track whether shipped experiences improve outcomes



**Collaboration \& Execution** 



* Partner closely with PMs and Engineering throughout design and implementation
* Communicate design rationale, trade\-offs, risks and blockers proactively
* Ensure design intent is maintained through development and QA
* Make pragmatic trade\-offs without compromising core user value
* Proactively identify UX/UI improvements beyond assigned scope



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* 3–5 years of Product / UX Design experience with a strong portfolio demonstrating end\-to\-end ownership
* Strong interaction design fundamentals and high visual design craft
* Demonstrated ability to solve ambiguous problems and create simple, intuitive experiences
* Strong understanding of user research, usability testing and product analytics
* Experience working with design systems and creating reusable patterns
* Ability to balance user needs, business objectives, technical constraints and speed
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, particularly with Product and Engineering
* Comfortable working independently in a fast\-paced, high\-ownership environment
* Marketplace, consumer internet or two\-sided product experience is a strong plus



  





**What Will Make You Successful** 



* You start with the problem, not the screen
* You take ownership from problem discovery through launch and iteration
* You move quickly and favour learning over waiting for the perfect solution
* You actively seek feedback and are comfortable changing your mind when evidence is presented
* You find creative ways through product, business and technical constraints without losing sight of user value
* You have a high bar for craft without letting perfection slow down learning
* You think in systems, not just individual features



  





**Job Location:** 
 HSR Layout, Bengaluru
 



  





**Why Join WorkIndia?** 



* **Impact:** 
 Be part of a mission\-driven company whose product impacts millions of job seekers and businesses every day.
* **Scale:** 
 Design experiences used by millions of users across India's diverse blue\- and grey\-collar workforce.
* **Ownership:** 
 Work on meaningful product problems with significant ownership over the experience and outcomes.

**About The Role**

Working as an extension of healthcare professionals, the MDS documents patient encounters within Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems while ensuring compliance with organizational quality standards, provider preferences, and applicable healthcare regulations.
   

  

 Medical Documentation Specialists leverage Commure's Ambient AI technology and documentation workflows to reduce providers' administrative burden, enabling providers to spend more time focusing on patient care.
   

  

 This is an entry\-level opportunity designed for recent graduates and early\-career professionals. Through a structured onboarding program, comprehensive training, ongoing coaching, and continuous feedback, Medical Documentation Specialists develop expertise in clinical documentation, medical terminology, healthcare technology, provider workflows, and documentation best practices while maintaining the highest standards of quality, confidentiality, and operational excellence.

 The program is designed to prepare participants for live documentation responsibilities while fostering professional growth, operational excellence, and a commitment to continuous learning. Upon successful completion of the training program, participants transition into the Medical Documentation Specialist role with ongoing coaching, mentorship, and quality support to further develop their expertise and advance their careers within Commure.

**The Medical Documentation Specialist Is Accountable For**

**Clinical Documentation**

* Review completed documentation for completeness, consistency, and accuracy prior to submission.
* Complete documentation within established turnaround time and productivity expectations.
* Apply learnings from onboarding, coaching sessions, and quality feedback to continuously improve documentation accuracy and efficiency.


**Clinician Support**
