+ Primary Care
+ Internal Medicine
+ Oncology
+ Orthopedics
+ Rheumatology
+ Other specialties as assigned.

* Learn clinician\-specific workflows, documentation preferences, and specialty requirements through structured training and practical experience.
* Adapt documentation style and workflow to individual clinician requirements.
* Communicate professionally and effectively while supporting providers and collaborating with internal stakeholders.


**Documentation Quality**
* Produce documentation that meets established organizational quality standards and clinician expectations.
* Learn and apply specialty/provider\-specific documentation guidelines and best practices.
* Identify documentation inconsistencies and seek clarification through appropriate channels when required.
* Incorporate feedback from quality reviews, coaching sessions, and audits into daily practice.
* Participate in quality improvement initiatives and calibration activities.


**Technology \& Workflow Management**
* Utilize Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems and documentation platforms effectively.
* Develop proficiency in Commure's Ambient AI documentation technology and associated workflow tools through structured training and guided practice.
* Navigate multiple systems while maintaining productivity, accuracy, and quality.
* Follow established operational workflows, standard operating procedures, and documentation processes.
* Escalate workflow, technology, or system\-related issues through appropriate channels.


**Compliance \& Information Security**
* Maintain compliance with HIPAA and all applicable patient privacy, confidentiality, and information security requirements.
* Protect Protected Health Information (PHI) in accordance with organizational policies.
* Adhere to Commure's compliance, security, and documentation standards.
* Complete mandatory compliance and security training within required timelines.


**Continuous Learning \& Professional Development**
* Successfully complete onboarding, certification, and ongoing training programs.
* Continuously develop knowledge of medical terminology, specialty\-specific documentation, healthcare workflows, and emerging technologies.
* Stay current with documentation standards, organizational processes, and workflow enhancements.
* Demonstrate curiosity, adaptability, coachability, and a commitment to continuous learning and professional growth.
* Actively participate in refresher trainings, coaching sessions, quality reviews, and knowledge\-sharing initiatives.


**Collaboration**
* Collaborate effectively with Operations, Quality, Training, Product, and other cross\-functional teams.
* Participate in coaching sessions, quality calibrations, workflow reviews, and operational improvement initiatives.
* Seek guidance from trainers, mentors, and quality teams to continuously improve performance.
* Escalate documentation, workflow, clinician, or operational concerns through appropriate channels.

Cohesity is the leader in AI\-powered data security. Over 13,600 enterprise customers, including over 85 of the Fortune 100 and nearly 70% of the Global 500, rely on Cohesity to strengthen their resilience while providing Gen AI insights into their vast amounts of data. Formed from the combination of Cohesity with Veritas’ enterprise data protection business, the company’s solutions secure and protect data on\-premises, in the cloud, and at the edge. Backed by NVIDIA, IBM, HPE, Cisco, AWS, Google Cloud, and others, Cohesity is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA, with offices around the globe.
   

  

 We’ve been named a Leader by multiple analyst firms and have been globally recognized for Innovation, Product Strength, and Simplicity in Design , and our culture.
   

  

**Want to join the leader in AI\-powered data security?**
 Cohesity is looking for a Front End Software Engineer to join one of our largest teams in Cloud Vertical. With millions of documents, terabytes of emails, and endless Teams conversations, we deal with unprecedented data volumes that require unique strategies and algorithms to process data efficiently. Keeping pace with the changing nature of products while ensuring seamless protection is a puzzle we solve every day. Our team tackles these challenges head\-on with creativity, technical expertise, and a passion for excellence. Through mentorship, cross\-training, and constant learning, you’ll grow your skills in ways you never imagined. Be part of a mission\-critical team to protect the data that drives businesses across the world.
   

  

 As a Front End Software Engineer, you will be an individual contributor focused on delivering features with high quality, along with continuous quality improvements with the help of automation. Working on the UI, you’ll be expected to coordinate with Product Management and User Experience team on the mock\-ups as well as with the backend engineers on the interfaces and end\-to\-end testing. There will be a large variety of features to work on including: distributed and parallel data flows, cloud services, asynchronous programming, performance optimization, infinite scalability, snapshots, resiliency, multiple protocols, and fault tolerance.
   

  

 We are a passionate team of customer obsessed and quality focused engineers with a desire to disrupt the way organizations manage and protect their data, to help them unleash the maximum value locked in their data. We are looking for an outstanding UI Engineer to expand our team of UI engineers that are excited about building quality products and delivering value to customers through simplifying the world of data management.
   

  

**How You’ll Spend Your Time Here**
 As part of this team, you will design and build massively distributed systems at web\-scale. You’ll be building the UI that is closest to the customers when they are interacting with Cohesity’s hyper\-converged, highly\-scalable storage clusters.
   

  

**WE’D LOVE TO TALK TO YOU IF YOU HAVE MANY OF THE FOLLOWING**

title: Embedded Systems Engineer-Medical Devices
description:
Embedded Systems Engineer – Medical Devices
 
  





**Company:** 
  Shulkon Healthcare Pvt. Ltd.
 



**Location:** 
  Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra
 



**Employment Type:** 
  Full\-Time \| On\-Site
 



**Experience:** 
  4–8 Years
 



**CTC:** 
  ₹6–12 LPA
 



  





  




 About Shulkon Healthcare
 
 Shulkon Healthcare is a healthcare technology company focused on developing, manufacturing, and supplying medical devices, surgical products, and healthcare solutions.
 



 Our R\&D team is developing innovative medical and rehabilitation technologies involving embedded electronics, sensors, motorized systems, automation, and connected devices.
 



 We are looking for a hands\-on 
 **Embedded Systems Engineer** 
  who can contribute to the development of medical devices from 
 **prototype and engineering development through testing, validation, and production** 
 .
 



  





  




 Role Overview
 
 We are seeking a technically strong and hands\-on 
 **Embedded Systems Engineer** 
  to join our Medical Devices R\&D team in 
 **Navi Mumbai** 
 .
 



 The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, integrating, testing, and debugging embedded firmware and electronic systems used in medical devices.
 



 You will work closely with 
 **electronics, mechanical, product development, quality, manufacturing, and clinical/application teams** 
  to convert product requirements into reliable, manufacturable, and safe embedded systems.
 



 The ideal candidate should be comfortable working in an R\&D laboratory and troubleshooting problems across 
 **firmware, electronics, sensors, motors, actuators, and communication interfaces** 
 .
 



  





  




 Key Responsibilities1\. Embedded Firmware Development
 * Design, develop, test, debug, and maintain embedded firmware using 
 **Embedded C/C\+\+** 
 .
* Develop firmware for microcontroller\-based medical and rehabilitation devices.
* Work with 
 **ARM Cortex\-M, STM32, ESP32, PIC** 
 , or equivalent microcontrollers.
* Develop firmware in 
 **bare\-metal and RTOS environments** 
 .
* Implement device\-control logic, sensor interfaces, motor/actuator control, alarms, safety functions, user\-interface functions, data acquisition, logging, and communication.
* Optimize firmware for reliability, performance, maintainability, and production use.
* Perform firmware debugging, optimization, and root\-cause analysis.


 2\. Hardware–Firmware Integration
 * Collaborate with electronics engineers during schematic, PCB, and prototype development.
* Participate in 
 **PCB bring\-up and hardware–firmware integration** 
 .
* Interface and troubleshoot:
* Sensors
* Motors
* Actuators
* Encoders
* Limit switches
* Displays
* Keypads/buttons
* ADC/DAC
* Relays
* Analog and digital circuits
* Diagnose whether problems originate from firmware, electronics, hardware interfaces, or system integration.


 3\. Sensors, Motors \& Actuators
 
 Experience with electromechanical systems will be highly valued.
 



 The candidate may work with:
 


* Position and pressure sensors
* Temperature and other analog sensors
* Encoders
* DC motors
* BLDC motors
* Stepper motors
* Servo motors
* Linear actuators
* Motor drivers
* Limit switches
* Electromechanical safety mechanisms



 Knowledge of 
 **closed\-loop control, PWM, feedback systems, and PID concepts** 
  will be an advantage.
 


 4\. Communication Interfaces
 
 Hands\-on experience with several of the following:
 


* UART
* SPI
* I²C
* CAN
* USB
* RS\-232 / RS\-485
* BLE / Bluetooth
* Wi\-Fi
* Ethernet



 Experience with telemetry, data logging, device connectivity, or IoT applications will be an advantage.
 


 5\. Testing \& Debugging
 
 Use laboratory equipment to systematically identify and resolve technical problems, including:
 


* Oscilloscopes
* Logic analyzers
* Digital multimeters
* Function/signal generators
* DC power supplies
* Electronic loads



 The candidate should be capable of tracing signals and diagnosing problems at the 
 **firmware, communication, sensor, power, and actuator levels** 
 .
 


 6\. Medical Device Development \& Quality
 
 Participate in the development of medical devices within Shulkon's quality and design\-control processes.
 



 Exposure to the following will be preferred:
 


* **ISO 13485**
* **ISO 14971**
* **IEC 62304**
* Design controls
* Risk management
* Software requirements
* Software architecture and design
* Verification and validation
* Traceability
* Root\-cause analysis
* Corrective and preventive actions



**Medical\-device experience is preferred but not mandatory.** 




 .
 


 7\. Technical Documentation
 
 Prepare and maintain technical documentation including:
 


* Firmware/software requirements
* Firmware architecture and design documents
* Interface specifications
* Test protocols
* Test reports
* Verification records
* Debugging and root\-cause reports
* Version\-control records
* Engineering change documentation



  





  




 Required Technical SkillsMust Have
 * **4–8 years of hands\-on experience** 
  in embedded systems, firmware development, electronics product development, or a closely related field.
* Strong programming skills in 
 **Embedded C/C\+\+** 
 .
* Experience with 
 **ARM Cortex\-M / STM32 or equivalent** 
 .
* Strong understanding of:
* GPIO
* Interrupts
* Timers
* PWM
* ADC/DAC
* UART
* SPI
* I²C
* Experience with hardware–firmware integration.
* Ability to read and understand electronic schematics.
* Experience with 
 **PCB bring\-up and debugging** 
 .
* Hands\-on experience using an 
 **oscilloscope and logic analyzer** 
 .
* Good understanding of microcontroller architecture and embedded debugging.
* Experience with 
 **Git or equivalent version\-control systems** 
 .
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.


 Preferred / Good to Have
 * STM32CubeIDE / STM32CubeMX
* FreeRTOS or another RTOS
* ESP32
* Motor\-control systems
* Sensor integration
* BLE/Wi\-Fi
* Data acquisition and logging
* Embedded product development from prototype to production
* Medical\-device development
* IEC 62304 / ISO 14971 / ISO 13485 exposure
* Jira or equivalent development\-tracking tools



  





  




 Education
 
**B.E. / B.Tech / M.E. / M.Tech** 
  in:
 


* Electronics
* Electronics \& Telecommunication
* Electrical Engineering
* Instrumentation
* Computer Engineering
* Embedded Systems
* or a related discipline



 Relevant hands\-on industry experience will be given significant importance.
 



  





  




 Ideal Candidate Profile
 
 We are looking for an engineer who is 
 **hands\-on, technically curious, and comfortable working in an R\&D laboratory** 
 .
 



 The ideal candidate should be capable of independently working through:
 



**Product Requirement → Embedded Design → Firmware → PCB Bring\-up → Sensor/Motor Integration → Debugging → Testing → Verification → Production** 




 Candidates who have personally developed and debugged real embedded products will be strongly preferred over candidates whose experience is primarily limited to software maintenance or application\-level programming.
 



  





  




 Key Competencies
 * Strong analytical and troubleshooting ability
* Ownership and accountability
* Attention to detail
* Practical problem\-solving approach
* Ability to work independently
* Good technical documentation skills
* Ability to collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams
* Willingness to work hands\-on with hardware and laboratory equipment
* Strong commitment to product quality, reliability, and patient safety



  





  




 Compensation
 
**CTC: ₹6–12 LPA** 




 Final compensation will be based on:
 


* Relevant experience
* Embedded C/C\+\+ capability
* STM32/ARM expertise
* Hardware\-debugging skills
* Sensor/motor integration experience
* Product\-development experience
* Medical\-device/regulatory exposure
* Overall technical assessment



**Maximum CTC: ₹12 LPA** 




  





  




 Why Join Shulkon Healthcare?Build Real Medical Technology
 
 Work on embedded systems that form part of real medical and rehabilitation products.
 


 End\-to\-End Product Development
 
 Gain exposure to the complete product\-development lifecycle:
 



**Concept → Prototype → Engineering Development → Testing → Validation → Manufacturing → Market** 



 Multidisciplinary R\&D
 
 Work with electronics, mechanical, product, quality, manufacturing, and clinical/application teams.
 


 Growth Opportunity
 * As Shulkon expands its medical\-device portfolio, the successful candidate will have the opportunity to grow into a 
 **Senior Embedded Systems / Medical Device R\&D** 
  role.
